title: Eigenius: A Typed Knowledge-Graph DBMS with Epistemic Stratification and Institution-Mediated Reasoning
summary: As "AI Scientists" emerge to drive research via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), systems relying on ephemeral scripts will fail. The sheer scale of stateful, interconnected evidence requires a machine-walkable warranty grounded in a purpose-built database architecture. Eigenius is an open-source, typed knowledge-graph DBMS built on a single premise: answering the audit question ("what do you know, and what is your warranty?") requires a unified kernel. By tightly coupling the type system, storage engine, and integration protocol, Eigenius turns data provenance into a structural invariant rather than a property reconstructed across subsystem boundaries. The kernel rests on three pillars: a dependent type theory woven through the core, institutions acting as strongly typed integration boundaries, and a content-addressed immutable storage layer. On this foundation, epistemic status (declared/observed/derived/verified) is enforced as a strict commit-time invariant. Cross-system translations (comorphisms) are checked at commit and materialized directly into the graph as durable, first-class resources. To eliminate O(N^2) polystore bottlenecks, shared on-chain intermediate representations (IRs) collapse multi-system translations to identity. Crucially, this architecture unifies both domains of scientific epistemology: it relies on justification logic for empirical science, while embedding a fast, in-process term checker to safely evaluate formal mathematical proofs (via Lean 4) without IPC overhead. In an end-to-end recomputation of a published Nature study from fragile scripts to a materialized evidence graph, all 52 derived conclusions hold from pinned data, surfacing four machine-checked discrepancies in the original study.

AI.tldr: Eigenius 是一个面向 AI Scientist 场景的开源类型化知识图谱数据库管理系统（DBMS），通过将类型系统、存储引擎与集成协议统一在内核中，把数据溯源（data provenance）提升为结构性不变量而非事后重构属性，从而为 MCP 驱动的科研工作流提供可机器遍历、可审计的"知识保单"。
AI.motivation: 随着基于模型上下文协议（MCP）的"AI 科学家"兴起，传统依赖临时脚本（ephemeral scripts）的研究流程难以承载大规模、有状态、相互关联的证据数据。现有数据栈中溯源信息分散于多个子系统边界之外，无法直接回答审计性问题（"你知道什么，你的保单是什么？"），存在 O(N²) 多存储（polystore）翻译瓶颈以及经验科学与形式化数学缺乏统一处理框架的痛点。
AI.method: 提出 Eigenius 统一内核，由三大支柱构成：(1) 贯穿核心的依值类型理论（dependent type theory），将认识论状态（declared/observed/derived/verified，即声明/观察/推导/已验证）作为强制的提交时不变量；(2) 作为强类型集成边界的"机构"（institutions），支持跨系统翻译（comorphisms）在提交时校验并作为一等持久资源直接物化进图谱；(3) 内容寻址的不可变存储层。通过共享的链上中间表示（on-chain IRs）将多系统翻译塌缩为恒等映射，消除 O(N²) polystore 瓶颈。在认识论上：经验科学侧基于辩护逻辑（justification logic）；形式数学侧通过内嵌 Lean 4 进程内项检查器（term checker）安全求值证明，避免 IPC 开销。
AI.result: 在一项端到端的重计算实验中，Eigenius 将一项已发表的 Nature 研究从脆弱脚本重写为物化的证据图谱（materialized evidence graph）：全部 52 条派生结论（derived conclusions）在固定（pinned）数据下均成立，同时在该原始研究中机器可检查地发现了 4 处不一致（discrepancies），证明了该架构在审计严谨性与可复现性上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Eigenius 通过将类型、存储与协议统一为单一内核，把数据溯源与认识论状态内化为结构性不变量，为 AI 科学家提供了一个可审计、可复现、跨经验与形式数学域的证据承载平台；初步复现实验表明其在自然科学研究流水线中既具备工程可行性，又具备发现原始研究中隐性错误的实际能力。

title: From Research Questions to Columns: Operationalization-Aware Data Discovery
summary: Researchers often approach a data repository with an abstract concept and ask which columns can measure it. Useful columns may not resemble the query; they may matter only as complementary indicators in a defensible measure. This need differs from schema linking and column retrieval, which begin from more explicit needs and reward direct relevance. We define operationalization-aware data discovery (OADD): given a broad question and a database, optionally under a scope constraint, OADD jointly determines how focal concepts can be measured with available data and identifies supporting columns. Developing OADD methods requires examples for design and evaluation, but asking researchers to supply conceptual questions and their columns is impractical. We construct OADD-Bench by treating empirical papers as records of schema in use. A question miner extracts and reframes a paper-supported question; a paper-conditioned column miner reconstructs its measurements and grounds them to database identifiers. We admit only mappings supported by the publication and database documentation. OADD-Bench contains 160 questions from 111 papers and 4,682 question-column labels. Each target records a measurement used in published research; the paper supplies the precedent, while the miners extract and ground it. We evaluate lexical and neural retrieval, adapted schema-linking systems, and large language model (LLM) OADD agents. Each method receives only a question, permitted years, and dataset metadata; source papers are used only to construct and document benchmark labels. At the largest output limit, direct retrieval reaches at most 0.185 recall. The strongest schema-linking adaptation reaches 0.401 but remains optimized for a different objective; an OADD-directed agent performs best at 0.465. Even this agent covers less than half the target columns, showing that OADD remains an open problem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一项名为"操作化感知数据发现"（OADD）的新任务，旨在弥合研究者的抽象概念与数据库中可用测量列之间的"操作化鸿沟"。作者构建了基于同行评审论文的基准 OADD-Bench（160个问题、4682个问题-列标签），并评估了词法检索、神经检索、适配的schema链接系统和LLM代理，结果显示即便是最强方法也只能覆盖不到一半的目标列，证明OADD仍是一个开放问题。
AI.motivation: 研究者常以抽象概念检索数据库（如"社会隔离"），但数据库中并不存在直接对应字段，需要通过多个间接指标组合进行测量。现有的schema链接和列检索方法假设用户已明确所需数据，只奖励直接相关性，无法识别那些仅在测量组合中才有价值的间接指示变量。这种"操作化鸿沟"使可行的研究显得不可行，或迫使研究者使用浅层相关的代理变量。
AI.method: 问题形式化：给定研究问题q、数据库D和可选范围约束C，输出一组列V(M)，使得这些列能共同为q中的焦点测量角色提供科学上合理的可操作化度量。基准构建：利用已发表论文作为"使用中的模式"记录，通过问题挖掘器（question miner）提取并重构论文支持的研究问题，通过论文条件列挖掘器（paper-conditioned column miner）重建其测量方式并映射到HRS的精确字段标识符（仅保留论文和数据库文档支持的映射）。评估方法：在4层方法上对比——直接检索（BM25、TF-IDF、BGE-base、SPLADE++）、5种适配的schema链接系统、3种LLM代理配置（GPT-5.4 nano/mini、GPT-5.5），使用Recall@R、@2R、@5R作为指标。
AI.result: 直接检索表现最弱，Recall@5R最高仅0.185（BGE-base）；schema链接适配中AutoLink最强达0.401，但仍是针对不同优化目标；OADD导向的GPT-5.5代理表现最佳，Recall@5R为0.465，但仍覆盖不到一半目标列。在部分/完整测量组件覆盖率上，GPT-5.5代理仅在50/160问题中检索到每个组件的至少一个字段，即使扩大输出预算（从2R到5R）召回率提升有限（0.458→0.465），表明限制并非输出预算而是检索能力。共识性检查显示LLM挖掘器与人工标注的宏平均集合F1达0.933。
AI.conclusion: OADD是一个对数据管理社区而言新颖但对研究者熟悉的问题，需要联合推理科学测量与数据库列的实 现。OADD-Bench为该问题提供了基于出版物的可复现评测基础。当前方法普遍不足，开放方向包括：针对跨重复波次的bundle级发现、溯源感知的字段对应、以及人机交互式的研究者验证。同时论文也揭示了可操作化失败对数据科学研究的潜在影响。

title: A General Sufficient Condition for Rewriting Horn-ALCHI Atomic Queries into GQL
comment: 27 pages. Technical report of a paper to appear at ISWC 2026
summary: The emergence of the ISO standard GQL introduces a powerful query language extending first-order logic with controlled recursion, raising the question of its applicability to evaluation of ontology-mediated queries (OMQs). We focus on OMQs consisting of atomic queries over ontologies expressed in Horn-ALCHI, an expressive Description Logic that is not, in general, first-order rewritable. To address this, we introduce DL automata, a novel formalism that captures the semantics of such OMQs via runs over fact sets. We then identify a large class of DL automata that can be rewritten into unions of conjunctive two-way regular path queries (UC2RPQs), a central fragment of GQL. Our class of automata relies on a stratification of their states, ruling out specific forms of cyclic dependencies known to raise the complexity. This yields a broad class of Horn-ALCHI OMQs that are GQL-rewritable.

AI.tldr: 本文针对 Horn-ALCHI 描述逻辑上的本体介导原子查询（OMQ），提出了一种将其重写为 ISO 标准图查询语言 GQL 的充分条件。作者引入了一种新的自动机形式——DL 自动机，并基于其状态的"分层"（stratification）条件，识别出一大类可被重写为 GQL 核心片段 UC2RPQ 的查询。该方法严格扩展了此前相关工作（如 DL-Lite、无害线性 ELHI、拟线性 ELH 等的可重写类）。
AI.motivation: 1. GQL 作为新发布的 ISO 标准查询语言，在数据库和图查询领域具有重要应用价值，但其在本体介导查询（OMQ）评估中的适用性尚不明确。2. Horn-ALCHI 是一种表达力丰富的描述逻辑（含逆角色、角色构造子），但其上的原子查询通常不可一阶（FO）重写，因此需要超越 FO 的重写技术。3. 已有工作（如 harmless linear ELHI、quasi-linear ELH 等）只能覆盖受限的查询子类，存在大量可重写但未被捕获的查询，亟需更一般的充分条件。
AI.method: 1. **规范化（Section 3）**：将 Horn-ALCHI 查询通过两步归约为 Horn-ALC（无存在量词）查询：先利用角色包含关系的自反传递闭包消除角色包含公理；再借助现有翻译技术消除存在量词公理（可能产生指数级膨胀）。2. **DL 自动机（Section 4）**：提出一种新型有限状态装置，其状态对应类，转移函数包含二元转移（标记为 ε、类或角色表达式）和多元转移（标记为 ε）。DL 自动机通过在事实集上的"运行"（类似树自动机在树上的运行）定义布尔查询；并证明 Horn-ALC 查询与对应 DL 自动机等价。3. **分层条件与重写（Section 5）**：定义二元依赖关系 ≻，刻画当某状态经历角色二元转移后经若干转移再触发多元转移时产生的依赖。分层条件要求 ≻ 无环。基于此，对每个分层状态按层号归纳地将其重写为正二元正则路径查询（PQs），其中利用 Kleene 定理将无多元转移部分转化为正则表达式。4. **从 PQ 到 GQL（Section 6）**：通过标准的分配律变换将 PQ 转化为 UC2RPQ，再利用已有结果将 UC2RPQ 嵌入 GQL。
AI.result: 1. **Theorem 3.1**：任意 Horn-ALCHI 查询可计算地等价于一个 Horn-ALC 查询。2. **等价性定理**：Horn-ALC 查询与其对应 DL 自动机等价；分层 DL 自动机与对应 PQ 等价。3. **Theorem 6.1**：存在从 PQ 到 GQL 的保等价重写。4. **覆盖范围扩展**：所识别的分层 DL 自动机类严格扩展了 DL-Lite 类；通过具体示例证明能覆盖此前 harmless linear ELHI 和 quasi-linear ELH with limited inverses 无法重写的查询（如示例 2 中的 Trust 查询）。5. 该工作同时给出了完整的证明（含 DL 自动机等价性、分层自动机到 PQ 的正确性等）。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心贡献是提出了一种基于"分层 DL 自动机"的充分条件，能够将一大类 Horn-ALCHI 原子查询重写为 GQL 公式。方法路线为：Horn-ALCHI → Horn-ALC → DL 自动机 → 分层 DL 自动机 → PQ → UC2RPQ → GQL。意义在于：(i) 形式化地扩展了 GQL 在 OMQ 评估中的应用范围；(ii) 所提类严格包含此前多种已知可重写子类；(iii) DL 自动机的引入为后续研究（如利用自动机理论工具证明不可表达性）提供了新视角。未来工作包括：扩展以处理 ⊥（不相交公理）和角色链、放宽分层条件以捕获更广查询类（如可被嵌套正则路径查询表达的查询）、经验性评估、以及刻画不可被 GQL 表达的 Horn-ALCHI 查询类的完整特征。

title: EdgeLM: Edge Demonstrations for Language Models' Table Understanding
summary: Large language models (LLMs) perform table-centric prediction through in-context learning, making demonstration selection critical to performance. Existing retrieval methods prioritize similarity to the query, but similar demonstrations often reinforce the model's likely prediction rather than reveal the distinctions needed for difficult decisions. We propose EdgeLM, a retrieval framework that instead selects edge evidence, demonstrations that are both relevant to the query and informative about the decision boundary. EdgeLM retrieves two complementary forms of edge evidence by selecting data edges, nearby examples with different ground-truth labels, and model edges, similar examples previously misclassified by the deployed model. EdgeLM requires neither model retraining nor task-specific engineering. Across five data wrangling tasks, fifteen datasets, and five open-weight and proprietary LLMs, EdgeLM consistently achieves the best or near-best performance in every setting, while ablations show that the two forms of edge evidence provide complementary benefits. Our code and datasets are publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: EdgeLM是一个用于LLM表格理解任务的检索式上下文学习演示选择框架，通过选择"边界证据"演示——既与查询相关又能揭示决策边界信息的样本——来提升LLM在表格任务上的性能。它在15个数据集、5个数据整理任务和5个LLM上一致优于零样本、随机、多样性和相似性检索等基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有演示选择方法主要基于与查询的相似度，但这往往强化了模型的预测倾向，而非揭示困难决策所需的关键区别。当样本处于决策边界附近时，相似的邻居可能都共享同一标签，反而强化了错误或默认预测。作者认为有效的演示不仅需要与查询相关，还应能区分局部决策边界，即展示竞争预测之间的关键差异。
AI.method: EdgeLM利用两种互补的"边界证据"：(1) 数据边界（Data Edge）：从查询的局部邻域中选取具有不同真实标签的样本，通过轮询各标签组来确保标签对比性；(2) 模型边界（Model Edge）：预先对LLM进行零样本评估以构建错误池，然后选取与查询相似但模型曾预测错误的样本作为纠正性演示。两种演示按固定预算比例组合成单一提示，无需模型重训练或任务特定工程。
AI.result: 在5个LLM（Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-Nemo-12B、GPT-4o-mini、Gemini-3.1-flash-lite）和15个数据集的全面评估中，EdgeLM在几乎所有模型-任务组合上达到最佳或接近最佳F1分数。消融实验显示两种边界证据提供互补收益（数据边界提升+0.095~+0.259 F1，模型边界提升+0.049~+0.300 F1）。预算分配（数据边界与模型边界的比例）对性能不敏感，平均差异仅+0.010 F1。异常检测等不平衡任务提升最大（F1提升+0.099~+0.212）。额外检索开销极小（<1ms/查询），且仅需一次性的零样本错误池构建。
AI.conclusion: 演示相对于决策边界的位置比其与查询的相似度更重要。边界感知检索为上下文学习提供了一种简单而通用的增强手段。EdgeLM的两种边界视图互补且对预算分配具有鲁棒性，无需针对新数据集或模型进行调整，仅需少量标注池即可部署。未来工作可扩展至流式/在线场景和非表格结构化数据。

title: A Long-Run Persistence Theory for AI Systems under the Redundancy-Adjusted Artificial Age Score (AAS)
comment: 38 pages, no figures, theoretical paper with theorems and proofs
summary: Artificial intelligence systems are increasingly expected to operate over repeated cycles of interaction, adaptation, and update rather than through isolated one-shot outputs. This raises a fundamental theoretical question: can an AI system persist indefinitely without incurring unbounded structural aging? This paper develops a long-run persistence framework for AI systems based on the redundancy-adjusted Artificial Age Score (AAS). The model extends AAS from a static evaluative measure into a cycle-level functional that generates an age sequence across repeated operation. At each cycle, structural age is defined through a weighted, redundancy-aware logarithmic penalty over component consistency levels. Within this framework, cycle-level age is shown to be well defined and uniformly bounded, thereby excluding explosive pointwise aging. On this basis, the paper defines a hierarchy of asymptotic regimes, including burdened persistence, zero-burden persistence, oscillatory persistence, and cumulative terminal burden. It also establishes comparative ordering, sensitivity bounds, convergence under componentwise stabilization, persistence under finite total variation, geometric stabilization under damped inter-cycle perturbations, and a zero-burden characterization under nondegenerate redundancy conditions. The main result is that indefinite cyclic continuation does not require unbounded structural aging: an AI system may pass through infinitely many cycles while its structural age remains bounded, while under stronger regularity conditions its marginal aging vanishes and, in the strongest regime, its cycle-level burden converges to zero. The framework thus provides a formal basis for analyzing long-run artificial persistence as a problem of bounded structural burden rather than inevitable cumulative deterioration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于冗余调整人工年龄评分（AAS）的长期持续性理论框架，将AI系统从单次评估的静态度量拓展为跨重复操作周期的循环级泛函，旨在形式化分析AI系统在无限次操作下结构年龄是否不可避免地趋于发散。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统在交互、适应与更新中反复运行，单次成败指标已不足以刻画其纵向行为：端点成功掩盖了时间结构、二元判断忽略了退化程度、加性度量对冗余弱点存在重复计数。论文试图解决一个基础理论问题——AI系统能否在无限多个运行周期中持续存在而不累积无界结构性老化。
AI.method: 论文以Kayadibi（2026）的冗余调整AAS为基础，构建循环级年龄泛函 $A_n=\sum_{i=1}^{m} w_i(1-R_{n,i})\phi(x_{n,i})$，其中包含三个因子通道：归一化权重 $w_i$、对数惩罚核 $\phi(x)=-\log_2((x+\varepsilon)/(1+\varepsilon))$（含正则化参数 $\varepsilon$）以及冗余修正因子 $1-R_{n,i}$。进而定义三类循环间量（符号增量 $\delta_n$、绝对波动 $D_n$、正累积 $\Delta_n$）与累积负担 $\mathcal{C}_N$，并建立四级渐近运行机制：负担式持续、零负担式持续、振荡式持续、累积终局负担。在此基础上证明系列的定理，包括核的非负性与一致有界性、单调性凸性、循环级年龄的良定义与一致有界、比较序关系、对一致小扰动的Lipschitz灵敏度、分量收敛蕴含年龄收敛、有限变差蕴含收敛、几何衰减扰动下的几何稳定、非退化冗余条件下零负担的充要刻画等。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：（1）循环级年龄 $A_n\in[0,B_\varepsilon)$ 一致有界，排除逐点爆炸性老化；（2）弱一致性与弱冗余修正不会产生更小年龄（比较序定理）；（3）在一致下界 $\alpha$ 下，对内部扰动满足加权Lipschitz稳定；（4）有限总变差 $\sum|A_{n+1}-A_n|<\infty$ 蕴含 $\{A_n\}$ 收敛且 $D_n,\Delta_n\to 0$；（5）分量级以几何速率衰减扰动时，循环年龄以 $D_n\leq Cq^n$ 几何稳定；（6）累积级有限 $\sum A_n<\infty$ 当且仅当 $A_n\to 0$；（7）若 $A_n\to A^*>0$ 则累积负担必发散；（8）在非退化冗余条件下，零负担持续等价于所有活跃分量一致性渐近趋于1，即 $x_{n,i}\to 1$。核心结论：无限循环延续不需要无界结构老化——系统在无穷多周期中可保持年龄有界，在更强正则性下其边际老化消失，并在最强机制下负担趋于零。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心结论是：在所提出的框架下，AI系统的无限循环运行与有界结构年龄在数学上相容，并在强化条件下兼容边际老化消失乃至循环级负担渐近趋于零。长期持续性不应被理解为必然的结构爆炸式退化，而是有界冗余调整负担在重复操作下的渐近行为问题。该框架为将长期人工持续性从二元"运行/失败"范式过渡到结构负担的渐近剖面分析提供了形式语言。

title: The LLM Proposes, the Executive Disposes: A Self-Verifying Agent Instrument that Dissociates Commitment Drift from Binding Drift in Long-Horizon Agents
summary: How do you verify a long-horizon agent when its own state and self-reports are exactly what you cannot trust? We present an agent instrument built so that verification is structural rather than post-hoc. A deterministic Executive owns all belief; a language model may only file typed proposals, and a claim is admitted only when a prediction pre-registered before acting is matched against observation by code. Two properties make the instrument a verifier of its own science, not just of the agent: every run invalidates itself when per-organ write-error, render-size, or salted-canary-echo floors are breached (four of the first eight architecture runs were invalidated, each localizing a real defect); and a render-invisible shadow reference compiles the plan the full system would have committed in every ablation cell, so drift metrics are defined even where the mechanism under test has been removed. Using this instrument we report a clean, single-variable result on a failure every long-horizon agent suffers: ablating the commitment mechanism flips goal-abandonment from 0.00 to 1.00 while binding error stays flat at 0.00 (three seeds per cell, up to 394 reference beats per run, every run gated valid). The binding channel, by contrast, does not reappear as per-beat drift when its repair is ablated -- because binding is code-owned, the failure class is structurally absorbed, its only residue appearing one layer upstream as a collapse in hypothesis formation. We report these under full disclosure that task efficacy is null (zero level completions across 52 gated runs on ARC-AGI-3), pre-registered as a structural defeater. The contribution is a verification methodology for agent development and the drift decomposition it makes measurable.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"自验证代理架构",通过确定性执行器(Executive)与LLM提议分离的结构性验证机制,将长期目标漂解解耦为两种机制独立的失效(承诺漂移 vs 绑定漂移),并以ARC-AGI-3上52次零完成门控运行的负面结果为前置注册的结构性反证(disconfirming case)。
AI.motivation: 长程LLM代理普遍存在"目标漂移"(goal drift),但现有验证方法存在两个根本弱点:(1)信任代理自身的状态与自报,"完成"被以LLM发言而非事件为凭证;(2)漂移以聚合分数呈现,无法识别具体失效类别或判断运行是否有效归因。论文将"谁来验证代理"作为设计前提,通过结构而非后置检查作答。
AI.method: 核心架构为"LLM提议、执行器裁断"(LLM proposes, Executive disposes):(1)三个模型器官(Observer/Surveyor/Actuator)只能通过封闭词汇表提交类型化提案,所有状态变迁由确定性执行器(差分器、匹配器、验证器、编译器、渲染器、测试评估器)持有,存储仅追加、状态可重放;(2)信念由验证获得——指称(referent)需经过"预登记预测→动作→执行器对观测差异匹配"的多层晋级;(3)两类可独立关闭的修复开关:J(绑定修复,将目标↔指称联接外部化为固定位置结构)与A(承诺修复,将外部承诺存储由代码执行);(4)运行自验证机制:每个器官写入错误率>0.25、渲染尺寸越限、canary回显低于下限均触发运行失效(前8次架构运行中4次因此被废);(5)"影子引用"(shadow reference)在每个消变单元内编译完整系统本应承诺的计划,定义漂移度量;(6)操作漂移分类法按每个引用节拍标记bind/aligned/abandon。
AI.result: ARC-AGI-3上52次运行、约1700万tokens、200-400动作时域、3种子/单元:承诺开关关闭时目标放弃率从0.00跃至1.00(多达394影子编译引用节拍/次),绑定错误持平于0.00(FULL与J0均保持放弃率0.00);绑定开关关闭不产生逐节拍漂移(代码持有的绑定失败被结构性吸收),但在上游以假设形成率体现(FULL=J0 3/3>A0 2/3>J0A0 0/4)。Haiku级小模型可在错误率0.0下完整跑通闭环。引擎在3/3零游戏专属代码的未见游戏中启动课程生成。任务效能为零——所有52次门控运行在ARC-AGI-3上零关卡完成,该零结果被前置注册为效能主张的结构性反证而非附注,且不影响机制层面发现。
AI.conclusion: "目标漂移"不是单一失效,至少存在承诺漂移(意图在后段上下文中缺席,修复为外部承诺存储)与绑定漂移(意图与指称联合仅存于注意力内,修复为位置性)两种机械性独立的失效,具有不同签名与不同修复;在自验证的仪器下二者解耦且可独立测量。绑定一旦由代码持有,失败类别即被结构性吸收,不再以逐节拍漂移显现,而仅在上游假设形成层面留下痕迹。论文以任务零效能为前置披露的负面结果,但论证漂解分解作为贡献不依赖效能成立。验证"正在发生哪种漂移"是修复任一类别的前置条件,且该性质需被内置于代理架构,而非事后追加。

title: Monte Carlo Tree Search for Table-to-Multimodal Report Generation
summary: Automatically generating professional multimodal reports comprising both textual analysis and visual charts from structured tabular data is a critical challenge in data intelligence. Existing methods suffer from fixed linear pipelines and isolated subtask processing, which hinder joint optimization of factual accuracy, visual quality, and narrative coherence. To address these issues, this paper proposes MCTS-Report, a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-driven framework that formulates multimodal table-to-report generation as a progressive construction process over a structured search space. The core idea is to decompose report generation into atomic actions, including chapter planning, visualization task identification, chart generation, insight organization, and narrative refinement, each executed by an LLM based on dynamic reasoning conditioned on the current report state. We use an LLM to generate step-by-step reasoning and actions during MCTS, storing the reasoning trajectory in each node for context-aware, coherent report construction. To guide the search, we design a multi-dimensional reward function that jointly evaluates numerical fact consistency (via SQL), chart quality, chart-text alignment, and structural completeness, while incorporating a diversity penalty to suppress repeated charts and a precondition check to prune invalid actions. We also construct MMRBench, a comprehensive benchmark comprising real-world tables from six domains, paired with expert-refined reference report structures and verifiable key insights. Experiments on MMRBench demonstrate that MCTS-Report significantly outperforms strong baselines across structural completeness, numerical accuracy, chart-text alignment, and insight novelty, achieving a 77.9 overall score.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MCTS-Report框架，将多模态表格报告生成建模为蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）过程，通过分解为原子动作（章节规划、可视化识别、图表生成、洞察组织、叙事优化）并利用多维自监督奖励（事实准确性、结构完整性、视觉质量、洞察新颖性）指导搜索，联合优化事实准确性、视觉质量和叙事连贯性。同时构建了包含185张跨六个领域表格的MMRBench基准。
AI.motivation: 现有表格到多模态报告生成方法存在两大根本局限：（1）固定线性流水线（表格解析→图表生成→文本撰写→润色），无法回溯或全局优化，导致"洞察冻结"；（2）子任务孤立处理，事实准确性与视觉美观难以联合优化。此外，现有基准要么仅限纯文本输出，要么缺乏可验证的多维度评估，LLM-as-a-judge范式易受奖励攻击。
AI.method: 1. 将报告生成构建为树形结构化搜索问题：根节点为空报告，叶节点为完整报告，边为构造动作（共10种：章节规划、可视化任务识别、图表生成、图表修改、洞察组织、章节摘要、标题优化、叙事流优化、过渡设计、终止）；2. 使用动作转换约束矩阵（Table 2）限制非法路径；3. MCTS四阶段——选择（UCT公式，c=1.414，宽度优先探索优先）、扩展（每个动作采样k=3次，温度0.8）、模拟（低温度0.3、短提示的快速rollout至终止动作）、反向传播；4. 多维自监督奖励r = r_fact（SQL验证数值声明，1%容差）+ r_struct（结构完整性）+ r_vis（图表技术正确性与数据保真度，OCR+解析对比）+ r_novel（与模板库的余弦相似度<0.7为新颖）；5. 单个LLM作为统一的"动作-评估"引擎，通过不同提示策略实现所有能力；6. 每个查询执行N_rollout=10次独立rollout。
AI.result: 在MMRBench上，MCTS-Report以DeepSeek-R1为底座取得77.9总分（结构完整性88.6、数值准确性73.1、图文对齐88.7、新颖性61.3），超过最强基线DeepSeek-R1（62.7）15.2分，图文对齐接近人类水平（89.5），但新颖性仍有显著差距（人类88.5）。消融实验表明：去除MCTS搜索下降13.4分（数值-13.7、新颖性-23.8），去除自监督奖励下降10.6分，rollout从5增至10带来7.5分提升。错误分析显示：平凡/改写型洞察占31.0%仍是最主要错误，数值幻觉降至24.6%（基线38.5%），多表混淆占9.8%。
AI.conclusion: MCTS搜索规划与自监督奖励引导对联合优化事实准确性、视觉质量和叙事连贯性至关重要，MCTS-Report在MMRBench上显著优于12个基线。未来工作将聚焦高效搜索策略、更细粒度奖励模型、检索增强或好奇心驱动提升新颖性、交互式报告生成，以及扩展基准至更多领域。

title: FinProBench: Evaluating Financial AI Agents with Role-Grounded Rubrics Derived from Professional Deliverables
summary: Evaluating financial AI agents requires criteria aligned with real professional work. Existing rubric methods typically derive criteria from task prompts or model outputs, overlooking tacit standards visible only in practitioner deliverables. We introduce FinProBench, a benchmark for professional financial tasks, and Role-Grounded Rubric Construction (RGRC), a reusable pipeline that derives rubrics from deliverables produced by practitioners in the same role. RGRC comprises four stages: Deliverable Collection, Competency Extraction, Rubric Synthesis, and Validation. Its rubrics capture tacit standards, distinguish quality levels, and transfer across tasks within a role. Before analysis, we classified 57 occupations by deliverable genre into 30 prior-rich conventional roles and 27 prior-sparse role-specialized roles. Across all roles, Prompt-only nearly matches RGRC for conventional roles (89.2% vs. 90.7%), but RGRC substantially outperforms it for role-specialized roles (99.1% vs. 78.0%). This split indicates that prompt engineering can approximate rubrics when conventions are well represented in model priors, while professional grounding is essential for standards beyond those priors. FinProBench is built from 1,723 curated deliverables spanning 57 occupations, 8 financial sub-industries, and 161 deliverable types, and releases an initial evaluation set of 20 complete tasks covering 20 roles in 7 sub-industries. With heterogeneous LLM judges and role-level rubrics, human deliverables rank first on average (73.7 vs. 70.3, 70.2, and 69.6 out of 100), while all four systems show overlapping 95% confidence intervals and complementary strengths. Reusing rubrics at the role level reduces estimated per-task construction effort by 6.7 times relative to authoring each rubric from scratch.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FinProBench 基准与 Role-Grounded Rubric Construction (RGRC) 流水线，通过从真实金融从业者交付物（而非任务提示或模型输出）中提炼评价标准，构建可跨任务复用的角色级评分量表。该方法在传统角色上与仅用提示词的方法接近（90.7% vs 89.2%），但在角色专业化领域显著领先（99.1% vs 78.0%），并使单任务构建工作量降低约 6.7 倍。
AI.motivation: 当前金融 AI 评测基准存在三大缺口：（1）现有基准多停留在抽取式问答或事实性回答层面，未能评估 AI 生成完整专业交付物（如研报、估值模型、合规分析）的能力；（2）评分量表（rubric）构建方法（直接生成、对比提取、迭代优化）均依赖任务提示或模型输出，遗漏了仅存在于真实从业者交付物中的隐式专业标准（tacit standards）；（3）缺乏可在角色级别复用的评分框架，导致每个任务都需独立撰写量表，工程开销巨大。GDPval 等工作虽有任务级专家量表，但无证据驱动衍生机制与角色级复用能力。
AI.method: RGRC 包含四阶段流水线：（1）**交付物收集（Deliverable Collection）**：按真实性准则从权威公开来源为每个角色收集 ≥20 份真实交付物，采用三级来源优先级（直接/邻近/推断）；（2）**能力提取（Competency Extraction）**：先逐文档分析结构、分析深度、专业惯例与质量差异因素，再跨文档聚类，要求能力至少在 60% 文档中出现，区分通用能力、角色专有能力与隐式标准；（3）**量表合成（Rubric Synthesis）**：遵循可评性、无歧义性、不可博弈性、正交性四项设计原则，权重集合 {1,2,3,5}，复杂度自适应准则数 ≈10·difficulty+ε；（4）**验证（Validation）**：三道门控——自动化质量保证、判别力复审、跨评判者一致性（Cohen's κ ≥ 0.75）。核心创新在于**两层量表结构**：角色级规范层（一次性提取，跨任务复用，约 60-70% 准则可继承）+ 任务特定层。
AI.result: （1）基准规模：1,723 份精选交付物，覆盖 57 个职业、8 个金融子行业、161 种交付物类型；初始评测集 20 个完整任务，跨 20 个角色、7 个子行业。（2）覆盖实验：57 个职业按交付物体裁预分类为 30 个先验充足的常规角色与 27 个先验稀薄的角色专精角色；Prompt@78 在常规组达 89.2%，RGRC 达 90.7%（差距 1.5 点）；在角色专精组 Prompt@78 仅 78.0%，RGRC 达 99.1%（差距 21.2 点），呈现显著的制度分异。（3）人类—智能体对比（黄金留出角色级量表下）：人类交付物平均 73.7 分居首，Codex 70.3、Qoder 70.2、Claude Code 69.6；任务胜场分布为人类 8、Claude Code 7、Codex 3、Qoder 2；四者 95% 置信区间重叠。（4）维度互补：人类在结构完整性、数据准确性、合规、呈现上领先；Qoder 在分析深度与风险披露上领先；Claude Code 分析深度强但方差大。（5）评判者可靠性：Fleiss' κ=0.76，原一致性 89.5%；自偏好检验未发现实质性同源偏见。（6）工程效率：角色级复用使单任务构建时间从 ~4 小时降至 ~35 分钟，约 6.7 倍提升。
AI.conclusion: RGRC 范式的核心价值不在于普遍优于提示工程，而在于恢复超出通用模型先验的隐式、角色特定专业标准。常规角色上提示工程即可逼近评分量表，但角色专精领域必须依赖真实从业者交付物进行专业锚定。FinProBench 证明该方法论是司法管辖区无关的（jurisdiction-agnostic），跨语言、监管制度与机构的扩展只需新的角色对齐证据语料，而非新的量表构建方法。人类交付物在完整工作产物维度上整体领先，但各智能体在不同维度展现互补优势，无单一系统在所有维度占优——这一发现支持"完整工作产品质量不能被简化为单一排行榜数值"的评估理念。局限在于验证依赖异构 LLM 评判组而缺乏独立从业者标注，且公开交付物语料可能过度代表外部文档化程度高的角色。

title: FinPerMA: A Theory-Informed, Event-Grounded Personalized-Memory Benchmark for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used as personalized assistants in high-stakes domains such as financial advising, yet it remains unclear whether they can maintain and update an individualized user model over long horizons. Existing personalized-memory benchmarks primarily test factual retention or rely on weakly constrained model-generated trajectories, leaving event-driven preference adaptation underexplored. We introduce FinPerMA, an event-grounded benchmark that evaluates personalized memory against frozen longitudinal investor trajectories. Its generation pipeline combines deterministic, theory-informed impact rules, controlled LLM narration, and automated quality screening; a Post-Shock checkpoint isolates whether an agent has integrated a material event into its persistent user model. On 2,994 questions from 276 personas, seven frontier LLMs and up to seven memory configurations remain far from saturated: no full-context configuration exceeds approximately 0.47 overall accuracy or approximately 39% on multiple-choice questions. Attribution analysis shows that summary-based memory often preserves factual details while losing the preference signals needed for personalization; simple retrieval can therefore outperform purpose-built memory systems, with the gap widening after shocks.

AI.tldr: FinPerMA 是一个面向金融咨询场景的、基于事件驱动的个性化记忆基准，用于评估 LLM 智能体在长时程跨会话中维持并更新用户模型的能力。它包含 276 个人物画像、97 个真实事件、2994 道题目，并通过 Post-Shock 检查点隔离事件后的状态更新能力。实验表明前沿 LLM 和现有记忆系统在该任务上远未饱和，简单检索常优于专用记忆系统，且差距在冲击事件后扩大。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 智能体被用于金融咨询等高风险个性化场景，其能否在数周至数月的长跨度交互中维持并更新个体用户模型成为关键问题。现有个性化记忆基准多侧重事实性回忆或弱约束模型生成的轨迹，缺乏对"事件驱动偏好演化"的评估，且标签难以审计。因此需要一个既可控制偏好变化、又能在评估时保持标签一致性的基准。
AI.method: 提出 FinPerMA 基准，采用五阶段生成流程：(1) 基于中国散户投资者调查统计分布采样人物画像（含人口统计学、金融特征、大五人格、风险容忍度等，分入四类 BIT 投资者类型）；(2) 构建 2020–2026 年间 97 个真实金融与生活事件的时间线（17 宏观 + 64 行业 + 16 个人）；(3) 三层 Impact Model 生成事件反应——Layer 1 由五个基于行为金融理论的确定性子模块（M1 BIT 分类、M2 事件冲击系数、M3 大五人格乘数、M4 经验聚合、M5 记忆参考锚点）合成 ImpactConstraint，Layer 2 用 LLM 在硬约束下进行受控叙述，Layer 3 自动化校验并重试；(4) 多会话对话合成；(5) 在 3 维度×4 检查点的网格上生成评估问题。核心创新是 Post-Shock 检查点，用于隔离事件后是否已整合进持久用户模型；并采用冻结 v8gold 语料库保证标签一致性。
AI.result: 在 7 个前沿 LLM 与最多 7 种记忆配置的评估中：(1) 加入完整人物历史使总体准确率从 0.18–0.27 提升至 0.41–0.47（1.5–2.4 倍），但仍远未饱和——无任何 full_context 配置超过约 0.47 总体准确率或约 39% 的多选题准确率；(2) 在 Qwen3.7-Max 上，BM25 与 BGE-M3 检索用约 1/10 的 token 数即可恢复约 88% 的 no_memory–full_context 差距，而 Mem0/MemOS/Memobase 等结构化记忆系统仅恢复 54–79%；(3) 归因分析显示基于摘要的记忆保留事实但丢失偏好信号，差距在 Post-Shock 检查点扩大（8.0→13.0 分）；(4) 七种能力雷达与七种认知失败模式（zero-memory default、single-signal over-inference、temporal misalignment 等约占 66%）显示记忆失败源于回忆、整合与时效性三个独立瓶颈；(5) 所有模型在 anti-typical 画像上比典型画像低 4.5–11.2 分，揭示存在类型级刻板印象回退。
AI.conclusion: FinPerMA 将"访问用户历史"与"维护变化中的用户模型"分离，证实了个性化证据的必要性但表明该任务远未解决。结论支持混合式记忆设计——分离稳定属性与可变偏好、为变化加时间戳、并检索支撑这些变化的对话；Post-Shock 检查点与 anti-typical 区分共同使该基准能够区分真正的持久个性化与基于事实回忆或画像猜测的伪个性化。局限在于合成人物与规则化偏好变化、单次种子评估、聚焦个人金融领域，未来工作应扩展更长历史、多轮次运行与其他个性化领域。

title: BrainBench: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Comprehensive EEG Understanding
summary:
Electroencephalography (EEG) analysis extends beyond assigning predefined labels to recordings; it requires workflows connecting natural-language instructions, signal processing, quantitative evidence, and scientific interpretation. We term this capability \emph{comprehensive EEG understanding}. Existing evaluations, however, primarily target isolated decoding tasks or system-specific demonstrations, leaving the competence of large language models (LLMs) insufficiently quantified. We introduce  enchmarkname{}, a unified benchmark for comprehensive, instruction-conditioned EEG understanding. It comprises four subsets---Foundational Analysis, Sleep Assessment, Neurocognitive Assessment, and Physiological Integration---covering 17 datasets, 
umcases{} tasks, and over 
uminstances{} real-data instances. Given an instruction and EEG recordings with optional physiological signals, a system must perform the analysis and produce a scientifically grounded report and, when required, artifacts. Outputs are assessed through numerical, categorical, set, sequence, semantic, and artifact validation. We evaluate 
ummodels{} representative LLMs across more than 100K executions under two paradigms: autonomous code execution with CodeAct and structured agentic analysis with BrainAgent. Results vary substantially across models, subsets, difficulty levels, and execution paradigms, showing that EEG competence depends on the model and its operationalization.  enchmarkname{} provides a reproducible testbed for advancing LLM-based EEG understanding. The code and benchmark will be released soon, with evaluation results continuously updated.

AI.tldr: BrainBench 是首个面向大语言模型的综合性 EEG（脑电图）理解基准测试，包含四个子集（基础分析、睡眠评估、神经认知评估、生理信号整合），覆盖 17 个数据集、172 个任务和超过 4000 个真实数据实例。它在统一的指令条件评估协议下，对 13 个代表性 LLM 在两种执行范式（结构化代理 BrainAgent 与自主代码执行 CodeAct）下进行超过 100K 次执行的全面评估。
AI.motivation: 现有 EEG 评估主要针对孤立的解码任务（如睡眠分期、情绪分类），或将 LLM 评估局限于特定系统的演示，缺乏对 LLM 是否能完成从自然语言指令到科学结论的完整 EEG 分析工作流的系统性量化。该研究将"综合 EEG 理解"定义为连接自然语言指令、信号处理、定量证据和科学解释的工作流能力，旨在填补这一评估空白。
AI.method: 采用三层层次结构（subset-task-instance）：四个子集对应不同的 EEG 分析维度；每个任务定义记录无关的分析目标和评估标准；实例则将任务绑定到具体记录、参数和指令。统一的评估函数 E 对自由形式的分析报告和工件进行评估，通过六种验证单元（数值、类别、集合、序列、语义、工件）进行多维度评估。在黑盒评估协议下，每个实例在隔离容器中执行，分别采用 BrainAgent（结构化多代理工具调用）和 CodeAct（自主代码生成）两种范式，通过相同的输入-输出接口进行公平对比。
AI.result: 评估结果显示：（1）当前 LLM 表现出显著但不完整的 EEG 理解能力；（2）BrainAgent 在 13 个模型中有 10 个在 FA、12 个在 SA 上优于 CodeAct，平均得分 68.78 vs 62.83；（3）任务难度显著影响性能，FA 中 BrainAgent 从 Easy 的 82.6 降至 Hard 的 64.7；（4）结构化代理在数值和工件验证上优势最明显；（5）Claude Opus 5 在 CodeAct 上表现最佳（79.25），Gemini 3.6 Flash 在 BrainAgent 上领先（75.17）；（6）BrainAgent 改善跨实例稳定性，但牺牲 token 效率。
AI.conclusion: BrainBench 将 EEG 评估从预定义的解码目标转向综合的、指令条件的理解能力，为评估 LLM 在异构 EEG 工作流中的能力提供了可复现、可扩展的测试平台。研究发现结构化代理工作流与自主 LLM 编码是互补而非可互换的：前者通过领域导向的执行提高可靠性，后者保留分析灵活性但对模型能力和工作流复杂度更敏感。最佳综合得分仍低于 80，表明实现可靠的 EEG 理解仍有显著提升空间。

title: Adversarially Robust Abductive Fusion of Pre-trained Transformer-based Perception Models
summary: Deploying pre-trained perception models in novel environments degrades their accuracy under distributional shift, and assembling them alone does not recover it: combiners such as majority voting trade recall for precision and are brittle to coordinated failures. Prior metacognitive methods learn logical rules that flag a model's errors, but rely on hand-authored domain-knowledge cues (object-size priors, segmentation masks) that do not transfer to genuinely novel scenes. We show that this metacognitive layer can be learned without any domain knowledge by exploiting vector-space geometry: per-model Label Vector Pools (LVP), built from each model's own training embeddings, yield error-detection rules from the geometry of detections relative to training-determined prototypes, reaching parity with domain-knowledge rules to within $0.002$ every F1 on test set. Because the approach remains neurosymbolic, these geometric rules share a single logical framework and can still be complemented by domain knowledge when available. We frame the fusion of multiple imperfect ViT-based detectors as a consistency-based abduction problem solved at test time by an exact Integer Program (IP) and a polynomial-time heuristic. On an aerial-imagery benchmark of 15 weather-shifted test sets and six ViT detectors, our domain-knowledge-free layer matches the strongest majority-vote variant on clean data (within $0.005$ F1) and, unlike every majority-vote baseline, retains its performance under a coordinated label-flipping attack: at a $90\%$ flip rate it averages $0.42$ F1 versus $0.35$ for MV-Plurality (a $22\%$ relative gain) and attains the highest F1 on \emph{every} test set once the flip rate exceeds $0.4$

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需领域知识的元认知层（基于每模型的Label Vector Pool）和基于一致性归纳(abduction)的融合框架，用于在分布偏移和协同对抗攻击下鲁棒地融合多个预训练ViT检测器。在15个天气偏移测试集和6个ViT检测器上，干净数据下与最强多数投票基线持平（差距<0.005 F1），而在90%协同标签翻转攻击下F1达0.42 vs MV-Plurality的0.35（相对提升22%），且当翻转率>0.4时在每个测试集上均取得最高F1。
AI.motivation: 预训练感知模型在新颖环境下因分布偏移而性能下降。多数投票等组合方法以召回率换取精度，且对协同故障脆弱。先前的元认知方法依赖手工编写的领域知识线索（如目标尺寸先验、分割掩码），这些无法迁移到真正新颖的环境。此外，之前的工作未考虑感知模型可能遭受对抗扰动的情况。需要在无领域知识前提下学习元认知层，并使融合器对协调攻击具有鲁棒性。
AI.method: 两大贡献：(1) 无领域知识的元认知层——为每个模型从其自身训练嵌入构建每类原型池（Label Vector Pool, k=3的k-means），用每(模型,类)随机森林学习到各原型的距离→错误概率，作为唯一条件生成错误检测规则；(2) 基于一致性归纳的融合——将多模型融合建模为一致性归纳问题：在不一致性预算δ约束下最大化覆盖率的假设选择，通过精确整数规划(IP)和多项式时间启发式搜索(HS)求解，可选置信度平局打破(TB)。实验在MDS-A数据集（6种天气ViT检测器，15个混合天气测试集）和DroneVehicle多模态数据集上进行，评估在干净数据和协同标签翻转攻击（翻转率0~0.9）下的F1。
AI.result: 干净数据：IP+TB/HS+TB与最强MV基线MV-Plurality持平（差距<0.005 F1，15个测试集平均0.64 vs 0.64）。LVP规则与领域知识(DK)规则下游F1差距<0.002，且两者识别不同错误源。对抗攻击：从p≥0.4起IP+TB在每个测试集上均领先；p=0.9时平均F1=0.42 vs MV-P的0.35（+22%相对），且MV-P丢失0.10-0.15 F1而IP+TB几乎不变。多模态测试：干净数据与MV-P持平（0.672），但p≥0.1时IP+TB和HS+TB优于所有基线，p=0.9时达0.395/0.410 vs MV-P的0.376。运行时：HS+TB每对象1.4-3.0ms（多项式），IP+TB慢约30倍但绝对值仍实用。结合LVP和DK规则未能提升F1（过度严格过滤）。
AI.conclusion: 证明了多模型感知系统的元认知层可在无领域知识下学习（仅用每模型的Label Vector Pool），且将模型集成建模为一致性归纳可产生在干净数据上具竞争力、对协同对抗攻击鲁棒的融合器。一致性驱动的接受机制远优于基于计数投票的组合。LVP与DK规则互补但当前融合方式过度严格，未来方向包括结合两者的更复杂规则、FP自动检测、联合优化ε与δ及实时部署优化。

title: MatrAIx: Simulating the World with 8.3 Billion Persona Agents
summary: Human evaluation of AI systems and digital products is costly, slow, and difficult to scale. Offline evaluations are more scalable but often abstract away human diversity and interactive behavior. We therefore introduce MatrAIx, a population-scale simulated-user evaluation infrastructure for testing AI systems and digital products with heterogeneous users. MatrAIx has three core components: First, Persona 8B contains 8.3 billion persona records represented by 1,290 categorical dimensions. Records are either sampled from a dependency graph that preserves correlated attributes or derived from human-authored profiles. We release a quality-filtered coreset of approximately 1 million personas, comprising 599,847 human-grounded and 400,000 synthetic records. Second, the MatrAIx Playground provides four environments in which diverse users evaluate and interact with digital products: Survey, AI Chatbot, Web, and App. Third, MatrAIx provides 1,010 application tasks spanning more than 25 domains, including Commerce, Software, Finance, and Healthcare. We conducted 18,189 evaluation trials across eight representative tasks. Persona agents were powered by three LLMs: Claude Opus 4.8, GPT 5.5, and Claude Haiku 4.5. The resulting feedback captures how decisions and preferences vary across persona backgrounds, including hesitation after a price increase, willingness to continue after an AI assistant fails, and latency tolerance. We conducted two main validation studies: First, a 400-trial controlled study evaluated persona adherence across ten behavioral attributes and all four environments. The declared behavior was expressed or correctly suppressed in 366 trials (91.5%). Second, human and LLM judges evaluated the extraction quality of human-grounded personas. Overall, MatrAIx provides an end-to-end infrastructure for evaluating AI systems and digital products with diverse simulated human users.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 MatrAIx，一个用于评估 AI 系统和数字产品的大规模模拟用户评估基础设施。其核心组件包括：包含 83 亿条人物档案记录的 Persona 8B 数据集（基于 1290 个分类维度）、支持四种环境的 MatrAIx Playground（调查、AI 聊天机器人、网页和应用），以及涵盖 25+ 领域的 1010 个应用任务。通过 18189 次评估试验验证，在受控行为依从性研究中达到 91.5% 的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有的人类评估成本高、速度慢、难以扩展，而离线评估虽可扩展但往往忽略人类多样性和交互行为。因此需要一种既能扩展又能保留用户多样性的评估方法，以弥合离线基准测试与在线评估之间的差距。
AI.method: MatrAIx 采用三种核心方法：(1) Persona 8B 数据集，结合基于有向无环图（DAG）采样的合成人物档案（保留跨属性相关性）与来自维基百科、亚马逊评论、Stack Overflow 调查、GSS、PRISM 和志愿者调查的真人数据；(2) 四种评估环境（Survey、AI Chatbot、Web、App）支持不同交互模式；(3) 版本化的任务规范库，包含评估目标、人群队列、场景、结果指标和验证器。三种 LLM 模型（Claude Opus 4.8、GPT 5.5、Claude Haiku 4.5）作为人物代理执行评估。
AI.result: 在 18,189 次评估试验中：(1) 受控行为依从性研究在 400 次试验中达到 91.5% 的成功率（366/400），10 项行为属性在四种环境中进行了测试；(2) 提取质量研究中，6 名人类评分员在 100 条子集上给出 4.135/5 的平均分，Claude Opus 4.8 在 93.8% 的比较中与人类评分相差在一分以内；(3) 八个代表性任务展示了在不同人群中检测到的差异，例如 OpenBB 任务中信任等级在所有三个模型下都能分离子群（Cramér's V = 0.228–0.363）。
AI.conclusion: MatrAIx 提供了一套端到端的基础设施，用于使用多样化模拟用户评估 AI 系统和数字产品。其优势在于：(1) 集成了合成数据生成与人类基础数据；(2) 支持多种交互环境；(3) 提供任务级与子群体级报告。关键发现是：人物代理模型是评估结果的第一阶因素而非实现细节——同一产品在三个模型上的付费计划份额跨度可达 23.2% 到 93.9%。因此，建议重要结论应在多个模型下交叉验证，人类研究仍然是面向真实人群的决策的标准依据。

title: Interoceptive Attention as Dynamic Homeostatic Prioritization in a Foraging Agent
comment: Accepted at SAB 2026 (From Animals to Animats 18), forthcoming in the Springer Lecture Notes in Artificial Intelligence proceedings. 20 pages, 11 numbered figures (12 graphics), 5 tables. The 12-page camera-ready paper is reproduced without alteration and followed by supplementary analyses that were not part of the proceedings paper. Code: this https URL
summary: Biological systems must regulate competing needs under limited perceptual bandwidth, where sharpening one estimate costs the capacity to sharpen the others. Any fixed-budget system therefore has to decide where to allocate its perceptual precision. We study this in a foraging agent that must keep several bodily needs satisfied to survive, modelled with active inference. At each step it reads its own body-state beliefs, identifies the most-needed channel, and reallocates a fixed budget of interoceptive precision toward it, so that the same precision-shaped likelihood feeds both belief update and planning. In AffectWorld, a four-channel foraging gridworld, this selective allocation more than doubles learning-phase survival at matched budget against a uniform-precision agent ($0.414$ vs $0.199$ across 11 layouts, $n{=}32$ seeds each, paired cluster-bootstrap $p \leq 10^{-4}$). Two further results sharpen the mechanism. The benefit runs through planning as well as perception, since denying the shaped likelihood to the planner alone removes about half of it. It is also need-aligned, since aiming precision at the least-needed channel does worse than spreading it evenly. The attended channel additionally learns its own dynamics about twice as fast, and stays ahead even at matched observation count, a behavioural trace of the same precision routing, visible in learning speed, not survival.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于主动推理(active inference)的觅食智能体模型，研究有限感知精度预算如何在多个内感受(interoceptive)需求通道间动态分配。核心发现：在固定精度预算下，将感知精度集中分配到当前最紧迫需求通道，可使学习期存活率翻倍(0.414 vs 0.199)，且该增益主要通过规划阶段而非仅感知阶段实现。
AI.motivation: 生物系统面临多需求并存(如饥饿、口渴、呼吸)与有限感知带宽的矛盾。在选择行为之前，生物体必须先决定信任哪些内感受信号——精确感知一个信号意味着削弱对其他信号的感知能力。这一"感知精度分配的优先化机制"在以往研究中常被忽视，现有主动推理工作要么处理单一外感受通道的注意力，要么将精度控制作为分层模型中的动作，而非在多个内感受需求间动态分配固定预算。本文旨在填补这一空白：在固定精度预算约束下，智能体能否通过动态路由精度到当前最紧迫需求来提升生存与学习效率。
AI.method: 采用基于主动推理的POMDP智能体，在自定义环境AffectWorld(6×6网格世界，4个内感受通道：饥饿、口渴、窒息、非活性对照)中进行测试。固定精度预算K=2.60分配于4通道。关键机制(κ-attention)：每步从智能体自身身体状态后验中选取最紧迫通道m*，将精度预算重分配——给予被选通道κ_att=0.90，其余通道κ_un≈0.567；均匀分配基线则各通道κ=0.65。精度塑形的似然A^(m)同时驱动信念更新与EFE规划。规划视界H=3，采用预期自由能(EFE)选择策略。实验包含三个核心智能体(均匀/注意/反向对齐)及消融变体(仅推理路径、仅规划路径)，在11种布局×32种子×100试次下评估学习期存活率。
AI.result: (1) 选择性分配使学习期存活率从0.199提升至0.414(约2.08倍)，配对集群自助法p≤10⁻⁴；(2) 反向对齐控制(将精度分配给最不需要的通道)存活率仅0.144，显著低于均匀分配，证明方向而非不均匀性本身是获益来源；(3) 传播分析显示规划阶段贡献约一半增益；在刚性先验(α₀≥10)下，仅推理路径消融完全崩溃(从0.905降至0.023)，表明刚性先验下规划路径占主导；(4) 被注意通道的模型学习速度约为均匀智能体的2.4倍，且在匹配观测数量下仍保持优势(每观测精度差约0.31)；(5) 优势在精度预算K∈{1.5,…,4.0}、先验刚性、食物-毒药非平稳性等多个参数扫描下保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: 选择性内感受精度(由智能体自身身体状态信念驱动)足以实现对竞争性需求的优先级排序，无需依赖外部设计的奖励信号。这一结果将"注意力即精度"的主动推理范式与稳态控制相结合，并通过证明塑形似然必须进入EFE规划阶段才能发挥主要作用，扩展了既有注意力模型。理论上确认了内感受精度分配作为生物系统中一种可行的优先化机制，并提出可验证的假说：内感受处理的增益调制与身体紧迫性耦合，且该机制在学习不熟悉环境时最为关键。局限包括：精度路由为手工指定、依赖身体状态后验的校准、环境为离散网格世界简化模型。

title: The RAIL Principles for Neurosymbolic AI: Reasoning, Assurances, Interfacing and Learning
summary: Neurosymbolic AI systems that integrate machine learning and symbolic reasoning are rapidly gaining attention. They complement the data-intensive statistical approaches of neural networks and language models with symbolic reasoning algorithms to function in high-stakes domains or in low-data regimes that characterize many real-world applications. We argue that the neurosymbolic combination of machine learning and formal reasoning is not a niche approach within AI, but rather includes many already successful techniques that are of crucial importance to the development of reliable, efficient and, ultimately, trustworthy systems. This perspective prompts a re-examination of the design of current AI systems. We show that many leading AI systems, including some that are not traditionally considered as neurosymbolic, can be analysed from the perspective of four principles of neurosymbolic AI design: Reasoning, Assurances, Interfacing and Learning (RAIL). Applying the RAIL framework offers a unified view of seemingly disparate AI systems, ranging from physics-aware machine learning to neuro-guided search (such as Google DeepMind's Alpha-* suite), causal learning and tool-augmented Large Language Models. Importantly, the RAIL principles will enable engineers to make better-informed and more principled decisions about the design and deployment of production-level AI systems. In this article, we introduce the RAIL principles, examine how they can be applied across major areas of AI, and illustrate how they may guide practitioners to integrate neurosymbolic methods into next-generation AI technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了神经符号AI的RAIL四原则框架（推理Reasoning、保证Assurances、接口Interfacing、学习Learning），将多种看似不同的AI系统（包括Alpha系列、知识图谱嵌入、工具增强大语言模型、因果学习、物理感知机器学习等）统一映射到一个四维设计空间中，揭示其内在的权衡与协同关系，为构建可靠、可解释、可组合的工业级AI系统提供统一设计蓝图。
AI.motivation: 当前工业AI系统通常由独立设计、单独优化的任务特定模块拼接而成，缺乏对整体行为的正式保证，导致误差传播、模块接口不连续、生成模型推理难以解释等问题；大语言模型的幻觉问题长期未解。作者认为神经符号AI并非小众方法，而是构建可靠、高效、可信赖系统的关键途径，亟需一个统一框架来分析和指导下一代AI系统的设计与部署。
AI.method: 提出RAIL四维框架，每一维度均设计为一个定性谱系（spectrum）：(1) 推理维度——从隐式相似性推理到显式形式推理（含DeepProbLog、Logic Tensor Networks等中间形式，以及LLM调用符号解释器的程序合成方式）；(2) 保证维度——从无要求的纯训练到按设计验证（涵盖软/硬约束、模糊逻辑松弛、shield layers、训练后验证）；(3) 接口维度——从神经网络潜表征到纯符号表征（中间含注意力模式、因果图、结构化符号等形式）；(4) 学习维度——从无学习（纯符号）到数据驱动、到知识引导、到双向学习、再到持续神经符号学习。然后将框架应用于五大AI领域（知识发现、神经引导搜索如Alpha*系列、LLM工具使用、因果学习与推理、物理感知机器学习）及工业神经符号架构，逐一定位其RAIL坐标并以雷达图（radar plot）可视化对比。
AI.result: (1) 证明大量前沿AI系统可被重新诠释为神经符号系统，无意中遵循RAIL原则；(2) 识别出关键权衡关系：推理-保证权衡（更强的形式保证需要更显式的推理组件，如AlphaGo→AlphaProof的演进）；接口不对称性（用户→系统接口强，系统→用户解释接口弱）；知识引导学习在多数Alpha系统中占主导；(3) 知识发现中嵌入方法偏学习、规则学习方法偏保证与接口；因果建模在三个推理层级（关联/干预/反事实）上提供强保证；物理感知机器学习通过架构注入对称性与守恒律实现"按设计保证"；(4) 指出工业AI架构本质上是隐式神经符号的，但采用临时性、分散的集成方式，限制了其形式化保证能力。
AI.conclusion: RAIL原则为神经符号AI提供了一个四维设计空间，揭示了维度间的相互依赖与可行架构约束；该框架可指导新设计机会的发掘及未来AI研究与工业部署。然而当前仅为定性分析，转化为实用工具尚需可操作的标准、形式化定义与具体度量指标，作者呼吁社区共同推进这一方向。

title: SafeCommit: Certifying When Memory-Grounded Agents May Safely Act
comment: 14 pages, 6 tables, and 1 figure, target NeurIPS
summary: Long-horizon agents increasingly use persistent memory and tools to take actions with external side effects. A central failure mode is premature commitment: an agent acts before resolving whether its memory grounding is stale, conflicting, incomplete, or corrupted. We formalize this problem as safe commitment under memory uncertainty and introduce SafeCommit, a risk controlled layer between agent reasoning and external execution. The layer constructs a calibrated set of plausible latent worlds from memory, observations, tool outputs, provenance, and policy constraints. It permits a side effectful action only when a conformal action certificate shows that the action is safe in every retained world. Otherwise, it selects a low-side-effect probe that targets the worlds blocking certification, or returns a conservative fallback. Under calibrated world coverage, the probability of an unsafe certified commit is at most the target level {\alpha}; with imperfect world proposal, the bound separates calibration and representation error. A dependency-free controlled simulator illustrates the safety-utility tradeoff and reproduces all reported results with one command. The goal is to offer a concrete approach for deciding not only what an agent should do, but when the available evidence is sufficient to safely do it.

AI.tldr: SafeCommit 是一个面向记忆型 LLM 智能体的风险控制决策层，通过保形预测（conformal prediction）在潜在世界集合上对候选动作发放"动作证书"，仅当动作在所有保留世界中均安全时才允许执行；否则选择低副作用探查以缩减阻止认证的世界，或返回保守回退。在理论上保证未经校准的"不安全提交"概率不超过目标水平 α，并将校准误差与表征误差（世界提案遗漏）显式分离。
AI.motivation: 长时程 LLM 智能体依赖持久记忆与工具调用产生外部副作用，但其记忆可能过时、冲突、不完整或被投毒，存在"过早提交"（premature commitment）失败模式——智能体在尚未解决记忆的不确定性时就采取了行动。现有防御机制（澄清提问、基于标量置信度的弃答、访问控制、副作用中介）各自只覆盖相邻问题，无法回答一个统一问题：在当前证据下，所提动作在所有仍合理的解读中是否都安全？因此需要一种在"做什么"与"是否证据充分可做"之间给出显式决策规则的方法。
AI.method: 将 SafeCommit 作为记忆/推理循环与外部执行之间的风险控制层，核心包括：(1) 构造器 C_α 基于记忆、观测、工具输出、来源与策略构造有限支持集合，并以保形非一致性分数阈值 κ_α 过滤得到校准后的合理世界集 W_t，满足 P(ω*∈W_t)≥1−α；(2) 动作证书：定义每世界下安全动作集 Γ_t(ω)，动作 a 仅当其在 W_t 中所有世界均安全（即未认证域 U_t(a)=∅）时获得 α-认证；(3) 安全性等价压缩：以动作签名合并安全判定相同的世界，压缩后认证集严格不变；(4) 证书导向的探查：当无动作认证时，选择能最大化缩减未认证域质量且成本最低的低副作用探查（度量读、权限检查、阶段化 diff、模拟等）；(5) 回退机制在预算耗尽或探查价值低于阈值时触发 defer/escalate/abstain。理论上证明在保留集覆盖条件下 P(unsafe commit)≤α；当世界提案可能遗漏真值世界时（概率 β），得到 P(unsafe commit)≤α+β，把校准误差与表征误差显式分离。
AI.result: 在自包含的受控基准 SafeCommitBench-Controlled（含过时、冲突、被投毒、授权漂移四类记忆不确定性族，每族每 seed 4000 episodes，α=0.05，最多两次探查，10 个随机种子）上：单世界基线不安全提交率（UCR）为 41.2%、任务成功率 58.8%；无探查的 SafeCommit 把 UCR 降至 2.5% 但任务成功率仅 44.7%；完整 SafeCommit 达到 UCR 2.6% 与任务成功率 97.4%，平均 0.55 次探查/回合。分族结果：UCR 在 1.2%–3.9% 之间，任务成功率不低于 96.1%。探查预算消融显示 1 次定向探查即可将任务成功率从 44.7% 提升至 95.1% 且 UCR 几乎不增加。风险水平扫描：α∈{0.01,0.05,0.10} 下 UCR 分别为 0.6%/2.6%/4.8%，均低于目标水平。表征误差实验：随着真实世界被从提案支持中以 β 概率剔除，观测 UCR 升至 10.1%（β≈10.1%）但仍低于松散界 α+β=15.1%，验证了误差分解。
AI.conclusion: SafeCommit 将外部动作视为带显式风险解释的"释放决策"，把"看起来合理"与"可被认证地安全"区分开来，并以可重现的受控实现验证了机制有效性；框架模块化，可与记忆系统、访问控制、阶段化/沙箱执行协同。其保证强度依赖于世界覆盖率和领域安全图的正确性，应作为补充而非替代授权、沙箱与人工监督。受控实验是机制证明而非部署级验证，下一步需在长时程真实工具环境中评估世界构造器与探查库的可用性，并发展处理自适应多次提交的任务级风险分配与时间一致保形方法。

title: NeuMoSync: End-to-End Neuromodulatory Control for Plasticity and Adaptability in Continual Learning
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
summary: Continual learning (CL) requires models to learn tasks sequentially, yet deep neural networks often suffer from plasticity loss and poor knowledge transfer, which can impede their long-term adaptability. Drawing high-level inspiration from global neuromodulatory mechanisms in the brain, we introduce Neuromodulation and Synchronization (NeuMoSync), a novel architecture that integrates dynamic, neuron-specific modulation into deep neural networks to enhance their adaptability and plasticity. NeuMoSync extends standard neural network architectures with learnable feature vectors for each neuron that track network-wide historical context and with a module operating at a higher level of abstraction. This module synthesizes neuron-specific signals, conditioned on both current inputs and the network's evolving state, to adaptively regulate activation dynamics and synaptic plasticity. Evaluated on diverse CL benchmarks, including memorization (Random Label CIFAR-10 and Random Label MNIST), concept drift (Shuffle CIFAR-10 and Shuffle Mini-ImageNet), class-incremental learning (Class Split ImageNet and Class Split CIFAR-100), and domain-incremental learning (Permuted MNIST), NeuMoSync demonstrates strong performance in retaining plasticity and achieves improvements in both forward and backward adaptation compared with existing methods. Ablation studies validate the necessity of each component, while analysis of the learned modulatory signals reveals interpretable coordination patterns across tasks. Our work underscores the potential of integrating global coordination mechanisms into deep learning systems to advance robust, adaptive continual learning. The code is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出NeuMoSync，一种受大脑神经调制机制启发的持续学习架构，通过引入全局NeuroSync控制器动态调制每个神经元的权重、激活函数和偏置，在多个持续学习基准上显著优于现有方法，特别是在保持可塑性和快速前向/后向适应方面表现突出。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络在持续学习中面临两个核心挑战：可塑性丧失（loss of plasticity，即随任务序列增加学习能力下降）和知识迁移效率低下。生物大脑通过全局神经调制系统（如神经调质释放）动态协调局部神经回路的可塑性和兴奋性，使生物体能够在不断变化的环境中保持学习能力而不遗忘已有知识。然而现有ANN主要依赖局部前馈计算和基于梯度的更新，缺乏这种上下文依赖的系统级反馈机制，限制了其在长任务序列中的适应性。
AI.method: NeuMoSync架构包含三个核心组件：(1) MainNetwork（主网络）参数θ，快速适应当前任务；(2) ConsolidatedNetwork（巩固网络）参数ϕ，通过EMA（β=0.999）维护长期记忆；(3) NeuroSync控制器（单层encoder-only Transformer，含参数共享），以当前输入和神经元特征向量为输入，为每个神经元生成四个调制系数α：α_SM（突触调制）、α_WC（权重巩固）、α_AL（自适应线性度，调节PReLU负斜率）和α_ARM（加性调节偏置）。推理时通过w^i = α_SM^i·θ^i + α_WC^i·ϕ^i动态构造InferenceNetwork。整个系统通过标准梯度下降端到端训练。为支持大模型，还提出了稀疏的encoder-decoder控制器变体（仅采样K≪1比例的神经元）。
AI.result: 在六个持续学习基准（Random Label CIFAR-10/MNIST、Shuffle CIFAR-10、Class Split T-ImageNet/CIFAR-100、Permuted MNIST）上，NeuMoSync在平均任务准确率、前向适应（LCA_F）和后向适应（LCA_B）方面均优于CBP、ReDo、CReLU、L2Init+EWC等基线，且仅增加5-8%参数开销。消融实验证明：四个α参数和全局控制器均不可或缺，其中α_AL对保持可塑性贡献最大，α_SM需要全局协调才能发挥作用；关键归纳偏置是参数共享而非注意力机制本身（1D CNN控制器效果相当）。分析表明适应优势主要来自知识迁移（FKT/BKT高）而非内在学习速度（LCA_0较低），且优于MAML和ANML等元学习方法。在ResNet-18/50上仅用0.002%参数即可扩展到大规模架构。与经验回放结合时，NeuMoSync+ER在遗忘和可塑性之间取得良好平衡。理论分析揭示了"对消-转向"机制：α_SM和α_WC反号且合并网络高度相似时，模长变化可引起InferenceNetwork权重大幅方向变化。
AI.conclusion: NeuMoSync验证了将全局神经调制机制集成到深度学习中的可行性，能够在保持可塑性的同时实现快速跨任务适应。核心贡献在于学习了一种可迁移的调制策略（而非任务特定知识），通过全局控制器协调多个互补的调制信号。其优势源于跨任务积累的归纳偏置，而非更快的内在学习算法。未来方向包括更深层次的调制-优化动力学理论分析、稀疏化扩展策略，以及探索其他生物启发的系统级协调机制在持续学习中的应用。

title: Improving Auto-Design of Neural PDE Solvers with a Domain-Specific Language
summary: Neural PDE solver auto-design is fundamentally a search-space representation problem. In the space of unrestricted Python programs, valid solvers form an extremely sparse subset: most candidate programs are syntactically incorrect, semantically incompatible, or numerically unstable. Direct code generation therefore forces an LLM to spend most of its search capacity navigating implementation failures rather than reasoning about solver quality. ADSL-PDE addresses this challenge by introducing a structured search state between solver concepts and executable code. It represents the functional decisions that determine a neural PDE solver (architecture, physical constraints, objectives, sampling, and optimization) while abstracting away low-level implementation details. A deterministic compiler maps each valid search state to an executable solver. In effect, ADSL-PDE reshapes the search space: it removes large regions of invalid programs, increases the density of meaningful candidates, and preserves the compositional freedom needed to discover previously unseen designs. Solver evolution can thus operate over design decisions rather than code artifacts. Built on this representation, our evolutionary agent iteratively proposes, evaluates, and refines solver search states using empirical feedback. Across multiple PDE benchmarks, ADSL-PDE improves both search efficiency and optimization stability, achieving an improvement of more than 52% within the first ten evolution iterations. These results suggest a broader principle for LLM-driven auto-design: effective agents do not merely require stronger reasoning, but rather a search representation that concentrates exploration on valid and consequential decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ADSL-PDE，一种面向神经偏微分方程（PDE）求解器自动设计的领域专用语言（DSL）。其核心思想是在求解器概念与可执行代码之间引入结构化的搜索状态，通过确定性编译器将有效设计映射为可执行求解器，从而重塑搜索空间，消除大量无效程序，使大语言模型驱动的进化搜索聚焦于有意义的求解器级决策。实验表明，该方法在多个 PDE 基准上显著优于人工设计的求解器、传统搜索方法和基于 LLM 的代理方法，在前 10 轮迭代中即实现超过 52% 的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 神经 PDE 求解器的自动设计存在两种主流范式：基于搜索的方法受限于人工预定义的搜索空间，难以覆盖完整设计空间；基于 LLM 代理的方法则在无限制的 Python 代码空间中直接生成代码，其中有效求解器占比极低（绝大多数候选程序存在语法错误、语义不兼容或数值不稳定问题），导致 LLM 大量搜索能力浪费在处理实现失败上，而非推理求解器质量本身。因此，搜索空间的表示方式成为制约神经 PDE 求解器自动设计的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: ADSL-PDE 包含两大耦合组件：（1）语言系统——前端 DSL 显式表示 PDE 任务、求解器族（PINN/FNO/U-NO 等）、网络架构、物理约束、采样策略、训练配方与评估协议等求解器级设计决策；通过解析器生成类型化中间表示（IR），由验证器检查任务、求解器族及后端层面的类型、可行性约束，再由确定性编译器映射为可执行求解器；（2）进化系统——采用"方法孤岛"（method islands）种群结构，每个孤岛对应一个求解器族，通过快速训练筛选、全量训练评估与结构化反馈驱动 LLM 代理迭代修改 DSL 字段，并支持跨孤岛创新以注册新求解器实现。前端采用"受控表达性"设计原则：在屏蔽实现细节自由度（如任意函数定义、外部库导入）的同时，保留求解器级灵活性（架构深度/宽度、激活函数、损失权重、采样密度、优化器与学习率调度等）。
AI.result: 在 12 项 PDE 基准（涵盖 1D/2D/3D/高维的对流-扩散、Burgers、Allen-Cahn、Darcy 流、Navier-Stokes 等方程）上，ADSL-PDE 在所有任务上均优于人工设计的 PINN、DFVM、RFM、FNO、U-NO、MPNN 等基线，几何平均误差降至 1.16E-03（如 1D Burgers 上从 U-NO 的 6.01E-02 降至 2.20E-03）。在 11 项任务上与 BayesianAgent、PINNsAgent、Lang-PINN、PINNacle 等搜索/代理方法对比中取得 8 项最优，几何平均误差最低（1.58E-04）。LLM 后骨干敏感性测试表明 DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Qwen-3.5-Plus、GLM-5.1 均能产生稳定提升（约 41%-52%）。消融实验显示完整系统每 100K token 带来 30.18% 性能提升，有效候选率（VCR）从直接 Python 生成的 0.34 提升至 0.91，搜索效率（SE）从 0.18 提升至 0.83，验证了结构化表示、IR 验证、后端编译的互补作用。此外，ADSL-PDE 作为表示层可与 OpenEvolve、PINNsAgent、OpenAlpha-Evolve 等不同进化后端结合，在 12 项任务-后端组合中改善 10 项。
AI.conclusion: 本文论证了 LLM 驱动的自动设计中，搜索表示的设计与代理推理能力同等重要——有效代理不仅需要更强的推理，更需要一种能将探索集中于有效且关键决策的搜索表示。ADSL-PDE 通过结构化 DSL 在固定搜索空间与无限制代码生成之间提供中间地带，通过静态验证与确定性编译在昂贵训练前过滤无效候选，并通过结构化反馈使代理修改聚焦于求解器级设计而非底层实现错误。其贡献为语言引导的科学求解器演化及更广泛的 LLM 代理设计提供了通用方向。

title: Architectural Implications of Agentic AI Workflows
summary: Agentic AI is emerging in datacenters, but its architectural implications remain unexplored. We organize agentic workflows in a taxonomy and present its first architectural characterization with a production study at Microsoft Azure and a controlled study of open-source frameworks. We show that agentic execution is fragmented and heterogeneous. Requests expand into a workflow of LLM inferences, tool invocations, and orchestration decisions that repeatedly cross the CPU-GPU boundary. Our taxonomy explains how this fragmentation turns into resource demand. As orchestration and tools run on the host, the CPU sits on the critical path. Execution structure sets the load over time, which stays low with sudden spikes. Model composition sets how evenly the workflow uses the GPUs. Diversity in tasks and tools widens this range even further. These characteristics expose architectural mismatches of conventional uniform servers. Fragmented execution strands CPU and GPU capacity despite bursty demand. Different software roles make homogeneous CPU provisioning inefficient. Finally, multiplexing many agents onto shared cores degrades microarchitectural locality. Guided by our findings, we derive implications for agentic servers and examine them through Agora, our prototype for commodity servers. Agora dynamically harvests idle CPU cores for co-located throughput work, while protecting agentic tail latency against tool spikes. It oversubscribes GPU memory by placing more agents on each GPU, prefetching the next agent's state to hide swap latency. To match the machine to the heterogeneous roles, Agora pools cores by role and applies affinity-aware scheduling to restore locality. It automatically tunes mechanisms to the workload. Agora improves utilization and server throughput while preserving agent tail latency. Our insights also identify key directions for future server architectures for agentic AI.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对智能体AI（Agentic AI）工作流进行生产级架构特征分析，提出基于编排、执行结构和模型组合的三维分类法，并揭示其在传统统一服务器上的三大架构失配问题。作者设计了Agora原型系统，通过CPU/GPU资源收割、角色感知的核心池化与绑定策略，将Agent工作流延迟影响控制在3.3%以内的同时，恢复95%的共生吞吐量、82%的生成吞吐量和2.5×的尾延迟改善。
AI.motivation: 智能体AI正快速成为数据中心的重要负载，但现有服务器架构主要针对传统CPU中心化服务或单体LLM推理进行优化，缺乏对智能体工作流的架构特征理解。智能体工作流将单个请求扩展为LLM推理、工具调用和编排决策的依赖图，反复跨越CPU-GPU边界，其异构性和碎片化执行模式给传统服务器带来挑战。论文旨在系统刻画智能体AI的架构特征，识别现有服务器的架构失配，并提出相应的服务器设计原则。
AI.method: 方法包含三个层面：(1) 分类法构建——沿编排（宿主编排 vs LLM编排）、执行结构（顺序 vs 并行）、模型组合（同构 vs 异构）三个平台相关维度组织智能体工作流；(2) 两阶段特征化研究——在Microsoft Azure超大规模生产环境中开展24小时舰队研究，捕获真实工作负载、工具混合和资源使用；在96核AMD EPYC 7V12 + 8×A100服务器上对SWE-Agent、Trae、CORAL、Owl四个代表性开源框架进行受控研究，并发度从1到32；(3) Agora原型系统设计——实现CPU收割（角色隔离、自适应退让、编排器提示）、GPU收割（内存超订阅、分类引导的共存、动态MILP分配）、角色感知核心池化与按任务绑定三大机制，并基于分类法和工作负载自适应调优。
AI.result: 关键结果包括：(1) 生产请求中超过27%的时间花在工具执行上，与推理相当或更多；(2) 宿主CPU中位数利用率仅6%-31%，GPU SM活跃度低于55%，但存在接近饱和的突发峰值；(3) 三个宿主角色（调度器、编排器、运行器）资源特征截然不同，统一核心池导致低效配置；(4) PMU数据显示IPC低（1.2-1.6），后端停顿占43%-47%，L1 MPKI达14-20，存在微架构局部性损失；(5) CPU收割在低负载下恢复95%共生吞吐量、agent减速<3%，主机CPU利用率提升31%；(6) GPU收割在Owl上释放33% GPU的同时，生成吞吐量提升82%，尾延迟降低2.5×，能效提升51%；(7) 角色感知池化将工具CPU需求降低最高46%、最差工具延迟降低13%，同时保留99%的服务吞吐量；(8) 按任务绑定（2任务/池）使工具时间尾部降低12.8%、批量完成加速4.7%。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出结论：智能体AI产生高度碎片化和异构的执行模式，挑战了传统服务器的两个基本假设——资源需求相对稳定、宿主工作可作为统一池管理。智能体工作流存在三大架构失配：碎片化使CPU/GPU容量闲置、不同软件角色使同质配置低效、多路复用降低微架构局部性。Agora通过动态收割闲置CPU核心和GPU容量、按角色池化和绑定核心、基于分类法和工作负载自动调优机制，有效解决了这些失配问题。同时，论文为未来硬件提出了三个方向：调度和上下文切换的硬件支持、微架构结构分区、异构与可变核心。论文的核心贡献是首次对生产级智能体AI进行架构特征化，提出了面向平台的三维分类法，并通过Agora原型验证了三大服务器设计原则。

title: CARGO-VL: Counterfactual Arbitration with Risk-Constrained Group Optimization for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language systems combine images with retrieved text, but these sources can disagree or jointly fail to support an answer. Reliable models must identify the trustworthy source and abstain when neither is adequate. Existing post-training objectives score instances independently and therefore do not enforce coherent behavior under counterfactual evidence changes. We introduce CARGO-VL, a group-relative framework that optimizes matched variants covering aligned, image-correct, text-correct, and both-wrong (A/V/T/N) evidence states as one bundle. Its objective couples condition-wise correctness with transition rewards for answer invariance, source equivariance, and answer-to-abstention switching, while a primal-dual controller balances unsafe answers against excessive deferral. We also contribute XMC (eXtended Modal Conflict), a four-condition conflict training resource, and evaluate transfer on CMC-Bench and Modality-Bias. Across multiple seeds, CARGO-VL improves conflict handling, unsupported-answer avoidance, and modality balance over pointwise baselines. Ablations identify complementary benefits from relational transition signals and adaptive risk control, supporting counterfactual consistency as a practical objective for reliable multimodal evidence arbitration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CARGO-VL框架，将视觉-语言模型的多模态证据仲裁问题重构为对匹配A/V/T/N证据束的组优化任务，通过引入转换奖励（答案不变性、源等变性、答-弃切换）和原始-对偶风险控制器，在CMC-Bench和Modality-Bias上同时改善冲突处理、校准弃答与模态平衡。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言系统日益面临图像与检索文本的冲突（如多模态RAG场景）。现有后训练目标（监督微调、GRPO等）对实例独立评分，无法强制模型在反事实证据干预下保持决策一致性——例如翻转载体时应切换所遵循的模态，两者皆错时应弃答。同时，强模型仍存在系统性的模态偏好偏差，且弃答与准确率是相互制约的运营成本，单一标量奖励难以兼顾。
AI.method: CARGO-VL以匹配A/V/T/N证据束（对齐/图像正确/文本正确/皆错）为优化单元，包含：(1) 逐条件点奖励r_act/r_src/r_ans；(2) 转换奖励r_trans=0.4·r_AI+0.3·r_SE+0.3·r_DS（联合答案不变性、源等变性、N条件答-弃切换）；(3) softmin_τ保护最弱条件；(4) 滚动级原始-对偶风险成本C_B(λ)约束不安全答、过弃答和精确匹配损失，并在组相对优势归一化前施加；(5) 基于GRPO的更新策略，组由独立补全改为反事实证据束。同时构建XMC训练集，将A/V/T/N方案应用于新鲜的TextVQA和ScienceQA样例，并分离冻结的语义评判器。
AI.result: 在CMC-Bench holdout（283/1132）和Modality-Bias VSR（846）三随机种子{42,43,44}评估下，CARGO-VL在Acc(I★)=48.1、Acc(N)=98.2、ConfabR=7.3、CDR=53.2、ΔAcc=17.0上领先，模态偏好偏差B=-3.2最接近零且保持显著的%Img/%Txt=29.2/32.4；消融实验表明移除转换奖励使ConfabR升至22.4、CDR降至26.4、B回弹至+12.9；固定惩罚替代对偶更新则导致过弃答率42.0%、B=+13.5，验证转换一致性与自适应风险控制的互补作用。
AI.conclusion: CARGO-VL证明反事实一致性可作为多模态证据仲裁的实用训练目标：转换奖励驱动源路由，对偶控制防止虚构与过度弃答。增益集中于视觉胜出冲突、校准弃答与模态平衡，且明确报告决策覆盖率（避免近零偏差被低覆盖度掩饰），同时不宣称所选权重、温度或风险预算为最优。

title: Leak-Resistant Unlearning: A New Benchmark for Evaluating Multi-Hop Reasoning Consistency and Recovery Robustness
summary: Benchmarking machine unlearning methods is critical to understand whether sensitive knowledge is removed from large language models (LLMs) or not. Current unlearning benchmarks include mainly single-hop questions and a narrow set of multi-hop questions. Although effective, they still face two challenges. (1) Knowledge is not isolated, whereby diverse multi-hop reasoning paths can potentially induce knowledge leakage than normal queries. (2) Unlearning may be fragile: unlearned knowledge can be partially recovered through recovery attacks such as lightweight post-unlearning adaptation, making static evaluation insufficient. Therefore, in this paper, we introduce \unlearning as a novel benchmark to understand robust LLM knowledge removal across diverse reasoning paths and recovery attacks. We experiment with this benchmark on 3 models, 6 unlearning methods, and 2 carefully curated datasets. Results show that existing methods are vulnerable to multi-hop reasoning paths and recovery attacks. We further explore the trade-off among forget quality, robustness, and model utility for LLM unlearning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Leak-Resistant Unlearning"基准，针对大语言模型(LLM)遗忘方法在多跳推理路径下的知识泄露和恢复攻击脆弱性问题，设计了包含6种逻辑推理结构的多跳问题生成流程，并在3个模型、6种遗忘方法和2个数据集上系统评估现有方法的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM遗忘基准主要针对单跳问题或有限的多跳问题，存在两大挑战：(1) 知识并非孤立存在，多样化的多跳推理路径可能比普通查询更容易引发知识泄露；(2) 遗忘效果脆弱，被遗忘的知识可通过轻量级的恢复攻击部分恢复，使静态评估不够充分。因此需要一个更严格的评估框架来衡量遗忘方法在多样化推理路径和恢复攻击下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出"Leak-resistant Unlearning"基准，包含两个核心属性：(1) 路径一致性(Path Consistency)——目标知识在多样化多跳推理路径下不可访问；(2) 恢复鲁棒性(Recovery Robustness)——知识无法通过事后恢复方法被唤起。设计6种逻辑启发的推理结构：假言三段论(HS)、假言推理(MP)、莱布尼茨律(LL)、合取组合(CC)、析取三段论(DS)、拒取式(MT)。构建数据流水线：知识提取→多跳问题生成→自动质量验证。在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Qwen3-14B、Qwen3-32B三个模型上评估6种遗忘方法(GA、NPO、RMU、TV、PALU、AS)和3种恢复方法(Probab、FocusOnKey、Quantization)，使用Forget Quality、Recovery Rate、Reasoning Ability三个指标。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：(1) 某些推理结构(尤其是多跳查询)泄露的知识显著多于传统直接查询或链式查询，且多跳查询通常比单跳更容易恢复；(2) 被遗忘的知识对恢复攻击高度脆弱；(3) 现有遗忘方法难以同时实现高遗忘质量、模型实用性和鲁棒性，即存在"理想三角"的权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM遗忘方法在多样化多跳推理路径和恢复攻击下并非鲁棒，揭示了遗忘质量、鲁棒性和模型实用性之间存在固有权衡。该基准为评估遗忘方法的实际安全性提供了更全面、严格的测试框架，有助于推动更鲁棒的遗忘技术发展。

title: What Is a Skill Worth? Structure-Aware Shapley Valuation of Agent Skills
summary: Agent skills are increasingly optimized by automated feedback loops, producing long structured artifacts whose internal value remains unclear. We study skill valuation: assigning credit to the internal units of a fixed skill, such as rules, examples, scripts, and heuristics, under a fixed agent and held-out task distribution. Skill valuation differs from data or prompt-span valuation because skill units are structured: they may depend on other units, belong to a document hierarchy, trigger agent behavior, and consume limited prompt context. We introduce SkillSV, a structure-aware Shapley-style framework for skill valuation. SkillSV compiles a skill into units, dependencies, and hierarchy, so that only valid counterfactual skills are evaluated. It uses paired deletion and length-neutral padding to separate content value from context cost, and estimates the resulting values with a rollout-budgeted estimator for noisy agent evaluations. On four agentic benchmarks, we assess the faithfulness, actionability, and explanation of SkillSV: it recovers unit interactions, preserves aggregate skill lift, and guides safe pruning and compression.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SkillSV,一种面向智能体技能的结构感知 Shapley 归因框架。通过将技能编译为包含单元、依赖与层级的结构化博弈,SkillSV 能对技能内部单元(如规则、示例、脚本、启发式)在固定智能体与保留任务分布上的贡献进行信用分配,并通过配对删除/填充操作分离内容价值与上下文成本,在四个智能体基准上验证了其在保真度、可操作性与可解释性方面的有效性。
AI.motivation: 随着自动化反馈循环大规模生成并优化智能体技能(长结构化产物),其内部各组成单元的贡献归属仍是黑盒。现有 Shapley 估值方法适用于平坦无结构的数据点或提示片段,但技能单元具有依赖关系、文档层级、行为触发与上下文消耗等结构化特性,导致扁平方法(如 leave-one-out)产生错误归因甚至衡量"破坏"而非"贡献"。两大核心挑战为:(1)结构反事实——单元移除可能产生悬挂引用、未定义符号、孤立片段等无效技能;(2)预算受限的智能体执行评估——每个反事实联盟均需在保留任务上多轮智能体执行,噪声大且成本高。
AI.method: SkillSV 包含三大核心设计:(1)**确定性技能编译器** 𝖢,将技能产物映射为 G=(N, D, H),其中 N 为评估单元,D 为依赖 DAG(包含 9 类规则,涵盖引用、定义-使用、连续性、触发等),H 为文档层级。可行联盟 𝓕 须对依赖向下封闭,以保证"看起来像真实技能";编译器通过商图检测与修复 𝓓 与 H 的相容性冲突。(2)**结构感知 Shapley 单元值**,在满足 𝓕 与 H-连续性的可行排列上定义边际贡献期望 ϕ_{i,ρ}(μ),采用 ρ_del(直接删除)与 ρ_pad(长度匹配中性填充)两种局部渲染算子,分别估计内容价值、内容价值-删除效果差(上下文成本)与净效果;触发单元 m 单独估值。(3)**链耦合任务窗口估计器**,对每条采样的可行排列 π_k 抽取固定任务窗口 W_k(大小 b≪M),同一窗口在整条前缀链上共享评估,消除任务难度变化造成的方差,并通过噪声门控截断(与全技能锚点差异 ≤τ)跳过已饱和的后缀。在典型参数下可实现超过 10 倍的 rollout 开销削减。
AI.result: 在四个智能体基准(LiveMath、OfficeQA、SpreadsheetBench、ALFWorld)上,以冻结的 GPT-5.5 为目标智能体,使用四种自动化优化器(Trace2Skill、TextGrad、GEPA、SkillOpt)生成的最佳技能进行评估:(1)**保真度**——合成游戏中精确恢复植入的 OR/AND/有害/无效单元角色;真实技能中通过值闭包检验,Σϕ 与实测内容增益 Λ 之比在 0.95–1.04 区间,而 Closure-LOO 经常符号错误或大幅偏离 Λ(OfficeQA 上 4.43×,ALFWorld 上 -10×);真实壳余对的移除证实技能内部存在真正的交互效应。(2)**可操作性**——池化剪枝 AUC 显著高于所有基线(+0.026 对 LOO,+0.049 对 LLM 法官,+0.082 对随机,95% CI 均不包零);在高剪枝比例下 SkillSV 仍保持峰值性能;基于内容价值与上下文成本的定向精修后,技能平均压缩至原 69% 字符而性能无显著变化。(3)**可解释性**——OfficeQA 上 Top 10% 单元贡献 21%,LiveMath 35%,Spreadsheet 60%,ALFWorld 高达 100%,价值高度集中于少数高影响力单元。
AI.conclusion: SkillSV 证明技能估值并非简单的扁平消融:反事实技能必须尊重依赖与层级结构,删除必须与提示长度效应解耦,估计必须在严格的 rollout 预算下完成。通过结构化博弈编译、可行排序上的单元定价,以及基于链耦合任务窗口的配对差分估计,SkillSV 在四个智能体基准上恢复交互敏感的单元值,保持技能总体增益,并指导无损剪枝与压缩。结果显示,优化后的智能体技能常包含可识别的冗余或低价值内容,结构感知估值因此为未来技能优化系统提供了实用诊断层:不仅判断技能是否有效,还能明确哪些部分有效、哪些代价高昂、哪些可安全修改。

title: Joint UAV Flight and Opportunistic Routing under Reinforcement Learning for Delay-Tolerant Networks
summary: The growing deployment of delay-tolerant networks (DTNs) has made store-carry-forward (SCF) communication indispensable under sparse connectivity. However, intermittent contacts, finite buffers, and limited message time-to-live (TTL) often give rise to sparse delivery and congestion, leading to substantial end-to-end performance degradation. To address this challenge, this study explores the joint optimization of decentralized opportunistic routing and controllable unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) flight, aiming to enlarge future contacts through discrete UAV headings while enabling per-node replication under contact-limited observations. Building upon this architecture, we study cooperative factored routing--UAV control under centralized training and decentralized execution (CTDE) and propose JUROR (Joint UAV flight and Opportunistic Routing, based on the proximal policy optimization (PPO) framework. In our design, we first cast the problem as a factored partially observable Markov decision process with sequential motion--routing coupling and a per-step team reward; subsequently, decentralized actors act on local observations while a training-time critic uses global statistics, and an optional multi-horizon hotspot predictor provides auxiliary supervision. Simulation results over four traffic modes demonstrate effective gains over PRoPHET and MaxProp, while retaining contact-limited decentralized execution.

AI.tldr: 提出JUROR框架，基于CTDE-PPO集中训练分布式执行范式，联合优化无人机离散航向与DTN中的分布式机会路由，将问题建模为因子化部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，通过四项仿真流量模式验证其优于PRoPHET和MaxProp等基线，并支持接触受限的分布式部署。
AI.motivation: 时延容忍网络(DTN)在稀疏连接下依赖存储-携带-转发(SCF)机制，但间歇性接触、有限缓冲与有限TTL导致投递率低和拥塞。现有方法存在三类局限：(1)经典效用路由(如PRoPHET、MaxProp)假定无人机轨迹固定；(2)手工设计的UAV辅助路由将飞行规划与节点级SCF转发解耦；(3)仅路由强化学习未联合优化离散UAV航向与节点级复制。需要一种联合优化方法应对时变拓扑、分布式执行与团队学习的协同信用分配、以及稀疏延迟学习信号三大挑战。
AI.method: 构建离散时间SCF仿真系统，包含路网约束地面车辆与可控自由飞行UAV中继。采用CTDE-PPO架构：(1)每个节点含路由actor(局部观测含自身缓冲、生成/投递比、邻居缓冲缓存交换等9维特征+K个候选对7维特征)，每架UAV含运动actor(扇区应力+Top-K_σ偏移+质心方向的导航向量D_y维)；(2)集中式critic基于网络全局统计s(t)计算GAE优势；(3)因子化联合策略参数共享，路由与航向动作在同一团队奖励r(t)下联合优化；(4)可选多horizon热点预测LSTM辅助损失(λL_p)与HGA(热点引导对齐)奖励塑形，默认关闭；(5)部署时仅保留actor，使用接触受限观测g_u^L(t)；在Helsinki-medium测试床(N=70, N_uav=5)上对M1-M4四种流量模式进行80轮PPO训练。
AI.result: 消融研究表明：(1)移除UAV(M1峰值约13)大幅低于有UAV配置(峰值约51-58)，验证联合UAV-路由必要性，N_uav=1带来最大边际增益，N_uav∈[3,5]后收益递减；(2)deploy-near-real(接触受限g_u^L)在所有模式上接近base配置，验证分布式部署可行性；(3)Base+LSTM(λ=0.05)在M1峰值从57.6降至51.1、M2从2948.8降至2592.5，表现不及base，因噪声热点目标与稀疏投递奖励冲突；(4)Base+HGA在M3-M4峰值(217.0、315.9)领先，但M1-M2仍以base为优，说明可选模块为流量相关补充。基线对比：JUROR在四种流量模式投递比显著优于PRoPHET(M1:0.741 vs 0.505；M2:0.600 vs 0.373；M3:0.688 vs 0.513；M4:0.854 vs 0.600)与其他基线，且在M2持续高负载下优势最明显。
AI.conclusion: JUROR通过CTDE-PPO因子化架构成功实现了无人机离散航向与分布式机会路由的联合优化，在稀疏连接DTN中显著提升端到端投递性能。可选LSTM辅助与HGA塑形作为流量相关增强而非默认组件，默认base配置(λ=0, HGA关闭)在大多数场景下最为稳健。集中式critic利用全局统计降低训练方差，部署时actor仅依赖接触受限观测保持实用性。该工作为无人机辅助DTN与协作MARL研究搭建桥梁，验证了联合运动-路由控制是性能增益的结构性前提。

title: Agreement Before Diversity: Verification-First Complementarity for Heterogeneous Language-Model Coordination
summary: Heterogeneous language-model ensembles expand the space of candidate responses, yet they lack a principled criterion for when a newly generated answer should supersede an already supported one. We decouple candidate headroom from replacement authority, rendering the latter as an explicit, auditable object. Our proposed method, Agreement-Before-Diversity (ABD), is a frozen, label-free decision rule: an anchor answer is retained if two additional trusted samples corroborate it under a fixed equivalence relation; otherwise, it is replaced by a heterogeneous synthesis. For this gating mechanism, we prove two exact identities. The first shows that the accuracy gap relative to unconditional synthesis is determined jointly by the agreement coverage and the anchor's advantage on the protected subset. The second shows that the gap relative to never synthesizing reflects a contrast between authorized recovery and authorized destruction. Neither identity assumes independence or calibrated confidence, and the expected inference cost is approximately eight minus five times the coverage in number of calls. Under blind, exact-ID evaluation, ABD achieves 59.43% on the complete LiveCodeBench-v6 (vs. 52.57% for Single9 and 52.00% for HAC; n = 175) and 75.00% on an untouched GPQA-Diamond split (both controls at 72.78%; n = 180). Furthermore, these identities localize every aggregate difference to an enumerable protected stratum: no discordant items occur among the 3 protected cases on LiveCodeBench, where coverage bounds the gate's contribution to 1.71 points a priori; 13 versus 8 discordant cases among 132 on GPQA-Diamond; and 12 versus 0 among 71 under a frozen anchor perturbation. Diversity supplies potential; verification structure supplies authority.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Agreement-Before-Diversity (ABD) 方法，这是一种冻结式、无标签的决策规则，用于异构语言模型集成中的答案选择。ABD 将候选答案的"提升空间"与"替换权限"解耦，通过两个受信任样本在固定等价关系下对锚定答案进行验证，来决定是否用异构合成结果替换锚定答案。
AI.motivation: 异构语言模型集成虽然扩展了候选响应的空间，但缺乏一个原则性的标准来判断何时一个新生成的答案应该取代已有的支持答案。现有的合成方法（如无条件合成）缺乏明确的替换授权机制，难以审计和控制。论文旨在将替换决策转化为一个显式、可审计的对象。
AI.method: 核心方法 ABD 的运作流程为：(1) 保留一个锚定答案；(2) 使用两个额外的可信样本在固定等价关系下验证该答案；(3) 若验证通过则保留锚定答案，否则用异构合成结果替换。理论上证明了两个精确恒等式：(a) 与无条件合成相比的精度差距由一致性覆盖率和锚定答案在受保护子集上的优势共同决定；(b) 与永不合成相比的差距反映了"授权恢复"与"授权破坏"的对比。两个恒等式均不假设独立性或校准置信度。预期推理成本约为 8 - 5 × 覆盖率（以调用次数计）。
AI.result: 在盲法、精确 ID 评估下：(1) LiveCodeBench-v6 完整测试集上 ABD 达到 59.43%（n=175），优于 Single9（52.57%）和 HAC（52.00%）；(2) 未触及的 GPQA-Diamond 分割上达到 75.00%（n=180），两个对照组均为 72.78%。恒等式分析定位了每个聚合差异到可枚举的受保护层：LiveCodeBench 上 3 个受保护案例中无不一致项，覆盖率对门的贡献先验上限为 1.71 点；GPQA-Diamond 上 132 个中 13 vs 8 个不一致案例；冻结锚定扰动下 71 个中 12 vs 0 个。
AI.conclusion: ABD 提供了两个关键洞见：(1) 多样性提供"潜力"，验证结构提供"权威"——两者需协同作用；(2) 通过将聚合差异定位到可枚举的受保护层，ABD 实现了完全可审计的决策过程。方法无需标签、无需训练，且具有可证明的精度差距边界，在代码基准和科学问答基准上均显著优于现有集成方法。

title: A/B Agent: A Self-Evolving Agent for Strategy Iteration in Industrial A/B Testing
summary: Industrial recommendation strategy iteration heavily relies on large-scale A/B experimentation. Traditional tuning requires experts to repeatedly design strategies, configure experiments, analyze results, and adjust parameters, making the process labor-intensive and time-consuming. Meanwhile, valuable knowledge from historical experiments is often fragmented, making systematic reuse difficult through manual expert effort alone. Existing RAG agents partially alleviate this burden by retrieving prior strategies, but typically organize experience in a flat manner, overlooking the hierarchical relationships among business scenarios, recommendation stages, optimization objectives, and experimental contexts. This often results in mismatched retrieval and limited cross-scenario transfer, while preventing agents from continuously refining strategies and parameters through sequential A/B feedback. % To address these limitations, we propose A/B Agent, a closed-loop A/B agent for industrial recommendation strategy optimization. The framework comprises three tightly coupled core components: Historical Strategy Knowledge Organization, Autonomous Target-Aware Strategy Generation, and Experiment-Guided Strategy Self-Evolution. It organizes historical strategies into a hierarchical experience tree, retrieves transferable evidence through multi-path Tree-RAG to generate executable strategies, and continuously analyzes online A/B feedback to guide autonomous tuning and update the experience tree for self-evolution. Extensive offline and online evaluations demonstrate its effectiveness, including a 4.829% improvement in GMV in a real-world short-video e-commerce recommendation system while maintaining positive gains across all guardrail metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出A/B Agent，一种用于工业推荐系统策略迭代的自演化智能体框架。该框架通过层次化经验树组织历史策略知识，利用多路径Tree-RAG检索可迁移证据以生成可执行策略，并通过在线A/B反馈持续优化策略与参数、迭代更新经验树，实现"知识组织-策略生成-在线调优-经验演化"的闭环。在快手短视频电商的真实部署中实现了4.829%的GMV提升。
AI.motivation: 工业推荐系统的策略迭代严重依赖大规模A/B实验，传统调优需要专家反复设计策略、配置实验、分析结果和调整参数，过程耗时耗力。同时，历史实验中的有价值的策略知识分散在文档、源代码、实验配置和指标日志等异构来源中，缺乏统一的抽象，难以系统化检索与复用。现有RAG智能体仅以扁平方式组织经验，忽略了业务场景、推荐阶段、优化目标和实验上下文之间的层次关系，导致检索不匹配、跨场景迁移能力有限，且无法通过连续的A/B反馈自主迭代优化策略与参数。
AI.method: A/B Agent框架包含三个紧密耦合的核心组件：(1) 历史策略知识组织：将历史实验报告统一结构化为标准模式，通过智能体从多视角分解为原子化的策略块（包含动机、机制、参数、适用条件、效果和风险），并按"领域-场景-推荐阶段-优化目标"层次路径构建层次化经验树；(2) 自主目标感知策略生成：给定优化请求后，通过多路径（稀疏+稠密）检索、层次感知的相关性增强（基于树路径距离衰减打分）和Qwen-Reranker重排序，从经验树中选取与目标场景、阶段和目标匹配的证据，再由策略生成器结合工程可行性、护栏风险等生成可执行初始策略；(3) 实验引导的策略自演化：将连续A/B实验组织为实验树，通过父子与兄弟比较评估策略修改效果，利用联合考虑核心指标增益与护栏风险的效用函数指导局部参数搜索或机制替换，并将验证有效的策略写回经验树形成闭环。基础模型采用GLM-5.1。
AI.result: 离线实验：基于快手电商三个场景共310条历史策略构建基准，A/B Agent在所有评估维度上均取得最佳表现，平均Overall得分7.244，比Claude-Sonnet-4.6高1.3%，比各场景最强RAG基线分别高25.0%、31.7%和23.5%。在线A/B测试：从Strategy 1到Strategy 5展示了探索-精炼的调优轨迹，最终Strategy 5相比专家策略GMV提升4.829%、GPM提升4.677%，所有护栏指标均为正。消融实验：移除知识库、检索增强、重排序等模块均导致性能下降，其中知识库最为关键（Overall下降3.3%），重排序次之（下降2.3%）。阶段分析：在检索、排序、混排、其他四个推荐阶段均优于所有基线方法。错误分析：主要失败类型为方案不匹配（43.1%），其次是数据/标签/归因错误（29.2%）和工程服务问题（19.4%）。
AI.conclusion: A/B Agent作为面向工业推荐策略迭代的自演化智能体框架，通过层次化经验组织、多路径Tree-RAG检索和实验反馈驱动的自演化机制，有效解决了历史策略知识碎片化、扁平RAG检索不匹配和缺乏长周期优化闭环的问题。离线与在线实验均验证了其有效性，未来工作将聚焦于更强的需求对齐、更精确的数据与指标归因以及自动化的工程可行性验证，以支持更安全可靠的策略演化。

title: AI Literacy for Legal Translation: Developing Digital Resilience
summary: Generative AI is transforming legal translation by introducing opportunities alongside linguistic, technical, legal, ethical and cognitive risks. This chapter examines the implications of AI for professional legal translation and proposes an AI literacy framework tailored to the profession. It argues that AI does not change the fundamental objectives of legal translation but requires an extension of professional competence through AI literacy. The proposed framework comprises four mutually reinforcing dimensions, foundational, procedural, critical and strategic, and conceptualises AI literacy as a transversal component of legal translation competence that fosters digital resilience. It further discusses the pedagogical implications of this framework by proposing classroom activities designed to develop AI literacy in legal translator education, enabling future translators to integrate AI critically, responsibly and in accordance with professional standards.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨生成式AI对专业法律翻译的影响，提出一个专为法律翻译行业设计的AI素养框架，旨在通过该框架使未来译者能够批判性、负责任地整合AI，符合职业标准。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI正在改变法律翻译领域，既带来机遇也带来语言、技术、法律、伦理和认知层面的多重风险。然而，AI并未改变法律翻译的根本目标，因此需要通过扩展职业能力（即AI素养）来应对这些挑战。
AI.method: 提出一个包含四个相互强化维度的AI素养框架：基础维度（foundational）、程序维度（procedural）、批判维度（critical）和战略维度（strategic）。该框架将AI素养定位为法律翻译能力的横向贯穿组件，旨在培养数字韧性（digital resilience）。同时提出针对法律翻译教育的课堂活动设计，探讨其教学法含义。
AI.result: 构建了一个适用于法律翻译专业教育的AI素养四维框架，并设计了具体的课堂教学活动来培养未来译者的AI素养能力。
AI.conclusion: AI素养应作为法律翻译职业能力的横向贯穿要素，通过基础、程序、批判和战略四个维度的综合培养，能够使法律译者具备数字韧性，在AI时代以批判性、负责任且符合职业标准的方式整合AI技术。

title: Calibrating Artificial Guilt: Neurally Grounded Reward Shaping for Prosocial Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning often adds social terms to individual rewards, yet the scale of those terms is usually chosen by hand. We ask whether a guilt signal can instead be calibrated from human neural and behavioural data and transferred to artificial agents. Using the public SoDec responsibility fMRI dataset (40 participants), we fit a subject-fixed-effects regression of momentary-happiness changes on outcome-type counts and recover a guilt weight as the Partner-negative minus Social-negative contrast ($\hat{w}=1.118$, Cohen's $d=0.214$). We embed this weight in a two-agent Social Lottery environment and train independent Proximal Policy Optimization actor-critics under four shaping regimes: neurally calibrated, uniform constant, zero (selfish), and a unit-coefficient oracle. Across 1{,}000 evaluation episodes per condition, the calibrated agents track the human Social safe-choice rate most closely ($0.459$ vs.\ human $0.484$; $\mathrm{KL}=0.0012$), while the other three conditions deviate by one to three orders of magnitude in KL. Human neurobehavioural priors can therefore act as quantitative constraints on prosocial reward shaping.

AI.tldr: 本文从人类神经行为数据中校准"内疚"权重，并将其作为奖励塑形系数注入多智能体强化学习（MARL）中，在Social Lottery环境中训练独立PPO智能体。结果表明，经神经数据校准的惩罚系数（ŵ=1.118）使智能体的安全选择率（0.459）最接近人类Social基线（0.484），KL散度仅为0.0012，显著优于自私、均匀常数和单位系数oracle基线。核心贡献在于提供了一条从公开神经行为对比度到MARL可迁移奖励权重的校准路径。
AI.motivation: 合作型MARL通常在个体奖励中加入社会项（如不公平厌恶、社会影响等），但这些社会项的系数通常由人工手动调节或网格搜索确定，缺乏来自人类实际社会认知数据的定量约束。这导致智能体可能满足设计者的规范标准，却偏离真实人类的社会决策分布。论文提出利用人类神经行为数据中的"内疚"信号来校准奖励塑形的幅度，实现更符合人类实际行为的人工智能体。
AI.method: 1）数据来源：使用公开的SoDec责任数据集（OpenNeuro ds005588），包含40名参与者在fMRI扫描下完成的责任任务行为数据。2）权重提取：对每个参与者的happiness变化进行subject-fixed-effects回归，以9种结局类型计数为自变量，通过Partner负性减Social负性的对比度获得内疚权重ŵ=1.118（Cohen's d=0.214）。3）环境构建：在PettingZoo中实现Social Lottery双智能体Markov博弈，20轮/回合，参数从ds005588经验分布采样。4）奖励塑形：决策者选择风险选项导致伙伴低收益时施加惩罚w·Δp，设置四种条件——NeuroGuilt（w=1.118）、Uniform（w=0.5）、Zero（w=0）、Oracle（w=1）。5）训练：两个独立PPO actor-critic，64单元MLP，固定超参数（共享表2），训练20000回合，评估1000回合。6）评估指标：社会福利、安全率、奖励不平等、内疚惩罚质量、与人类Social基线的KL散度。
AI.result: NeuroGuilt条件：安全率0.459（vs人类0.484），KL(P_human∥P_agent)=0.0012，奖励不平等1.554，内疚惩罚质量2.863。Oracle（w=1）：KL=0.0153，比NeuroGuilt大12.8倍。Uniform（w=0.5）：KL=0.3097。Zero（w=0，自私基线）：KL=0.4717，比NeuroGuilt大393倍。虽然NeuroGuilt的系数（1.118）大于Oracle（1），但因更安全的选择策略减少了惩罚触发频率，其累积惩罚质量和不平等均低于Oracle。关键发现：校准幅度对齐优于系数大小的单调排序。
AI.conclusion: 论文结论为：(1) 单个来自公开神经行为对比度的标量能够比设计者默认设置更紧致地约束亲社会MARL；(2) 数据驱动的幅度校准比"惩罚越强越好"的直觉更重要，对齐效果取决于数据来源的尺度而非系数大小的单调排序；(3) 内疚权重的经典统计检验不显著（p=0.44），应作为先验而非确认效应量使用；(4) Social Lottery是对扫描仪任务的短期抽象，不含延迟信用分配或通信机制，结论限于任务环境。局限包括经典检验不显著、未使用受试者特异性前脑岛神经beta值、环境为短期抽象任务。未来方向是替换为受试者特异性神经beta值，并在更长视野的困境中测试幅度迁移思想。

title: Traceable LLM-Generated Hazard Scenarios for Operational Safety Analysis of Aviation Systems Using ASRS Reports
summary: Operational hazard analysis of aviation system operations must consider interactions among weather, ATC actions, airspace constraints, aircraft operations, and human factors - distinct from the functional hazard assessment applied at the aircraft-system level. We present an AI-assisted approach that generates candidate hazard scenarios from NASA's Aviation Safety Reporting System (ASRS). Given a target adverse outcome, it produces a structured hypothesis as categorical factors and a narrative scenario describing an operational event sequence consistent with the structure. Each scenario includes by a plausibility score from historical co-occurrence evidence and traceability to the most similar held-out ASRS reports. We then propose a hybrid variant, conditioning narrative generation on a structured hypothesis produced via evolutionary abduction, improving correctness and reducing variability. We evaluate multiple large language models, zero-shot versus few-shot prompting, and optional fine-tuning, measuring how prompting and model choice affect the validity and realism of the generated structures and narratives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HaGen 与 HaGen+ 两种基于大语言模型（LLM）的航空运行危险场景生成方法，以 NASA ASRS 报告数据库为基础，自动生成包含结构化分类因子与叙事描述的危险场景，并提供基于历史共现证据的可信度评分与可追溯性链接。
AI.motivation: 航空运行危险分析需考虑天气、ATC、空域、飞机运行与人为因素之间的复杂交互作用，潜在危险组合呈组合爆炸式增长，人工列举易遗漏且难以兼顾新颖性与可信度。现有传统风险分析方法（HAZOP、FMECA、FTA 等）依赖专家经验，难以有效识别多因素共现的新风险。同时航空领域积累了海量历史事故报告，蕴含了真实运行中因素共现的模式。如何利用生成式 AI 在分析员在环的工作流中辅助探索可信危险场景，并提供证据支持审查，是亟待解决的问题。
AI.method: HaGen：使用 LLM（Llama-3.1-8B、Ministral-8B、Phi-3.5，均经 AWQ 量化）在预定义模式与可选值集合下，同时生成结构化分类因子与叙事文本，对比零样本（ZSL）与三样本（3SL）提示策略，并可选基于 QLoRA 的参数高效微调。HaGen+：将基于进化演绎推理（EVA）的结构化假设生成作为前置，再用 LLM 依据该结构生成对应叙事。数据集为 ASRS 中随机抽取的 10000 份报告（1993 份作测试集），覆盖 10 种事故结果类型。评估指标：结构有效性用 Generation Failure Ratio (GFR)；结构部分相似度用 Jaccard 距离；叙事部分相似度用 BARTScore。对比基线包括三种进化算法（EVA、ES、GA）、三种因果结构发现方法（FGES、RFCI、GFCI）及随机基线 RAN。每配置重复 20 次并采用 Wilcoxon、Kruskal-Wallis、Dunn's、Levene's 等统计检验。
AI.result: （1）提示策略与模型选择显著影响有效性与真实性：3SL 较 ZSL 平均提升有效性约 52%；朴素微调反而恶化 GFR；最佳配置为 Llama + 3SL + 不微调，结构 GFR 低至 12-13%；（2）最佳 HaGen 配置在结构真实性上与 EVA、ES、GA、FGES、RFCI、GFCI 等专用基线无统计学显著差异，且能额外生成与 ASRS 报告操作语言对齐的叙事并提供可追溯性；（3）HaGen+ 通过耦合 EVA 结构性输出，结构性失效由构造消除，叙事真实度评分标准差由 0.12 降至 0.02（相对减少 83%），且 Levene's 检验显示结构部分、Jaccard 距离、Narrative 与 Callback 的 BARTScore 方差均显著低于 HaGen。
