AI.method: 1. 反事实分支协议：对每个错误状态 s 在相同剩余预算 B(s) 下执行 k 条教师继续分支和 k 条回滚分支，比较经验成功率 p_cont(s) 与 p_roll(s)，计算动作效应 Δ_action(s) = p_cont(s) - p_roll(s)。2. 三分类标签：可恢复（p_cont≥0.5）、不可逆但可避免（p_cont≤0.25 且 p_roll≥0.5）、模糊（其余）。3. 候选条件蒸馏骨干：师生在同一可行动作集 A(s) 上打分并各自归一化，消除非法动作和分词不对齐的混淆。4. 预言机控制规则：可恢复状态保留并赋予修正监督，不可逆状态回滚重采样，模糊状态走常规SOD路径。5. 探测-目标分离（E3）防止分支结果泄露。
AI.result: 1. 分支诊断（E2）：65个可恢复状态 Δ_action=0.185，34个不可逆但可避免状态 Δ_action=-1.000，组间差为1.185，组自助区间[1.092, 1.277]。2. 预测器诊断（E3）：分支衍生的可恢复性代理AUC=1.000，显著优于纯分歧度的0.392。3. 冻结评估（E5）：AIME2025成功率达0.578±0.019（最佳基线SOD为0.517）；AIME2024-25平均@32从0.2656提升至0.3125；GPQA-Diamond平均@32从0.2702提升至0.3070。4. 组件消融：保留策略贡献最大（去保留后60题保持集从0.583降至0.483），回滚次之（去回滚降至0.550）。5. 预言机使用约3倍教师token（662.8k vs ~220k），但token膨胀低于2×预算上限。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将纯分歧启发式转化为可执行的反事实问题，证实可恢复性与不可逆状态确实编码相反的干预偏好，分支衍生的代理信号比分歧度更具信息量。结果确立了可恢复性作为OPD中结果驱动的选择性监督决策变量，是对分歧信号的有益补充。然而，该预言机方案属于诊断性上界，证据仅来自单一教师、固定清单和有限种子（3个），且101/200状态为模糊类，部署仍需匹配预算下的状态级估计器验证。

title: SPOT: Sparse Probing and Outcome Calibration for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories, but standard reverse-KL training can assign insufficient probability to other plausible continuations. Teacher entropy alone does not reveal whether uncertainty is concentrated among a few plausible next tokens or dispersed over a long probability tail, nor whether the student already represents those candidates well. Moreover, local teacher probabilities may not predict downstream success. We introduce Sparse Probing and Outcome-calibrated Targets OPD (SPOT), which addresses two coupled decisions, where to probe and what to distill, through an acquisition--exploration--exploitation procedure. During acquisition, a position-level score combines normalized teacher entropy, the probability mass captured by a small top-$k$ candidate set, and student--teacher mismatch to allocate a limited probing budget. During exploration, SPOT evaluates teacher-proposed candidates through verifier-scored student continuations. During exploitation, these outcomes produce a closed-form, KL-regularized target that favors candidates with better downstream outcomes while remaining anchored to the teacher distribution. Extensive experiments across multiple student models and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of SPOT in improving reasoning performance while balancing solution quality and coverage.

AI.tldr: SPOT 提出了一种面向推理模型在策略蒸馏（OPD）的新方法，通过"采集—探索—利用"三阶段流程解决两个耦合决策：在何处探测（where to probe）以及蒸馏什么（what to distill）。方法在六个数学推理基准上以三种 Qwen 学生规模均取得最高的 macro Pass@8。
AI.motivation: 标准 OPD 采用反向 KL 训练，存在两个关键缺陷：(1) 模式寻求（mode-seeking）行为对教师分布中其他合理延续赋予的概率不足，限制了解决方案的覆盖度；(2) 仅依赖教师熵无法区分不确定性集中在少量合理候选 token 上还是分散在长概率尾部，也无从知晓学生是否已经较好地表征了这些候选。此外，学生生成前缀上教师的局部 token 概率未必能预测下游成功与否。已有方法 EOPD 使用熵阈值作为触发器，但仅解决"在哪里干预"问题，且不能定位有限探测预算最有价值的位置。
AI.method: SPOT 采用三阶段框架：(1) 采集（Acquisition）：定义位置级评分 s_t = H̄_T(c_t) · C_t^{k_s} · G_t^{k_s}，其中 H̄_T 为词汇表归一化教师熵，C_t^{k_s} 为 top-k 候选集捕获的教师概率质量，G_t^{k_s} 结合学生-教师质量欠覆盖 (1-A_t^{k_s}) 与 JS 形状散度的学生-教师失配度，三者相乘形成"软合取"评分，仅在三者同时较高时评分才高；按 Top-M 选取稀疏探测位置。(2) 探索（Exploration）：在选中位置对 top-k_p 教师候选各追加一个 token，让学生行为策略采样 N_p 次延续，用验证器评分得到候选的估计延续价值 V̂_t(v)；保留至少有一个候选获得正奖励的位置集 B⁺。(3) 利用（Exploitation）：在 B⁺ 上求解带 KL 信任域约束的优化问题 max Σρ_t(v)V̂_t(v) s.t. D_KL(ρ_t ‖ π̄_T^{k_p}) ≤ ε，得到闭式解 π̃_T(v|c_t) ∝ π̄_T^{k_p}(v|c_t) exp(γ V̂_t(v))，即教师对数先验加上 γ 倍的延续价值奖励（rewards），保持锚定于教师分布。最终损失在标准 OPD 反向 KL 之上，对 B⁺ 位置附加分支蒸馏损失 L^{Branch}。附录给出完整的理论分析，包括闭式解推导、信任域等价性、值-先验单调权衡、二元验证器情形下的 odds 更新解释等。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-8B 教师下，使用 Qwen3-0.6B-Base/1.7B-Base（MATH 训练数据）与 Qwen3-4B-Base（DAPO-Math-14k 训练数据）作为学生，对比 KD、GRPO、OPD、EOPD 四类基线，在 MATH-500、AMC 2023、Minerva Math、HMMT 2025、AIME 2024、AIME 2025 六个数学推理基准上各采样 8 次。主要结果：(1) 三个学生规模下 macro Pass@8 均最优（相对 OPD 提升 4.55–5.28 点，相对 EOPD 提升 2.49–3.19 点）；macro Avg@8 为最佳或次佳（相对 OPD 提升 0.47–1.48 点）；(2) 消融实验验证：a) 完整采集评分 s_t = H̄·C·G 优于 H、HC、HG、HC-Mass 等变体；b) 移除验证器引导后 macro Avg@8/Pass@8 下降 3.21/7.38 点；c) 在 k∈{4,8,16,32,64} 采样预算下，k≥8 时 SPOT 一致领先，k=64 时对 OPD 仍有 12.50–16.67 点优势；(3) 分支损失权重 β=0.1 为最优默认；(4) 域外泛化（GPQA-Diamond、MMLU-Pro、AlpacaEval 2.0）显示对推理性任务提升最显著；(5) Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 学生 + Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 教师下 Pass@8 仍领先，验证跨家族可移植性。
AI.conclusion: 论文系统论证了在策略蒸馏中将"在哪里探测"与"蒸馏什么"两个决策解耦的必要性：不确定性结构与学生-教师失配度应指导探测预算分配，而下游验证结果应校准监督目标。SPOT 通过稀疏位置采集与闭式 KL 正则化结果校准，在不损害平均准确度的前提下显著扩展多采样覆盖度，是 OPD 范式下一种理论完备且经验有效的改进。

title: Generative Optimization for Incentivized Advertising with Global Level Constraints
summary: Incentivized advertising allocates monetary or virtual rewards to drive user engagement, where a key challenge is optimizing continuous incentive magnitudes under strict global constraints. This problem is complicated by high-frequency interactions, delayed feedback, and non-Markovian user dynamics such as fatigue, which limit the effectiveness of existing uplift modeling and constrained reinforcement learning approaches. To address these challenges, we propose GOAL, a constraint-aware generative framework that formulates incentive allocation as a conditional sequence generation problem. GOAL directly generates incentive magnitudes conditioned on user histories and system-level global pressure, and integrates a hierarchical causal state encoder to capture both local behavioral dynamics and long-range dependencies. To enable flexible constraint control, we introduce \textbf{S}afe \textbf{C}onstrained \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{O}ptimization (SCPO), which learns a single generative policy that generalizes across a spectrum of ROI constraints without retraining. Experiments on large-scale real-world data and a synthetic fatigue-aware environment show that GOAL improves long-term revenue and user retention while substantially reducing ROI violation rates compared to strong baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GOAL框架，将激励广告中的连续激励金额分配建模为条件序列生成任务，通过分层因果编码器捕捉非马尔可夫用户动态（如疲劳），并结合约束感知MoE解码器和SCPO（Safe Constrained Policy Optimization）算法，实现单一策略在不同ROI约束间的灵活适配，无需重训练。
AI.motivation: 激励广告需要在严格全局ROI约束下优化连续激励金额，但现有方法存在两大瓶颈：(1) Uplift建模方法仅关注短期效果且对预测误差敏感，两阶段管线导致次优决策；(2) 离线强化学习方法依赖马尔可夫假设，在高频用户交互中失效，且因分布偏移过于保守。生成式序列建模虽具表达力，但标准Transformer的全局自注意力会稀释关键的局部信号（如疲劳突变），且现有对齐方法无法处理跨时间耦合的系统级约束。
AI.method: GOAL框架包含四大核心组件：(1) 激励分词器——基于动态分位数调整构建词汇表，用贪心分解实现连续值的粗到细离散化；(2) 分层因果编码器——先通过膨胀因果卷积(DCC)捕捉局部高密度行为动态，再注入λ条件嵌入并经自注意力建模全局依赖；(3) λ条件生成解码器——将FFN替换为约束感知MoE，门控网络根据λ路由不同专家，实现"激进投放"与"保守控制"的策略分化；(4) SCPO对齐算法——将λ提升为随机状态变量，在λ分布上训练通用策略，采用约束条件归一化（按λ分组计算优势），并通过PPO风格裁剪目标优化单一策略以适应任意ROI约束。
AI.result: 在工业数据集IA（130K DAU，1.84M事件）和合成疲劳感知环境上，GOAL（λ=0.5）显著优于DT、CDT、IQL、CAL、TREBI等基线：IA上Revenue提升18.52%、ROI提升4.01%、RVR降低18.40%；合成环境上Revenue提升2.40%、ROI提升2.40%、RVR降低9.86%。消融实验验证了SCPO、DCC、λ泛化和分词器各模块的互补作用。4周在线A/B测试（65%流量）实现ROI提升2.184%、Revenue提升2.559%（p=0.03），且DAU和停留时长无显著负面影响。λ梯度分析证明模型可在推理时平滑调节策略，无需重训练。
AI.conclusion: GOAL是首个面向严格ROI约束的激励广告生成式框架，通过统一因果用户状态建模、约束感知生成与SCPO对齐，突破了传统myopic uplift模型和刚性离线RL的局限。λ泛化机制使单一模型可适应动态运营要求而无需重训练，标志着从"预测-分配"管线向统一生成式控制范式的转变。未来计划扩展至平台收入、广告主ROI与用户体验的多目标优化。

title: MERaLiON-GR: Speech Gender Recognition Model for English and SEA Languages
summary: We present MERaLiON-GR, a speech gender recognition system that performs binary classification (female / male) on English and Southeast Asian (SEA) languages. The model finetunes MERaLiON-SpeechEncoder-2, a large conformer based transformer pre-trained on a broad speech corpus, and applies parameter efficient fine-tuning via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to adapt the encoder to the gender recognition task, and appends a multi-scale ECAPA-TDNN down stream network with attention pooling and a lightweight linear classifier. Extensive evaluations across multilingual Singaporean and Southeast Asian languages (English, Chinese, Malay, Tamil, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, and Khmer) show that MERaLiON-GR consistently surpasses the state-of-the-art gender recognition model Vox-Profile and a large Audio-LLM, in both full-utterance and segment level evaluation modes. The results underscore the value of dedicated speech models in achieving accurate paralinguistic understanding and strong cross-lingual generalization.

AI.tldr: MERaLiON-GR 是一个面向英语及东南亚语言的语音性别识别系统，通过对预训练的 Conformer 编码器（MERaLiON-SpeechEncoder-2）进行 LoRA 参数高效微调，并附加多尺度 ECAPA-TDNN 下游网络和轻量线性分类器实现二分类任务。在 8 种语言、15 个公开基准上全面超越当前最优的 Vox-Profile 模型和通用 Audio-LLM（MERaLiON-v2），并显著提升 Audio-LLM 在性别相关问答任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 语音中的性别识别是说话人日志、个性化语音接口、音频取证等任务的基础性副语言任务。尽管人类能轻松从语音中判断说话人性别，但自动化系统需要在不同语言、口音、年龄、信道等多样化条件下实现鲁棒泛化。现有专用模型（如 Vox-Profile）在东南亚多语言场景下的细粒度副语言理解能力有限，而通用 Audio-LLM 缺乏针对性的副语言建模能力。论文旨在构建一个专门针对英语及东南亚语言的鲁棒语音性别识别模型，并验证将副语言信息注入 Audio-LLM 的有效性。
AI.method: 模型架构包含三部分：(1) 预训练 MERaLiON-SpeechEncoder-2 Conformer 编码器作为主干，在其注意投影层插入 LoRA（rank=16, scaling=16，采用 rsLoRA 归一化，dropout=0.05）实现参数高效微调；(2) 层注意力聚合模块，对 25 层隐状态（含输入嵌入和 24 个 Transformer 层）的均值表示进行软注意力加权融合；(3) 多尺度 ECAPA-TDNN 下游网络（投影到 512 维，三个 SE-Res2Net 块扩张率 1/2/3，SE 缩减因子 8，使用 GroupNorm），通过注意力池化得到 256 维嵌入，最终经 RMSNorm+GELU 激活的线性头映射到 2 类。训练数据包括 VoxCeleb1 和 IMDA PART1–5（含新加坡英语的提示朗读、口语对话、代码切换、风格化语音）；采用基于有效样本数的类别平衡加权交叉熵损失，余弦学习率调度，标签平滑 ϵ=0.1，并在单卡 H100 上训练 15 个 epoch。评估涵盖 SG-ECMT 内部数据集与 15 个公开多语言基准。
AI.result: 在 15 个公开基准上，MERaLiON-GR 在 12 个数据集上超越 Vox-Profile，其中在英语 FLEURS、泰米尔 OpenSLR、泰语 Elderly 三个基准上达到 100.00% 准确率；在泰米尔 EmoTa（+4.71 pp）、越南语 Common Voice（+3.14 pp）、印尼语 IndoWave（+3.00 pp）上提升最显著；仅在马来语 SMALDUSC（−4.40 pp）和泰语 THAI-SER（−2.09 pp）上略有下降，归因于领域不匹配。MERaLiON-v2 Audio-LLM 在多数基准上远落后于专用模型。将性别预测注入 Audio-LLM 后（GR-AudioLLM），在越南语 Common Voice（+60.00 pp）、英语 FLEURS（+47.70 pp）、马来语 SMALDUSC（+41.20 pp）、泰米尔 Common Voice（+37.72 pp）上大幅提升。在 SG-ECMT 2 秒片段级评估中，MERaLiON-GR 在四种新加坡语言上一致优于 Vox-Profile，最大提升出现在马来语（+4.32 pp）和泰米尔语（+4.16 pp）。
AI.conclusion: MERaLiON-GR 验证了专用语音编码器配合参数高效微调与 ECAPA-TDNN 下游网络在跨语言性别识别任务中的有效性，相比现有最优专用模型和通用 Audio-LLM 均展现显著优势，且具备良好的短时片段鲁棒性。同时证明了将性别预测作为副语言元数据注入通用 Audio-LLM，能大幅提升其在性别相关问答中的表现，凸显了显式副语言线索对语音-语言理解的关键价值。论文强调了针对副语言任务设计专用语音模型的重要性及其在跨语言泛化中的潜力。

title: ExeCRE: Execution-Consistency Guided Reliability Estimation for Self-Correcting Code Generation
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have made notable progress in code generation, but they still struggle on challenging tasks that require sophisticated algorithms or complex implementations. Recent methods increasingly use code execution as feedback, especially in self-correction pipelines that construct verification signals from generated code. However, these pipelines often depend on supervision signals whose reliability is unknown, which can introduce misleading feedback, unnecessary revisions, and incorrect final answers. To address this issue, we propose ExeCRE, an Execution-Consistency guided code Reliability Estimation framework. Instead of judging candidate code by tests or LLM feedback, ExeCRE estimates code reliability by statistically analyzing consistency patterns in execution outputs over a large number of randomly generated inputs. It collects execution outputs over generated inputs, projects them into consistency signals, and applies the Dawid-Skene model to infer latent code reliability. We integrate ExeCRE into self-correction for code generation. Experiments show that ExeCRE consistently improves both effectiveness and stability, while substantially reducing misleading correction signals. Under GPT-5.2 on LiveCodeBench, the average number of misleading feedback cases on already correct code drops from 113.2 with a representative self-correction baseline to 14.0 with ExeCRE. As an additional study, we apply the same reliability estimation strategy to code-based mathematical reasoning and observe similar benefits. These results suggest that ExeCRE enables more reliable use of generated code in execution-based pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ExeCRE（执行一致性引导的代码可靠性估计框架），通过统计分析多个候选代码在大规模随机输入上的执行一致性模式，并应用 Dawid-Skene 模型推断候选参考代码的潜在可靠性，以解决自纠错代码生成中监督信号可靠性未知的问题。实验表明，ExeCRE 在 LiveCodeBench 上显著提升了生成效果与稳定性，并大幅减少了对已正确代码的误导性修正信号。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在代码生成任务中仍面临复杂算法与实现困难，自纠错流水线依赖代码执行反馈，但参考代码本身可能存在 bug、覆盖不完整或彼此冲突等问题，由此构造的验证信号可靠性未知，会引入误导性反馈、不必要的修改乃至错误的最终答案。因此，需要一种机制显式估计参考代码的可靠性，过滤不可靠的监督信号。
AI.method: ExeCRE 包含三个阶段：(1) 基于 schema 的执行输入构造——通过 LLM 一次提取问题输入的结构化 schema（含类型、范围、依赖关系），利用拓扑排序与基于规则的解析生成大量多样化有效输入；(2) 执行一致性投影——对每个候选代码在多个输入上执行，构建执行输出矩阵，将原始输出投影为基于多数一致性的二元一致性信号，以缩减标注空间；(3) 基于 Dawid-Skene EM 的可靠性估计——将输入视为项目、候选代码视为标注者，从二元一致性信号中联合推断每个代码的潜在错误率与每个输入的潜在一致性状态，最终通过 αⱼ = p̂₁π̂⁽ʲ⁾₁,₁ + p̂₀π̂⁽ʲ⁾₀,₀ 得到可靠性分数，并据此选择可靠参考代码或触发回退。该机制被集成到测试驱动的自纠错流水线中，仅使用通过阈值的参考代码构造验证测试。
AI.result: 在 LiveCodeBench v6（182 道题）上，ExeCRE 在 GPT-5.2、DeepSeek-V3.2、Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct 与 LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct 四种模型上均取得最佳 Pass@1（分别为 72.8、55.4、32.5、21.0），在中等和困难问题上提升尤为显著；可靠性识别的 F1 最高达 78.12%（GPT-5.2）；在 GPT-5.2 上，针对已正确代码的误导性反馈数量从 TextGrad 的 113.2 降至 14.0；自纠错迭代曲线更稳定，无早期退化。框架对可靠性阈值与输入构造方式均较鲁棒，错误候选聚集时错误采用率仍控制在 3.1%–14.3%。在 GSM8K 的额外适用性研究中，ExeCRE 使 Qwen-32B 准确率从 90.28% 提升至 92.96%，LLaMA-8B 从 75.16% 提升至 78.85%。
AI.conclusion: 执行一致性是一种有效且通用的可靠性信号，ExeCRE 通过 Dawid-Skene 模型从执行行为中推断候选参考代码的潜在可靠性，能够在不依赖隐藏测试或 LLM 判断的前提下识别更可靠的代码，减少误导性监督，提升自纠错的效果与稳定性。该机制在代码生成与基于代码的数学推理场景中均显示出价值，为基于执行的流水线中更可靠地使用生成代码提供了新的思路。未来工作可将该方法扩展至仓库级代码生成与有状态的编码智能体工作流。

title: D$^2$F-ReAG: Dynamic Decomposition and Filtering for Multi-Hop Reasoning-Augmented Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often generate inaccurate answers due to their reliance on static internal knowledge. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) addresses this limitation by integrating external knowledge and excelling at single-hop queries. However, it struggles with multi-hop questions that require cross-document reasoning. Existing methods, such as graph structured RAG or question decomposition, often lack dynamic decomposition and effective filtering, which leads to lower efficiency and accuracy. To overcome these limitations, we propose Dynamic Decomposition and Filtering for Multi-Hop Reasoning-Augmented Generation (D2F-ReAG), a novel paradigm that adaptively controls reasoning depth by judging the reliability of the root-level reasoning. If the root reasoning is reliable, the model directly generates the answer. Otherwise, the question is logically decomposed into sub-questions, and the verified reasoning derived from these sub-questions is used to refine the root reasoning. Experiments on three multi-hop benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in handling complex multi-hop questions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了D²F-ReAG框架，通过可靠性驱动的动态分解与过滤机制解决多跳推理中固定分解粒度和错误累积的问题。该方法根据根问题推理的可靠性判断，自适应地控制分解深度，并利用已验证的子问题推理路径反向优化根推理。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG方法在多跳问答中存在两大瓶颈：1）基于图结构的RAG（如GraphRAG、LightRAG）依赖预构建图谱，构建维护成本高且难以适应动态知识更新；2）基于提示的方法（如LogicRAG、ChainRAG）采用固定粒度的查询分解，简单问题被过度分解而复杂问题分解不足，且迭代压缩会累积噪声和错误。这导致多跳推理效率与准确性受限。
AI.method: D²F-ReAG框架包含四个阶段：(I) 检索与生成——使用稠密检索器（如all-MiniLM-L6-v2）取top-k文档并生成推理；(II) 可靠性判断——LLM按多维度评分（取值[0,10]，阈值θ=7）评估推理可靠性；(III) 分解与重写——仅当推理不可靠时触发分解，并基于已验证结果重写后续子问题；(IV) ReAG——检查子问题与根问题的相关性，将可靠且相关的子问题推理路径整合更新到根推理中。引入早停策略以避免过度分解。实验使用GPT-4o-mini作为生成器，在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue三个基准上以Str-Acc和LLM-Acc为指标进行评估。
AI.result: 在三个多跳基准测试中，D²F-ReAG均取得最优或接近最优性能：HotpotQA上LLM-Acc达63.4（最优），2Wiki上Str-Acc/LLM-Acc分别达70.3/68.9（最优），MuSiQue上达32.2/37.9（最优）。相比最强提示基线LogicRAG，在2Wiki上Str-Acc提升5.4点、LLM-Acc提升6.4点。消融实验显示无分解（No D）版本在2Wiki上效率最高（9.49秒/2267 token），而始终分解（+D）版本耗时73.54秒/13321 token，证明按需分解显著优于固定分解策略。案例分析表明该方法能通过分解子问题纠正根推理中的中间错误（如正确获取两位导演的死亡日期并进行有效比较）。
AI.conclusion: D²F-ReAG通过可靠性驱动的动态分解与选择性过滤，有效缓解了多跳RAG中固定分解粒度和错误传播两大核心问题，在性能与效率之间取得了良好平衡，为处理复杂多跳问答提供了一种更接近人类推理的自适应方案。

title: Tropical Algebraic Geometry for Neuronal Representations: An Arakelov-Green Measure Based Descriptor for Graph Learning
summary: The quantitative analysis of 3D neuronal morphologies requires capturing both graph topology and spatial geometry. Current message-passing Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are bounded by the 1-Weisfeiler-Lehman (1-WL) test, limiting their ability to capture cycles induced by spatial proximities. To address this, we propose a training-free geometric prior based on tropical algebraic geometry. We apply the recently established tropical Abel-Jacobi transform and polarization distances to machine learning on tree-structured data. We introduce a structural transformation pipeline, comprising cycle space augmentation and quotient space construction, to convert spatial trees into cyclic metric graphs suitable for embedding into the Tropical Jacobian. Computing exact tropical polarization distances requires solving the NP-Hard Closest Vector Problem (CVP) on integer lattices. Instead of relying on explicit approximations with quantization errors (e.g., Babai's rounding), we adopt a continuous relaxation on the universal cover of the Albanese torus. We show that the discrete Arakelov-Green measure, computed in closed form via the graph Laplacian's generalized inverse, decomposes exactly into the intrinsic path metric minus the unquantized polarization distance on this cover, avoiding integer lattice searches. This metric yields two descriptors: eigenvectors provide node-level structural coordinates, and the permutation-invariant eigenvalue spectrum provides a graph-level signature. On the BREC benchmark, the eigenvector formulation demonstrates expressivity beyond the 1-WL limit. On 3D morphology datasets (ACT-4, JML-4, BIL-6), the spectrum seamlessly integrates into standard architectures (VAEs, GNNs, Tree-LSTMs) without additional trainable parameters, outperforming explicit lattice approximations and improving classification accuracy over existing spatial models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于热带代数几何的**训练无关**结构先验方法，将3D神经元形态学建模为度量图，通过热带Abel-Jacobi变换和Arakelov-Green测度提取图结构描述符。该方法通过循环空间增广和商空间构造将空间树转换为循环度量图，并在Albanese环面的万有覆盖上连续求解，绕开了NP困难的格上最近向量问题(CVP)。提取的特征向量超越1-WL表达力界限，特征值谱作为置换不变签名可直接集成到现有架构中。
AI.motivation: 1. 3D神经元形态学的定量分析需要同时捕获图拓扑和空间几何信息，而当前消息传递GNN受限于1-Weisfeiler-Lehman (1-WL) 测试，无法捕获由空间邻近性诱导的循环结构。2. 现有TDA方法通过核密度估计将持久化图转化为图像，改变了原始路径距离，阻碍精确节点级对齐。3. 精确计算热带极化距离需要在整数格上求解NP困难的CVP问题，传统的Babai舍入近似引入量化误差。4. 现有模型要么忽略空间信息（序列/树模型），要么丢弃精确路径距离（点云模型）。
AI.method: 1. **结构变换管道**：(a) Kron归约消除2价节点，保留内在路径度量；(b) 循环空间增广——在根节点与空间邻近叶节点（距离阈值ε内）之间添加边，使第一Betti数β₁>0；(c) 商空间构造——将短终端桥边（长度小于τ）的亲和度设为无穷大，使其收缩为单一顶点。2. **连续松弛**：在万有覆盖ℝᵍ上计算离散Arakelov-Green测度M_AG = L⁺ₓₓ + L⁺ᵧᵧ - 2L⁺ₓᵧ，其中L⁺为图拉普拉斯算子的Moore-Penrose伪逆。3. **代数分解**：通过离散Hodge正交分解，证明M_AG精确分解为内在路径度量减去ℝᵍ上的无量化极化距离：M_AG(x,y) = ‖p_xy‖²_W⁻¹ - (ΔΦ_xy)ᵀ Q⁻¹ (ΔΦ_xy)。4. **谱特征提取**：提取M_AG的Top-K绝对特征值作为置换不变图级签名𝒮_Γ ∈ ℝᴷ，或提取特征向量作为节点级结构坐标。
AI.result: 1. **BREC基准测试**：AG-GIN达到70.0%的图对区分准确率，超越标准1-WL消息传递，在Basic和Extension类别达100%，CFI类别达33.0%（优于PPGN的23.0%和I²-GNN的21.0%）。2. **3D形态学数据集**：TreeLSTM(+ AG Prior)在ACT-4、JML-4、BIL-6上分别达到69.68%、74.29%、93.55%，参数数量不到TreeMoCo的三分之一；MorphVAE(+ AG Prior)在BIL-6上提升+20.25%；MorphoGNN(+ AG)在JML-4上提升+11.17%。3. **效率提升**：连续评估相比显式CVP近似，预处理速度提升4.1×-6.5×，且避免了量化误差。4. **消融实验**：ε=50.0, τ=10.0组合在ACT-4和BIL-6上达到最高判别性，验证了循环增广和商空间收缩的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将热带代数几何从纯数学领域引入到3D神经元形态学的机器学习任务中。通过在Albanese环面万有覆盖上的连续松弛，将NP困难的CVP问题转化为可通过图拉普拉斯伪逆闭式求解的代数运算，消除了传统离散格近似的量化误差和基依赖性。Arakelov-Green测度作为训练无关的几何先验，提供了：(1) 超越1-WL表达力界限的节点级特征向量描述符；(2) 可无缝集成到MLP、GNN、Tree-LSTM等标准架构的图级置换不变谱签名，无需额外可训练参数。该框架为图表示学习提供了新的代数几何视角，未来可探索基于万有覆盖距离矩阵的消息传递算子设计。

title: Beyond Linear Dynamics: Neural Bilinear Dynamical Models for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time series in real-world applications are often generated by nonlinear dynamical systems, making accurate forecasting challenging. Existing approaches that explicitly model system dynamics typically rely on linear assumptions or Koopman-based linearizations, which may inadequately capture complex nonlinear behaviors and lead to error accumulation in long-horizon prediction. To address this limitation, we propose the Neural Bilinear Dynamical Model (NBDM), which models nonlinear system dynamics through a bilinear latent dynamical formulation. Specifically, NBDM leverages Koopman theory to lift the original nonlinear dynamics into a higher-dimensional latent space, where a bilinear dynamical model is constructed to characterize state evolution. To mitigate the approximation error introduced by bilinear representations, we further incorporate a parameterized error compensation term. Within this formulation, control inputs are explicitly integrated into the dynamics, using auxiliary variables when available and learned feedback signals otherwise. To handle scenarios with missing control inputs, we design a memory-enhanced controller that infers latent controls through multiplicative interactions between historical states and control signals. Experiments on five real-world datasets demonstrate that NBDM consistently outperforms competitive baselines in both given-control and missing-control settings, particularly for multi-step and long-horizon forecasting.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于双线性动力学的神经预测模型NBDM，结合Koopman理论在潜在空间中构建双线性状态演化，并引入参数化误差补偿和记忆增强控制器，在给定控制和缺失控制两种场景下均显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列预测方法要么采用隐式黑箱深度模型缺乏动力学结构，要么依赖线性或Koopman线性化假设，难以捕捉复杂非线性动态和状态-控制间的乘性交互，导致多步/长程预测中误差累积严重。同时，许多现实系统缺乏显式控制输入，限制了对系统动力学的完整建模。
AI.method: NBDM包含三个核心组件：1）双线性动态传播模块，在Koopman潜在空间中构建包含线性项、控制驱动项和状态-控制双线性交互项的动力学方程；2）Koopman算子生成模块，利用DMD提取全局动力学先验并结合MLP自适应生成状态依赖的算子矩阵；3）反馈控制器，使用辅助变量或通过历史状态与控制信号的乘性交互推断潜在控制信号；4）参数化误差补偿项ζ缓解双线性近似误差。损失函数采用MSE。
AI.result: 在气候（Temperature）、空气质量（Seoul PM2.5）和交通（PeMS-Bay/04/08）共5个真实数据集上的实验表明，NBDM在给定控制和缺失控制两种设置下均一致优于DeepKoopman、Koopa、DDGCRN、PDG2Seq、SFGDE、iTransformer、SimpleTM、TimeMixer等基线。在PeMS04数据集10步预测上，NBDM相对Koopa的RMSE降低约52%、MAE降低约62%。消融实验证实双线性项、误差补偿项和记忆增强控制器均对性能有显著贡献。控制器在噪声注入实验中也表现出强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过在Koopman潜在空间中显式建模双线性状态-控制交互，并辅以参数化误差补偿和记忆增强控制推断机制，NBDM成功统一了给定控制和缺失控制两种场景下的非线性动力学建模，显著提升多步长程预测精度和稳定性。未来工作将拓展到更一般非线性动力学、不确定性感知控制推断以及更复杂动力系统建模。

title: AFD-Ledger: Deployment Provisioning for Attention--FFN Disaggregation
summary: Attention--Feed-Forward Network (FFN) Disaggregation (AFD) is emerging as a promising architecture for serving Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models. While existing AFD systems improve the efficiency of disaggregated execution, they leave a deployment question unanswered: under the same model, workload, time-per-output-token (TPOT) service-level objective (SLO), hardware budget, hardware catalog, and runtime capabilities, does AFD provide higher throughput than the best collocated deployment? Answering this question requires jointly optimizing hardware assignment and deployment organization for both architectures, making exhaustive provisioning prohibitively expensive. We present AFD-Ledger, an offline analytical provisioning system that independently provisions AFD and collocated deployments using an analytical execution model and an evaluation-bounded hardware search. Across deployment spaces where exhaustive provisioning is feasible, AFD-Ledger reduces complete deployment evaluations by 68.8%--83.5% while still recovering the globally optimal deployment. On three physical LongCat 2.0 deployments, it preserves the correct architecture decision while predicting AFD-to-collocated throughput within 6.6%--9.6% of measurement. Using this validated framework, we show that homogeneous AFD improves fixed-budget throughput in only a minority of the studied settings, heterogeneous AFD requires deployment-level hardware complementarity rather than heuristic device selection, and role-specific hardware improvements matter primarily when they enable better deployment organizations by crossing deployment capability--price boundaries.

AI.tldr: AFD-Ledger 是一个离线分析式的部署供给系统,用于在固定预算和服务等级目标(SLO)约束下,通过联合优化硬件分配与部署组织,系统性地比较 Attention–FFN 解聚(AFD)与共置(collocated)两种 MoE 大模型推理架构的吞吐量优劣。
AI.motivation: 现有 AFD 系统(如 FastAFD、MegaScale-Infer 等)聚焦于执行机制层面的优化(FFN MFU、KV 容量、调度、通信等),但回答的是不同的问题。关键未解决的问题是:在相同的模型、工作负载、TPOT SLO、硬件预算、硬件目录与运行时能力条件下,AFD 是否真的比最优共置部署提供更高的吞吐量?此外,现有的解析式供给系统通常假定硬件池已固定,无法将硬件选型纳入供给搜索。该文引入"承载请求容量税(request-bearing-capacity tax)"的概念,指出 AFD 的局部收益必须在完整预算核算下偿还将部分 GPU 转为 FFN-only worker 所损失的请求承载能力。
AI.method: 1. **固定预算账本(Performance Ledger)**:稳态解码吞吐量公式 Θ = N_r·b/T,其中 N_r 为承载请求 GPU 数、b 为每 GPU 常驻请求数、T 为 TPOT;比较 AFD 与共置即比较 N_r、b、T 三个因子之积。 2. **两层级供给策略**:(a) 基于角色专用(attention / expert)的轻量级硬件估计(含最小内存校验、代表探测批次的服务率、价格归一化)对候选硬件配对打分排序;(b) 仅对少量有前景的硬件分配执行完整部署供给。 3. **目录导航器(Catalog Navigator)**:首轮保留每角色代表设备(最便宜、最高服务率、最高性价比、最高内存性价比),按调和平均调和分排序;反馈驱动的局部细化(每次替换一侧设备,保留多样化的角色组合)加末轮全局未评估配对补全,确保不陷于局部。 4. **一致部署供给**:AFD 与共置共享同一解析执行模型(内存检查、TPOT 估计、调度构建、吞吐计算),仅枚举变量不同——AFD 增加 attention/expert worker 划分与流水线深度。 5. **形式化部署规格**:Ω = (M, W, τ, B, ℋ, Γ),分别表示模型、工作负载、TPOT SLO、预算、硬件目录与共享部署假设;比较目标为 Θ_C* 与 Θ_A*。 6. **物理验证**:在 LongCat 2.0 上实现完整 AFD 运行时(>8000 行 Python+AscendC 代码)进行端到端验证。
AI.result: **系统效率**:在可穷举的部署空间中,AFD-Ledger 将完整部署评估次数减少 68.8%–83.5%(Catalog E 从 64 降至 20;Catalog S 从 121 降至 20),且仍恢复全局最优。**物理验证**:在 3 个 LongCat 2.0 实测中,AFD-Ledger 正确选择架构决策,AFD/共置吞吐比误差仅 6.6%–9.6%。**部署洞察**:(1) **同构 AFD**:36 个 E-grid 设置中仅 7 次被选中(DeepSeek 0/18、Qwen 7/18),仅当专家内存释放、批次增大与更低 TPOT 能完全偿还请求承载容量税时才获胜。(2) **异构 AFD**:在 D/E 与 Q/E 参考用例中,DeepSeek 上 H200 attention + A100 PCIe expert 达 1.815×,Qwen 上 H200 + L40S 达 1.823×;但同一硬件配对在不同 TPOT/预算下吞吐比在 0.483×–1.815× 间剧变,表明硬件互补性需完整部署供给后才显现。(3) **角色专用硬件**:模拟 attention/expert 专用设备时,AFD 在 S-sweep 上吞吐提升 16.39×–52.07×(DeepSeek)与 17.92×–31.12×(Qwen);代表性 D/S12 用例通过将副本数从 1 增至 3,实现 19.59× 提升,说明硬件改进的价值在于其能否跨越"能力-价格边界"以解锁更优部署组织。**稳健性**:在 ≈10% 额外运行时开销下 AFD 决策仍稳健,≈20% 开销则切回共置;降低设备成本或增大内存容量的影响远大于单纯提升计算或带宽。
AI.conclusion: AFD 的局部与角色专用收益只有在完整部署供给框架下才能转化为整体吞吐增益。该文主张:系统架构应通过"在共同供给规格下各自独立优化"的部署供给方法学进行比较,而非手动挑选的固定配置对比。AFD-Ledger 的硬件探索与对比框架可推广至任何能在共同规格下供给的新架构(只需添加架构特定的枚举器与性能模型)。主要局限性:解析性能模型刻意省略实现级开销(内核缺失、调度延迟、网络争用),更大硬件目录可能需要更精细的搜索策略;未来硬件研究评估的是假设性能点而非商业产品预测。

title: A Model Merging Approach for Continual MLLM Unlearning
summary: Multimodal large language model (MLLM) unlearning methods have been proposed to remove private, sensitive, or proprietary information from well-trained models. However, most existing MLLM unlearning methods are designed for one-shot requests and fail to adequately address continual scenarios, as repeatedly applying one-shot operations leads to cumulative utility degradation, unlearning rebound, and retention drift. We introduce Merging for Continual Unlearning (MCU), an approach that dynamically merges multiple one-shot unlearning adapters into a unified adapter upon receiving each new unlearning this http URL a leave-one-out merging analysis, we reveal that these unlearning adapters exhibit strong cross-task dependencies. Such dependencies have two contrasting effects: they can facilitate cross-task unlearning transferability, but they can also introduce severe interference that degrades unlearning effectiveness and compromises retained knowledge. To address this challenge, MCU projects the adapters into a shared representation space, preserves their dominant directions, suppresses over-concentrated coordinates, and reconfigures cross-task dependencies to mitigate interference while enhancing transferability. Experiments on ICU-Bench and MLLMU-Bench demonstrate that MCU achieves superior unlearning effectiveness while preserving both retained knowledge and general multimodal utility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MCU（Merging for Continual Unlearning），一种基于模型合并的持续多模态大语言模型（MLLM）遗忘方法，通过将多个一次性遗忘适配器动态合并为统一适配器来解决持续遗忘场景中反复执行一次性操作导致的效用累积退化、遗忘回弹和保留漂移问题。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM遗忘方法主要面向一次性请求设计，在持续遗忘场景中反复应用一次性操作会导致：(1)遗忘效果回弹（unlearning rebound），(2)保留知识漂移（retention drift），(3)累积效用退化。核心挑战是如何在不断扩展的删除请求序列中，既保持历史遗忘效果，又维持通用多模态能力。
AI.method: MCU将每个任务特定的遗忘LoRA适配器视为任务向量，在共享核心空间中进行合并。具体包含四个核心步骤：(1) 共享核心空间投影——通过拼接所有适配器的左右LoRA因子构建正交基，将适配器映射到低维共享空间；(2) 主导方向选择——保留每个核心更新的前k个奇异分量（前4个保留74.1%能量，前6个保留89.6%）；(3) 通道容量控制——通过软行容量约束抑制过度集中的坐标（99百分位行范数是中位数的3.5倍）；(4) 依赖感知方向重构——通过求解带约束的Gram矩阵优化问题（非负跨请求相似性、秩约束、请求内正交性），使用交替投影近似求解，再通过正交Procrustes恢复方向矩阵，最终合并并映射回原始参数空间。leave-one-out分析揭示了一次性遗忘适配器之间存在显著的跨任务依赖（U侧重叠是V侧的6.6倍），既有协同效应也有干扰效应。
AI.result: 在ICU-Bench（100任务）和MLLMU-Bench（5阶段）上的实验表明：MCU在Qwen2-VL-7B和LLaVA-1.5-7B上均显著优于GA、GA-Diff、KL-Min、NPO、MANU、MMUnlearner等顺序遗忘方法以及Task Arithmetic、TIES、DARE、TSV、Core Space等合并方法。在100任务时，MCU在Qwen2-VL-7B上取得Forget VQA/QA 28.7/30.9与Retain VQA/QA 75.6/75.2，相比MMUnlearner在Forget上降低4.6/7.6点、Retain提升32.9/28.7点。序列级稳定性指标FR和RSR分别为1.12和1.10。外部VQAv2 val-lite效用评估中，MCU在100任务时仍保持76.8准确率（与vanilla相同）。组件消融验证了方向选择、容量控制和依赖感知重构三者的互补作用。MCU还表现出对请求顺序的不敏感性（原始/逆序/随机顺序结果完全一致）。
AI.conclusion: MCU通过模型合并框架有效解决了持续多模态遗忘问题，揭示了一次性遗忘适配器间的跨任务依赖既可支持有益的遗忘迁移也可能引入干扰。MCU保留有益共享结构的同时抑制有害干扰，实现了有效的当前和历史遗忘，同时保持保留知识和通用多模态效用。作为无需梯度优化的训练后合并过程，MCU在CPU上即可完成合并（100适配器约242秒），且合并后模型大小独立于请求数量，为持续MLLM遗忘提供了高效实用的解决方案。

title: EuroExec: Frontier Language Models Fall Short of Expert Judgment on European Executive Decision Tasks
comment: 16 pages, 9 figures, 12 tables, submitted to EACL 2027
summary: Frontier LLMs are increasingly put to use on open-ended complex questions, different in nature from the ones they are typically evaluated on. We dedicate more than 4,000 human expert hours to evaluate a selection of six frontier LLMs on a member of this class of problems: EuroExec, our introduced human expert-based benchmark composed of 413 open-ended long-form European executive tasks authored by 47 vetted domain experts, each question drawn from experience in a real case. Every response is manually evaluated through a multi-attribute rubric, an item-specific checklist of requirements, and a preference rank ordering, extracting an aggregate metric "Solve Rate". The strongest model solves only 56.9% of tasks, while expert-written reference answers judged blindly are solved at near-ceiling levels and are preferred over every model response in 74% of direct rankings, placing frontier generative systems well below the professional standard of work they are already used for. We see that the best way to extract this kind of conclusion is by employing human evaluators, carefully checking their consistency through rigorous statistical analysis, and observe that automatic measurements also fall short when evaluating on this case of real-world open-ended problems with a subjective ground truth.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个由47位欧洲领域专家编写的、包含413道开放式长篇行政决策任务的专家级基准测试EuroEval,用于评估6个前沿大语言模型。最佳模型Fable 5的解题率仅56.9%,而人类专家以92.4%的解题率获胜,并在74%的直接比较中优于所有模型输出。
AI.motivation: 前沿大语言模型越来越多地用于开放式复杂任务,而现有评估方法主要依赖客观确定性的指标(选择题、有标准答案的任务等),无法反映LLM的实际应用场景。此外,公共基准可能存在数据污染问题,而LLM作为评判者的可靠性尚未经过真正的专家评估验证。因此需要一个基于人类专家的开放性任务评估方法。
AI.method: 构建包含413个开放式长篇问题的EuroExec基准,问题由47位经验丰富的领域专家(覆盖金融、营销、商业、产品四个领域)编写,每个问题配有5-10项核查清单要求。问题经过自动质量检查和难度门槛两层验证流程。评估6个前沿LLM(Fable 5、Claude Opus 4.8、GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.1 Pro、GLM-5.2、Mistral Large),使用三种评估工具:5属性通用评分量表、项目特定核查清单、偏好排序。每个回答由两位领域专家独立评分,共投入4000多小时人工评估。引入"解题率"综合指标,并与ROUGE、BLEU和LLM评判者(DeepSeek v4-Pro)进行对比。
AI.result: 人类专家解题率92.4%,在74%的直接比较中胜出。最佳模型Fable 5解题率仅56.9%,GPT-5.5为51.3%。所有模型在推理能力上表现最弱,而在本地化和沟通方面较强。所有成对排序均具有极高统计显著性(p值范围1.26e-6到9.2e-23),150个问题足以建立可靠排序。核查清单完成率和评分量表之间存在强相关(Pearson r=0.69)。评估者内部一致性显著高于跨评估者一致性。ROUGE/BLEU与人类评分相关性弱且无法反映模型排序。LLM评判者虽与人类评估者相关性高,但存在过度评估最佳模型、过度低估最差模型的偏差,产生过于"清晰"的评估结果。
AI.conclusion: 前沿大语言模型仍未达到专业行政决策任务所需的标准,即使在最宽松的通过条件下,表现最好的模型也只能勉强达到50%的解题率,而人类专家则以超过90%的解题率轻松达标。对于开放式真实世界任务,人类专家评估仍然优于任何自动评估方法。ROUGE/BLEU等确定性指标和LLM评判者都无法复制人类评估的细微差别和异质性。局限性包括:高昂的人工成本限制了可重复性、仅33个问题有专家参考答案、未能进行定性失败模式分析、未测试数据质量问题。

title: Breaking the Curse ofMultilinguality inMany-to-Many Speech-to-Text Translation via a Resource-AwareMixture of Speech Encoders
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved significant success in speech-to-text translation (S2TT). However, when processing multilingual speech inputs, a single speech encoder shared across all languages suffers from the curse of multilinguality: languages at different resource levels compete for limited representation capacity, leading to strong high-resource performance but substantial degradation on low-resource speech. To address this problem and improve multilingual consistency, we propose MSRT, a novel framework built around a resource-aware Mixture of Speech Encoders (MoSE). MoSE uses an explicit language router to assign each utterance to an appropriate expert encoder. A frozen expert preserves high-resource language capabilities, while a trainable expert adapts to and specializes in medium- and low-resource languages. We further introduce a five-stage curriculum learning strategy that substantially reduces data dependence, requiring only 10 hours of paired S2TT data per language for effective alignment. We conduct extensive experiments on 45 languages, systematically evaluating all $45 \times 44$ translation directions. Our 4B-parameter model achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming substantially larger baselines. Empirical analyses show that MoSE improves high-, medium-, and low-resource languages simultaneously, with the largest gains on low-resource speech, thereby breaking the curse of multilinguality without compromising high-resource performance. To support future multilingual S2TT research, we release our code and models.

AI.tldr: MSRT是一个4B参数的多对多语音翻译框架，通过资源感知的语音编码器混合（MoSE）架构解决多语言诅咒问题。两个同构Whisper编码器分别承担不同角色：冻结专家保留高资源语言能力，可训练专家专门适应中低资源语言。结合五阶段课程学习策略，每个语言仅需10小时配对数据，在45种语言的1980个翻译方向上实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在多语言语音翻译中面临"多语言诅咒"问题：单一共享语音编码器难以同时处理高、中、低资源语言，导致高资源语言表现良好但低资源语言性能严重下降。现有多语言MLLMs仍以英语为中心，在非英语语音到非英语文本的翻译中表现欠佳，跨语言一致性不足。
AI.method: 提出MSRT框架，核心是资源感知的语音编码器混合（MoSE）：（1）冻结专家Ef处理高资源语言，保留预训练声学知识；（2）可训练专家Et专门适应中低资源语言；（3）显式语言路由器根据源语言token分配专家。配合五阶段课程学习：Stage I多语言ASR对齐 → Stage II专家专门化 → Stage III翻译激活（SMT）→ Stage IV端到端SRT → Stage V联合适配（启用LLM LoRA）。使用MiLMMT-4B作为LLM，Q-Former+MLP作为语音适配器。
AI.result: MSRT-4B在FLEURS所有45×44=1980个翻译方向上的平均COMET得分83.3，超越Gemini-3.5-Flash-Lite API（80.0）、MCAT-27B（80.9）、Qwen3-Omni-30B（77.5）等基线。COMET≥80的方向达1552个（78.4%），远优于MCAT-27B的1232个和Gemini的928个。消融实验显示MoSE在低、中、高资源语言上分别提升3.0、2.2、1.4 COMET分数。英语到44方向平均87.9分。在CoVoST-2上仅用7.5小时FLEURS数据即可零样本迁移，扩展到429.6小时数据后平均提升至85.3。
AI.conclusion: MoSE通过资源感知的专家分工成功打破多语言诅咒，在不牺牲高资源性能的前提下显著提升低资源语言翻译。MSRT-4B以紧凑的参数量实现了跨45种语言、11个语系的鲁棒多对多翻译，验证了资源感知架构设计在多语言语音翻译中的有效性。未来工作将扩展至更广泛的语言覆盖。

title: EASy: Towards Efficient LLM-Based Agentic System
summary: Agentic systems have emerged as a promising paradigm for solving complex tasks by coordinating specialized LLM-based agents. However, most existing systems primarily optimize task success while giving limited consideration to execution efficiency under practical constraints such as executor capability and computational cost. Existing router-based methods have limited ability to reason over rich, evolving task contexts, multi-step dependencies, and intermediate execution feedback, and often generalize poorly to unseen executors. We propose EASy, a trainable agentic framework that jointly optimizes task performance and computational efficiency through reinforcement learning. EASy equips an LLM-based orchestrator with explicit knowledge of the capability and cost profiles of heterogeneous executors, enabling context-sensitive coordination beyond performance-only routing. It further introduces a milestone-plan-act workflow that decomposes complex tasks into manageable milestones, constructs dependency-aware execution graphs, assigns suitable executors, and parallelizes independent steps while adapting subsequent decisions to intermediate outcomes. To train the orchestrator, we develop a tree-structured rollout procedure that explores alternative milestone decompositions and execution plans, together with multi-component rewards that capture task correctness, execution efficiency, and trajectory completeness. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning, embodied decision-making, and deep research benchmarks show that EASy consistently achieves stronger performance-efficiency trade-offs than strong agentic baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EASy，一种基于强化学习的可训练智能体编排框架，通过"里程碑-规划-执行"工作流与树结构化探索，同时优化任务性能与计算效率，在数学推理、具身决策和深度研究任务上优于现有主流智能体系统。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体系统主要优化任务成功率，忽视执行效率（执行器能力与计算成本）；基于路由的方法难以处理丰富演变的任务上下文、多步依赖与中间反馈，且对未见过的执行器泛化能力差。需训练一种能在性能-效率权衡下做上下文敏感决策的LLM编排器。
AI.method: 1) 能力-成本感知的LLM编排器，观察异构执行器池（能力、成本、工具集）；2) "里程碑-规划-执行"工作流：任务分解为可验证里程碑 → 构建DAG执行图（含依赖与并行） → 分配执行器 → 聚合里程碑结果反馈下一步；3) 树结构化展开（forest初始化 + 决策分支）探索不同里程碑分解与执行方案；4) 多组件奖励：正确性奖励（Beta后验比较）、效率奖励（同级分支相对成本）、完整性奖励（格式/可执行性）；5) 使用GRPO进行策略优化。
AI.result: 在AIME24/25、MATH500、ALFWorld、WebShop、GAIA、HLE六大基准上，EASy在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct与GPT-5-mini两种执行器配置下均全面超越Direct Reasoning、ReAct、AutoGen、Reflexion、Plan-and-Act、AgentFlow、MasRouter等基线（如GPT-5-mini下AIME24: 73.2 vs 69.4，HLE: 26.2 vs 23.6），且token效率最高。消融实验证明树结构化展开、决策分支、效率奖励均不可或缺；模型选择分析显示编排器学会了任务自适应的能力-成本权衡策略（数学/研究任务偏好低成本Agent A，具身任务偏好高成本Agent B）；可泛化至未见过的执行器配置（3执行器池、细粒度能力描述）。
AI.conclusion: EASy通过能力-成本感知编排、里程碑级抽象、树结构化探索与多组件奖励设计，有效解决了智能体系统中性能-效率联合优化难题，在多领域任务上取得了更强的性能-效率权衡。局限性在于效率指标主要衡量token消耗，且树结构化训练开销较大，未来工作将探索更全面的效率度量与选择性扩展策略。

title: When Absence Is Evidence: Evaluating Completeness-Sensitive Negative Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are often asked whether something is absent from a record, list, or retrieved context. Yet non-observation licenses a negative answer only when evidence completely covers the query scope; otherwise, the answer should remain unknown. We call this completeness-sensitive negative reasoning. We introduce CROWN-QA, comprising CROWN-Synth, a controlled paired core that fixes the question and observed facts while varying only query-relative coverage, and CROWN-Real, a real-document contrast-set evaluation with controlled coverage variants. Across three LLM families, models show unstable closure judgments and substantial over-closure, failing to reliably distinguish a justified negative answer (Certified-Negative) from insufficient evidence (Unknown). The dominant CROWN-Synth failure is asymmetric: models often recognize implicitly complete evidence yet treat implicitly partial evidence as query-covering. Prompting redistributes errors between over- and under-closure rather than consistently resolving them. Structured certificate elicitation traces many errors to evidence-coverage mischaracterization. CROWN-Real shows that the core partial-coverage asymmetry persists on real-document content, while its strength and the balance between over- and under-closure vary by model, prompt, and source.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大语言模型在"证据缺失型否定推理"（即未观察到某事实是否足以得出否定回答）上的判断能力进行研究，提出 CROWN-QA 基准，涵盖合成受控配对核心（CROWN-Synth）与真实文档对照集（CROWN-Real）。研究发现 LLM 普遍存在显著的过度闭合（over-closure）错误，尤其在隐式部分覆盖情境下；提示工程只能在过度闭合与欠闭合间转移错误，无法根除；通过结构化证书分析显示错误最常源自证据覆盖范围的误判。
AI.motivation: 在 RAG 与高风险问答场景中，许多关键问题取决于"某事物是否不在记录/列表中"的回答。仅当证据完全覆盖查询范围时，缺失才可作为否定的依据；否则答案应保持未知。现有评估主要关注正面证据的检索与利用，缺乏对"缺失即证据"这一判断的系统性评测。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 1. 形式化定义：定义 Certified-Negative 与 Unknown 两类标签，基于"证据覆盖查询范围"的布尔函数 Comp(E, S(q))。2. 提出 CROWN-Synth（2,500 对、5,000 条合成数据），通过 L1–L4 覆盖表达层级（显式、改写、隐式、对抗）和 Scope-Mismatch 案例严格配对控制。3. 提出 CROWN-Real（1,599 条、533 组）基于 ACL Anthology 论文集与 DailyMed 药品标签的 A/B/C 对照集。4. 七种提示条件（Naive/Def/Def+CoT/Abstain/Self-check/Cert/Cert+CoT）。5. 指标：OCR、UCR、类别平衡 Acc、配对完整度敏感度 CS。6. 结构化证书诊断查询范围、证据覆盖范围与最终判断三类字段的首错位置。
AI.result: 三大模型族（Qwen3.5-9B、Claude Haiku 4.5、Gemma-4-12B）均呈现不稳定的闭合判断；过度闭合普遍存在，尤其在 L3 隐式源型机制下，模型常将隐式部分证据误判为查询覆盖（部分成员正确率仅 0–27.9%）。显式规则+CoT 可提升整体准确率，但仅在过度闭合与欠闭合间重新分配错误。证书分析显示 45–72% 的错误首发出现在证据覆盖字段 S_E^。CROWN-Real 的 Proceedings 部分证实部分覆盖错误持续存在（C 比 B 更易出错，15 个模型-条件单元中 12 个的差异置信区间排除零）。CROWN-Real 错误大小依模型、提示与来源而异。
AI.conclusion: LLM 在判断"缺失是否足以支撑否定回答"这一完整性敏感型否定推理上存在根本性缺陷：(1) 无法可靠区分 Certified-Negative 与 Unknown，呈现过度闭合倾向；(2) 提示工程只能重新分配错误而非解决根本问题；(3) 错误根源在于对证据覆盖范围的语义化误判，而非仅是最终布尔判断失误；(4) 这一困难在合成与真实文档上均成立。挑战核心在于查询相对覆盖的语义判断，而非简单的缺失检测。

title: Rethinking Reservoir Pruning: A Dynamical Perspective for Echo State Networks
summary: Echo State Networks (ESNs) offer an efficient framework for temporal prediction, but their randomly initialized reservoirs are often over-parameterized and dynamically redundant. Existing pruning methods largely rely on static connectivity or activation statistics, which may overlook neurons that shape input-driven state transitions. We propose Dynamical Mode Pruning (DMP), a reservoir pruning method that ranks neurons by their contribution to dominant transition modes obtained from a trajectory-averaged Jacobian Gramian. DMP removes low-impact units and retrains only the readout. Experiments on chaotic and real-world time-series benchmarks show that DMP improves or preserves forecasting accuracy while reducing redundant reservoir components. Our results suggest that dynamical influence is a useful criterion for reservoir refinement beyond static structural importance alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种名为"动力学模式剪枝"（Dynamical Mode Pruning, DMP）的回声状态网络（ESN）储层剪枝方法。该方法通过构建轨迹平均的雅可比矩阵Gram矩阵来识别主导的输入驱动状态转移模式,并基于神经元对这些模式的贡献度进行排序和剪枝,从而在减少储层冗余的同时保持或改善预测性能。
AI.motivation: ESN的随机初始化储层常常存在过度参数化和动态冗余问题。现有剪枝方法主要依赖静态连通性（图中心性指标）或激活统计量,可能忽略那些对输入驱动状态转移至关重要的神经元。这反映出需要一个数据驱动、考虑输入轨迹动态结构的重要性评估标准,以更有效地识别并保留ESN中真正起作用的神经元。
AI.method: DMP采用一次性结构化剪枝策略:(1)沿驱动轨迹计算每个时刻的局部转移雅可比矩阵 J(t)=(1-a)I+aD(t)W;(2)聚合得到轨迹平均雅可比Gram矩阵 G=(1/T)ΣJ(t)ᵀJ(t);(3)对G进行特征分解,按能量阈值τ(默认0.9)截取主导模式;(4)计算每个神经元的动力学重要性分数 η_i=Σλ̃_k·V_ik²(主导模式下加权参与度);(5)保留Top-N'个高重要性神经元,重训练线性读出层。此外,研究了谱半径重缩放(DMP+ρ)作为消融对比。
AI.result: 在Mackey-Glass混沌时间序列及四个真实世界数据集(电力、温度、风能、太阳能)上的实验表明:(1)固定20%剪枝率时,DMP在所有数据集上均改善或保持预测精度,MSE平均降低3.5%-89.8%;(2)在N=1000→800的受控对比中,DMP在所有数据集上获得最低的平均NRMSE,并优于匹配的随机剪枝;(3)实现约1.90-1.97×的推理加速,模型大小减少35.7%,循环参数量从100万降至64万;(4)20%为最佳剪枝率,30%在部分数据集上会导致性能下降;(5)谱半径重缩放并未带来额外收益,表明无需重缩放的DMP为主推配置。局限性包括O(TN³)的离线计算成本、对储层容量的依赖性,以及一次性分数对激进剪枝的不精确性。
AI.conclusion: DMP提供了一种基于动力学原则的储层精炼视角,将神经元重要性直接关联到输入驱动的状态转移结构,超越了静态连通性或激活统计量的局限。Jacobian-Gramian框架不仅适用于储层剪枝,还可推广至自适应储层构建、任务相关容量选择、瞬态感知评分以及大规模循环系统的可扩展动力学模型约简。未来工作应扩展到多变量预测、分类及时序决策任务。

title: The Order Is the Guarantee: Verifier-Budgeted Code Deletion with Static-First Learned Proposals
summary: Frontier coding models now match or exceed strong human reference points on programming benchmarks, yet benchmark success does not imply maintainable software. Prompt-driven "vibe coding" is additive: new branches, guards, and fallbacks accumulate faster than obsolete logic is removed. We study the inverse problem-how an Al system should remove code when execution-verification capacity is finite. We formulate redundant-code reduction as proposal scheduling: a ranker orders single-statement deletion candidates, an execution suite accepts the first candidate that passes, and a budget bounds how many candidates may be tested. Our central observation is that candidate order, not model confidence, is the control surface a deployment can reason about. DELSCOUT instantiates two schedules. Given representative target-domain validation, a five-slot budget spends three slots on deterministic shortest-first candidates and two on complementary learned candidates; across nine MBPP replications with 0.5B, 0.6B, and 8B rankers this raises verified-deletion coverage by 9.5% relative (+6.7 accepted tasks) while consuming slightly fewer verifier calls than the matched static baseline. Without such validation the same rankers can lose coverage under shift, so we instead evaluate the complete static prefix first and append learned candidates only afterwards; for a deterministic verifier this makes coverage and character reduction non-decreasing by construction, at a measured 4.8-62.5% increase in verifier calls. MBPP+ then erases the in-domain advantage, showing that scheduling governs search while the test suite alone governs what "preserving behavior" means. The result is an auditable division of labor: models widen the search for removable code, order bounds the damage a mis-ranked proposal can do, and execution retains authority over every committed deletion.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究AI系统如何在执行验证能力有限的情况下移除冗余代码，将代码缩减问题形式化为提议调度问题，提出DELSCOUT方法，通过调度策略（而非模型置信度）控制冗余代码删除的顺序与安全性，在MBPP基准上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 前沿编程模型在基准测试上已超越人类基线，但基准成功不代表可维护软件。"氛围编程"(vibe coding)模式下代码呈累加式增长，新分支、守卫和回退逻辑不断堆叠而旧逻辑未被移除，导致软件难以维护。因此需要研究其逆问题：当执行验证能力有限时，AI系统应如何删除冗余代码。
AI.method: 将冗余代码缩减形式化为提议调度问题：由排序器(ranker)对单语句删除候选排序，执行套件(execution suite)接受首个通过的候选，预算(budget)限制可测试的候选数量。核心观点是：候选顺序（而非模型置信度）是部署时可推理的控制面。DELSCOUT实例化了两种调度策略：1）有代表性目标域验证时，5槽预算分配3槽给确定性最短优先候选、2槽给学习型互补候选；2）无域验证时，先评估完整静态前缀，再追加学习型候选，从而保证覆盖率与字符缩减非递减。
AI.result: 在MBPP九次重复实验中，使用0.5B、0.6B和8B排序器：1）有域验证场景：经验证的删除覆盖率相对提升9.5%（+6.7个接受任务），且验证器调用略少于匹配的静态基线；2）无域验证场景：确定性验证器下覆盖率和字符缩减非递减（构造性保证），代价是验证器调用增加4.8%-62.5%；3）MBPP+测试抹平了域内优势，表明调度控制搜索、测试套件决定"行为保持"的含义。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出可审计的分工结论：模型扩展可移除代码的搜索空间，排序约束误排序提议可能造成的损害，执行验证保留对每次已提交删除的最终决定权。调度策略是可解释、可推理的控制面，而非模型置信度。

title: Easy to Complete, Hard to Choose: Investigating LLM Performance on the ProverbIT Benchmark
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed computational linguistics and achieved remarkable performance across numerous natural language processing tasks, yet significant gaps persist in understanding how these systems process culturally embedded linguistic expressions. This paper introduces ProverbIT, a novel Italian benchmark comprising 100 multiple-choice questions designed to evaluate LLMs' ability to complete Italian proverbs. We assess 13 frontier models, including Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) and traditional LLMs, across three tasks: proverb completion, multiple-choice selection with correct answers, and multiple-choice selection without correct answers. Our evaluation reveals surprising results: while nearly all models demonstrate knowledge of the proverbs through successful completion tasks, performance drops dramatically when transitioning to multiple-choice formats without correct answers, with even state-of-the-art reasoning models showing substantial degradation. Through detailed Chain-of-Thought analysis of two LRMs, we uncover that models exhibit a strong bias toward selecting literal synonyms and frequently mention correct proverb endings during reasoning without successfully identifying their absence from the given options. These findings suggest that current LLMs rely heavily on memorized patterns rather than deeper semantic understanding of culturally grounded expressions, highlighting important limitations in their reasoning capabilities for figurative language comprehension.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了ProverbIT——一个包含100道多选题的意大利谚语补全新基准，用于评估LLM对意大利文化嵌入式语言表达的理解能力。通过对13个前沿模型（含大型推理模型LRMs与传统LLM）在三种任务上的测试，发现模型在补全任务中表现良好，但在无正确答案的多选题中性能急剧下降，表明LLM主要依赖记忆模式而非深层语义理解。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM在文化嵌入式语言表达（如图形化谚语）的理解上存在显著不足。尽管LLM在众多NLP任务中表现优异，但对其如何处理文化背景下的语言表达仍缺乏深入理解。填补这一评估空白，揭示LLM在处理文化特有语言现象时的真实能力与局限性。
AI.method: 构建ProverbIT基准（100道意大利谚语多选题），评估13个前沿模型（包括大型推理模型LRMs与传统LLM），设置三项任务：①谚语补全；②含正确答案的多项选择；③不含正确答案的多项选择。并对两个LRM进行详细的思维链（Chain-of-Thought）分析，挖掘其推理失败的原因（如字面同义词偏好偏差）。
AI.result: 研究发现三项关键结果：1）几乎所有模型在谚语补全任务中表现良好，证明其掌握相关谚语知识；2）当转为不含正确答案的多项选择题时，所有模型性能急剧下降，即便是最先进推理模型亦出现严重退化；3）CoT分析揭示模型存在强烈的字面同义词选择偏差，常在推理中提及正确谚语结尾却未能识别其不在选项中。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM主要依赖对谚语模式的记忆，而非对文化背景表达式的深层语义理解。研究揭示了LLM在处理图形化语言时的推理能力存在重要局限性，强调需要针对文化嵌入式表达开发更具语义深度的评估方法。

title: Active-SWE: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Proactive Bug Fixing without Issue Reports
summary: Coding agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly adopted in software engineering (SWE) scenarios, capable of fixing a specific bug in large-scale codebase. However, existing SWE benchmarks typically assume that high-quality issue reports with detailed information are always available, which is easily violated in practice due to the complexity of report acquisition and curation. To address this, we introduce Active-SWE, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on proactively discovering and fixing multiple bugs without report guidance, covering 1,663 tasks across six bug categories and eight languages. Beyond shifting the focus from existing reactive bug fixing to proactive bug fixing, Active-SWE enables a more in-depth evaluation by expanding the scope from fixing a specific recorded bug to multiple-bug fixing and potential bug discovery scenarios. To construct Active-SWE, we propose a novel difficulty-aware task formulation pipeline with a dual-track evaluation framework, facilitating comprehensive evaluation of proactive bug-fixing capability. Extensive experiments reveal that most state-of-the-art coding agents struggle with proactive bug-fixing tasks, demonstrating limited performance in locating and resolving recorded bugs, handling multiple bug fixing scenarios, and discovering valid potential bugs.

AI.tldr: Active-SWE 是首个面向"主动式 Bug 修复"（proactive bug fixing）的大规模基准，提出无需 issue 报告、由编码 Agent 自主发现并修复代码库中潜在缺陷的评测范式，覆盖 1,663 个任务、6 类 Bug、8 种编程语言；通过难度感知任务构造流水线与双轨评估框架，揭示了当前 SOTA 编码 Agent 在定位、修复以及发现潜在 Bug 上均存在显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有 SWE 基准（如 SWE-bench Verified / Pro）默认依赖高质量、人工撰写且信息完备的 issue 报告指导 Bug 修复。然而在实际工程中，报告的获取成本高（往往 Bug 已逃逸到生产环境才被发现，如 2024 CrowdStrike 事件）、撰写质量参差不齐，即便经过精心筛选的基准中仍存在大量低质量、不可解的报告。因此，基准对编码 Agent 的"被动式 Bug 修复"评估与真实 SWE 场景脱节，亟需一种更贴近真实需求、考察 Agent 主动发现并修复 Bug 能力的评测方式。
AI.method: 1) 基于分类驱动的数据构建流水线：从 87 个高 star 多语言开源仓库抓取 GitHub PR，通过多 LLM 标注器共识投票筛选出 6 类可发现 Bug 的 PR，并由 ReAct 风格的 Setup Agent 自动构建 Docker 可执行环境与测试脚本；2) 难度感知任务构建：Simple 任务由单个 PR 派生并丢弃 issue 报告，仅给出统一模板与待审查文件范围；Hard 任务采用时间滑动窗口聚合多个相邻 PR 的 patch/test/审查范围，构建多 Bug 修复实例；3) 双轨评估框架：Recorded Bug 轨道使用 Localization Recall/Precision（基于 edit hunk 匹配）与 Resolved（fail-to-pass 测试通过率）评估定位与修复能力；Potential Bug 轨道将潜在 Bug 评估重构为测试生成问题，通过 Test Validity（生成测试是否均呈 fail-to-pass 行为）与 Revealed（每个潜在 Bug 是否被有效测试复现）两个指标，由 LLM Judge Agent 判断测试与 Bug 的语义关联。
AI.result: 实验表明，即便是当前 SOTA 的编码 Agent，在 Active-SWE 的主动式 Bug 修复任务上整体表现欠佳：1) 在已记录 Bug 的定位与修复上精度/召回受限，Resolved 率偏低；2) 在 Hard 设置（多 Bug 场景）下性能下降明显，暴露出多 Bug 同时处理的扩展性瓶颈；3) 在潜在 Bug 发现上，能够生成的修复虽呈现一定新颖性，但有效测试证据不足，Revealed 指标显著偏低，说明 Agent 倾向于做出修改但缺乏可靠的复现验证。
AI.conclusion: Active-SWE 将 SWE 评测从"被动响应 issue"推进到"主动巡检修复"，并通过双轨评估同时考察"修复已知 Bug"与"发现潜在 Bug"两个维度，填补了现有基准在现实工程场景下的空白。实验结果证明当前 LLM 驱动的编码 Agent 尚不具备成熟的主动式 Bug 修复能力，尤其在定位准确性、多 Bug 协同处理和潜在 Bug 的可信验证方面仍有较大提升空间，为未来 Agent 在代码推理、缺陷假设生成与自我验证方向的研究提供了重要基准与启示。

title: Personalized Federated Sparse Adaptation of Time-Series Foundation Models
summary: Federated adaptation of time-series foundation models (TSFMs) is attractive for building energy forecasting because meter data are private, distributed, and highly non-IID. However, a single parameter-sharing strategy is unlikely to serve all pretrained TSFMs or building clients: fully shared adapters can suppress building-specific temporal behavior, while fully local adaptation discards cross-building transfer. We propose a personalized federated sparse adaptation framework with a heterogeneous temporal mixture-of-experts (MoE) adapter placed after the pretrained TSFM representation. A sequence-level router maps each 168-hour context window to a top-$k$ subset of experts specialized for periodicity, long-range interactions, local variation, trend-residual structure, and multi-resolution behavior. We compare global FL, local training, and personalized FL variants with globally shared or client-private expert banks. Across 50 buildings and three TSFM backbones, personalization consistently outperforms Global FL-MoE and Local MoE, while the best sparse-adaptation strategy varies by backbone and metric. Routing behavior further reveals client-level expert specialization, expert concentration, and near-uniform routing across backbones, showing that federated TSFM adaptation should be both client-aware and backbone-aware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的个性化联邦稀疏自适应框架，通过在冻结的预训练骨干表示后插入由傅里叶、注意力、卷积、分解和小波五种异构时序专家组成的稀疏混合专家（MoE）适配器，并采用序列级 top-k 路由，在保护建筑用电数据隐私的同时实现跨建筑知识迁移与客户特化建模的平衡。
AI.motivation: 建筑能耗预测面临数据隐私、分布式存储及高度非独立同分布（non-IID）的挑战，时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的联邦自适应成为自然选择。然而单一参数共享策略难以同时适配不同的预训练 TSFM 与建筑客户端：完全共享的适配器会抑制建筑特有的时序行为，而完全本地化训练则会丧失跨建筑的迁移能力。因此需要一种兼具客户感知与骨干感知能力的个性化稀疏自适应机制。
AI.method: 方法核心包括三部分：（1）后置表示稀疏 MoE 适配器——冻结预训练 TSFM 主干参数，在最终隐藏表示之后引入轻量级稀疏 MoE 分支，通过可学习残差门控 α·g(Z) 进行残差更新；（2）序列级稀疏路由与专家融合——对每个 168 小时上下文窗口的隐藏标记做均值池化生成序列级摘要，经路由器矩阵计算 logits 后选取 top-k=2 个异构专家（Fourier/Attention/Convolution/Decomposition/Wavelet），并对选中专家输出加权融合后由共享输出投影 Wo 映射回原空间；（3）个性化联邦优化目标——结合骨干特定预测损失、MoE 负载均衡损失与路由器正则化损失，通过 FedAvg/FedProx 在 15 轮通信中聚合共享参数，训练后冻结共享参数进行最终个性化阶段。实验在 ASHRAE GEP-III 数据集的 50 栋非住宅建筑上对比了零样本、全局 FL-MoE、本地 MoE、无 MoE 的 PFL、共享专家 PFL-MoE 及私有专家 PFL-MoE 六类策略，并系统消融专家组合、路由稀疏度（k=1/2/5）、优化器与客户端选择方式。
AI.result: 在 50 栋建筑、三种 TSFM 骨干（MOMENT-1-large、Chronos-2、Moirai-1.1-R-small）上的实验显示：（1）最佳个性化变体相比 Global FL-MoE 在 NRMSE 上分别降低 8.2%、7.1% 和 12.5%，且经 Holm 校正的 Wilcoxon 检验表明对 Global FL-MoE 的提升在三种骨干、两个指标上均统计显著；（2）私有专家 PFL-MoE 在 Chronos-2 与 Moirai 上显著优于 Local MoE，但对 MOMENT 不显著；（3）最强策略因骨干与评估指标而异：Chronos-2 的四专家变体（去除卷积专家）取得最佳 NRMSE，Moirai 在 FedProx 私有专家下取得最佳 NRMSE，MOMENT 则在 top-1 路由下取得最佳 NRMSE、私有专家下取得最佳 sMAPE；（4）通信开销方面，私有专家相比共享专家减少 58.6%–66.8% 通信量，仅比 PFL 无 MoE 多 6.3%–8.3%；（5）路由行为分析揭示骨干特有的专家利用模式——MOMENT 呈现客户级专家特化、Chronos-2 专家选择集中、Moirai 路由近似均匀。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，联邦 TSFM 自适应需同时考虑客户端异构性与骨干特性，不存在通用的最优个性化策略。个性化稀疏自适应在跨骨干、跨指标下始终优于全局 FL-MoE，并通常优于或与本地 MoE 相当，同时通过私有专家机制显著降低通信开销。骨干依赖的专家利用模式表明，自适应专家共享机制（如可学习哪些专家共享、哪些保持私有）及元学习适配器是未来有前景的方向，背骨感知（backbone-aware）应被视为联邦基础模型自适应的核心设计原则。局限在于仅在单一建筑能耗基准的 50 栋建筑与单变量小时级预测上验证，需扩展到不同气候、建筑类型、多变量设置与更大客户端规模。

title: Design Choices That Matter: A Functional ANOVA Analysis for Remote Sensing Multi-Label Classification
summary: Benchmarking deep learning (DL) models for multi-label classification (MLC) of remote sensing images (RSI) typically yields rankings that do not generalize beyond the evaluated datasets. In this work, we move beyond rankings by employing functional analysis of variance (fANOVA) to systematically quantify the contributions of individual design choices and their interactions to performance variability. We conduct two empirical analyses covering 48 and 20 DL models, respectively, spanning design choices such as network architecture, fine-tuning strategy, learning strategy, and initialization. By applying fANOVA across seven MLC RSI datasets, we construct dataset meta-representations that capture design-choice sensitivity profiles. Hierarchical clustering of these meta-representations reveals that datasets naturally group according to how they respond to design decisions, with patterns strongly linked to intrinsic dataset properties such as scale, spatial resolution, and label space complexity. Our findings show that for large-scale datasets, fine-tuning strategy and architecture are dominant factors, while in data-limited regimes, initialization becomes decisive. For intermediate regimes, the interaction between architecture and learning strategy governs performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于功能方差分析（fANOVA）的框架，系统量化深度学习模型设计选择（如网络架构、微调策略、学习策略、初始化）对遥感多标签分类（MLC）性能变异性的贡献。通过对两个基准场景（48个和20个DL模型）在七个MLC数据集上的分析，构建数据集元表征并通过层次聚类发现数据集按设计选择敏感性自然分组，从而将传统基准排名的结论重新解读为数据集条件性的指导。
AI.motivation: 传统深度学习模型基准比较仅产生模型排名，但这些排名无法泛化到新数据集。深度学习模型的性能受多种因素（网络架构、训练策略、迁移学习策略）影响，而这些因素的有效性又受数据集元特征（如规模、空间分辨率、标签空间复杂度）制约。因此需要超越简单的模型排名，理解各设计选择及其交互作用对性能变异的贡献，从而提供数据集感知的可操作见解。
AI.method: 采用fANOVA（基于随机森林代理模型的功能方差分析）框架，对两个基准场景进行方差分解：（1）场景1（48个DL模型）：分析架构（8种CNN）、微调策略（2种）、学习策略（3种）三个模块；（2）场景2（20个DL模型）：分析架构（10种含CNN与Transformer）和初始化策略（2种）两个模块。对每个数据集计算fANOVA重要性得分构建数据集元表征（场景1为7维，场景2为3维），然后使用余弦距离和平均链接的层次聚类对数据集元表征进行分组，并通过轮廓系数和共表型相关系数评估聚类质量。
AI.result: fANOVA代理模型在场景1和场景2的中位R²分别为0.966和0.831，拟合良好。场景1聚类将数据集分为三组：Cluster 1（BigEarthNet-19/-43、MLRSNet）：微调策略主导；Cluster 2（UCM、AID）：多种设计选择交互作用重要；Cluster 3（Ankara、DFC-15）：架构及其与微调的交互变得关键。场景2聚类同样分为三组：Cluster 1（BigEarthNet）：架构主导；Cluster 2（UCM、AID）：初始化策略决定性；Cluster 3（DFC-15、PlanetUAS、MLRSNet）：架构与初始化交互作用显著。核心发现：大规模数据集由微调策略和架构主导；数据有限场景由初始化策略决定；中等规模场景由架构与学习策略的交互决定。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一个基于fANOVA的分析框架，将深度学习基准比较从传统模型排名提升到数据集感知的设计选择敏感性分析。三个性能区间（大规模、中等规模、数据有限）与数据集内在元特征高度对齐，表明fANOVA元表征能够提供超越传统基准排名的可操作数据集感知指导。局限性包括仅分析CNN和早期Transformer架构、模块数量有限、排除现代视觉基础模型和遥感专用预训练模型、聚类数据集数量较少（每个场景仅7个）等。未来工作将探索从数据集元特征预测敏感性分布，并将分析扩展到现代视觉基础模型。

title: A 6G Integrated Sensing and Communication Framework for Railway Intrusion Detection and Collision Prediction
summary: Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) combines sensing and communication to efficiently utilize wireless resources and is emerging as a key paradigm for next-generation wireless networks. By leveraging the wide bandwidth, high frequencies, and massive antenna arrays of 5G-Advanced and 6G systems, ISAC enables physical-layer sensing using Channel State Information (CSI). The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Release 19 identifies 32 potential ISAC use cases, with particular emphasis on detecting and tracking moving objects. In this work, we address the Sensing for Railway Intrusion Detection use case, where intruders, including wildlife, entering a railway track can pose serious collision risks. We generated 22,695 CSI matrices with corresponding ground truth using a 3D-rendered railway environment and the Sionna radio simulator. We developed a machine learning model combining a three-dimensional Convolutional Neural Network (3D CNN) and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) network to detect intruders in the track danger zone and estimate their real-time position relative to the train, velocity, and time to collision. On synthetic CSI data, the model achieves 99.57% intruder-detection accuracy on a balanced test set and a combined Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.4240 for position, velocity, and time-to-collision prediction. These results demonstrate the potential of CSI-based ISAC sensing with machine learning for reliable railway intrusion detection. The complete codebase for CSI generation, preprocessing, and model development is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文针对3GPP Release 19定义的铁路入侵检测用例，提出了一种基于6G集成感知与通信（ISAC）的CSI无线感知框架。使用Sionna射线追踪仿真器在Blender构建的3D铁路场景中生成22,695个CSI矩阵，并设计了融合3D CNN与BiLSTM的混合深度学习模型，可同时实现入侵者检测（二分类）与运动学参数（位置、速度、碰撞时间）回归预测。
AI.motivation: 铁路轨道绵延数千公里穿越多样环境，野生动物、行人等异物侵入轨道危险区会引发严重碰撞事故。传统检测手段（红外、LiDAR、摄像头）受限于探测距离、视场或光照条件，难以满足长距离连续监测需求。3GPP Release 19将铁路入侵检测列为32个ISAC用例之一，但基于CSI的无线感知在此场景下的潜力尚未被充分探索，特别是从高维CSI中联合估计位置、速度与碰撞时间等运动学参数仍是开放问题。此外，获取足够多样化的铁路场景标注CSI数据也极具挑战。
AI.method: 方法分为三阶段：（1）数据生成——在Blender中搭建包含金属列车、铁轨、塔楼、建筑、树木等反射面的100m×100m 3D铁路场景，利用NVIDIA Sionna射线追踪仿真器在5GHz频段、两套无线电配置（实验配置：10×10天线、120KHz带宽；实用配置：7×7天线、100MHz带宽、833子载波、14个OFDM符号）下，通过Ray Tracing→CIR→CSI→Delay-Doppler变换流程生成带标签的CSI矩阵，并系统改变入侵者初始位置、尺寸与速度以覆盖多场景；（2）数据预处理——依次执行导频与空子载波移除、基于SNR×方差得分并结合相干带宽去相关选取的子载波选择、静态分量去除、Wiener滤波时域去噪与OFDM符号平均，最终将复值CSI拆分为幅度与相位两通道构成4D张量；（3）模型架构——混合3D CNN–BiLSTM两阶段网络，FrameEncoder采用带残差连接的4个3D卷积块（2→32→64→128→256通道）提取单帧空间特征，SequenceEncoder通过两层BiLSTM建模时序依赖，并行输出分类头（二分类检测）与回归头（位置、速度、碰撞时间、最小接近距离），采用Optuna超参寻优（学习率1.1e-5、RMSProp优化器、Batch Size 32）。
AI.result: 在合成CSI数据上：（1）入侵检测方面，平衡测试集上达到99.57%分类准确率；序列长度从1增至120时性能单调提升，验证轮次1在序列长度120下准确率达99.99%（F1=0.9998），验证轮次2在序列长度120下准确率达99.57%（F1=0.9944）；（2）运动学预测方面，验证轮次1上相对位置预测MAE=0.4200米（MSE=0.7042），联合位置、速度、碰撞时间预测的综合MAE为0.4240；定性推理案例显示模型能准确捕捉入侵者-列车相对轨迹，判断碰撞风险区间，速度Vx误差仅0.001m/s，碰撞时间误差0.182秒，最小接近距离误差0.104米。结果表明CSI与ML结合可同时支持入侵检测与运动学参数估计。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了基于CSI的6G感知技术在铁路入侵检测与碰撞风险预测中的可行性，所提出的3D CNN–BiLSTM模型可有效联合学习CSI的空间-时序特征，兼具检测与运动学参数回归能力。但存在若干局限：性能强依赖于MIMO天线规模与发射功率（天线网格减小则性能迅速下降）；入侵者的物理尺寸与材质对CSI变化可分性有影响，较小或高吸收性物体难以检测；慢速或静止入侵者时序特征弱，轨迹估计困难；当前结果基于合成仿真数据，尚需真实铁路场景实测验证以评估泛化能力。代码已开源以促进复现。

title: What We Observe as LLM Behavior Can Be a Side-effect of Inference Backend
summary: Benchmark scores are reported as properties of a model, yet the inference framework used to produce them, such as HuggingFace, vLLM, or Ollama, are considered non-influential and their names and versions are almost never disclosed. In this work we investigate how much this choice can influence the model output. In a fully-crossed study (three instruction-tuned models x five inference frameworks x six benchmarks x four generation modes) we investigate how different tools (wrappers/backend) influence benchmark scores and how their score changes is influenced by generation hyper-parameters. We find backend to be a non-negligible factor where even under greedy, sampling-noise-free decoding, changing the backend can significantly alter models performance and this effect is structural and strongly model-dependent. Decomposing the variance according to generation mode reveal that considerable portion of the variability (roughly 39\%) a practitioner sees out-of-the-box can stem from the backend, while the remaining stems from sampling noise and each framework's default generation parameters, both of which are avoidable by disclosing and matching the generation configuration. These divergences are more pronounced on factual than on social-bias benchmarks. Overall, benchmark numbers are not backend-agnostic therefore, we recommend disclosing the backend, its version, and the full generation configuration, also using deterministic decoding for cross-backend comparison.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统性地研究了五种LLM推理框架（HuggingFace、Pipeline、LangChain、vLLM、Ollama）对基准测试分数的影响，发现推理后端是非可忽略的影响因素——即使在贪心解码下，改变后端仍能显著改变模型表现，且这种效应具有结构性和模型依赖性。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM基准测试分数通常被报告为模型的属性，但推理框架（如HuggingFace、vLLM、Ollama）几乎从未被披露，且被视为无影响的工具。作者旨在揭示这一假设是否成立，量化推理后端对评估结果的实际影响，以促进可重复性。
AI.method: 采用全交叉实验设计：3个指令微调模型（Llama-3.2-1B-Inst、Gemma-3-1B-IT、Qwen2.5-1.5B-Inst）× 5个推理后端（hf_raw、hf_pipeline、langchain_hf、vllm、ollama）× 6个基准测试（MMLU、TriviaQA、TruthfulQA-MC1、TruthfulQA-Gen、BBQ、StereoSet）× 4种生成模式（Deterministic、Fix、Token=256、Default）。所有实验在固定硬件（RTX 3090）和软件环境下运行，使用BH校正显著性检验、方差分解、Jaccard相似度、Cohen's κ等统计方法。
AI.result: 1. 即使在贪心解码下，后端仍能显著改变模型表现（结构性后端效应占Default模式方差的约39%）；2. 后端效应高度模型依赖：Llama-3.2-1B-Inst受影响最大（Ollama偏离0.055），Gemma-3-1B-IT最稳健（最大偏离仅0.010）；3. 事实性基准比社会偏见基准受影响更显著；4. 后端差异不仅改变分数，还改变模型正确回答的问题集合（Llama的Cohen's κ降至0.45）；5. vLLM虽使用相同权重但因PagedAttention内核实现导致与HuggingFace分歧（Qwen2.5上|r|=0.38）。
AI.conclusion: 基准测试分数并非后端无关（not backend-agnostic）。作者建议：披露推理后端名称、版本及完整生成配置；跨后端比较时使用确定性（贪心）解码以消除采样噪声；偏见基准应同时报告格式合规性。后端效应中可通过标准化生成设置控制的部分应被消除，而结构性差异应被明确测量和报告而非隐含处理。

title: InsightEmb: Learning Action-Intent Embeddings for Agentic Insight Retrieval
summary: Self-improving agents accumulate reusable insights from prior trajectories, making retrieval increasingly important for turning accumulated experience into actionable guidance. At each decision step, retrieving the right insight can help the agent progress toward its goal, a setting we refer to as agentic insight retrieval. However, existing retrieval methods primarily model semantic similarity, while overlooking whether a retrieved insight resolves the agent's current decision bottleneck. We propose InsightEmb, a contrastive embedding framework that learns transferable progress-oriented retrieval geometry using only mathematical reasoning data. InsightEmb jointly learns to align concrete situations with abstract heuristic rules and to cluster reasoning trajectories with similar progress structures. We evaluate InsightEmb on dynamic agent tasks and a static skill-retrieval benchmark. Without any environment-specific training, InsightEmb improves over all these evaluations, surpassing the performance of existing reasoning embedding models. These results suggest that the geometry of state-insight matching can transfer across domains, enabling effective training from publicly available reasoning data without expensive environment-specific supervision.

AI.tldr: InsightEmb 是一个面向"智能体洞察检索"的对比嵌入学习框架,仅使用数学推理数据训练即可学习抽象情境与启发式规则之间的"动作意图"匹配几何,使 LLM 智能体在每个决策步检索到能解决当前流程瓶颈的洞察。它在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld 和 SRA-Bench 上均超越了基础嵌入模型及主流推理导向嵌入模型,证明了状态-洞察匹配几何在跨领域间的可迁移性。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在大型动作空间中需要从过往经验中检索抽象洞察来辅助决策,但现有检索方法主要基于语义相似度,忽视了检索结果是否真正能解决智能体当前遇到的"流程瓶颈"(即所谓"抽象鸿沟")。例如,在找到目标物体之前,智能体并不需要加热或放置规则的提示,而更需要先定位物体的搜索策略。这就要求检索从"话题匹配"转向"动作意图匹配"。论文的核心问题是:能否用一种领域无关的方式学习这种"进展导向"的相关性。
AI.method:
论文提出 InsightEmb——一个两阶段对比学习框架,完全基于公开数学推理数据(MATH 数据集的计数与概率、数论、几何领域)训练,并基于 Qwen3-Embedding-4B 微调。
1. 任务形式化:将检索视为目标条件下的"诱导式检索",相关性的定义是"使用某条洞察能否推进智能体靠近目标 Δ(s,g) 的进展",而非话题相似性。
2. 阶段一(situation-to-insight):针对每个数学问题运行 5 次轨迹,通过 DeepSeek-R1 蒸馏启发式规则(Bundle 与 Atomic 两种粒度),并采用"实用性校验"(将规则前置到同一题目查询,若能提升解题率则标为正样本 I⁺,否则为 I⁻),用 InfoNCE 损失对比学习。查询支持 query-only / full-traj / partial-traj 三种形态。
3. 阶段二(situation-to-experience):匹配结构相似的已解决问题轨迹,使用 2,896 个数学样本,继续用相同 InfoNCE 目标。两种阶段共享数学数据,仅"匹配目标"不同,从而同时学习"跨抽象层次映射"与"同层次结构聚类"。
4. 推理时,无需任何领域微调,使用任务无关的指令前缀(例如 "Given an AlfWorld task observation, retrieve relevant insights...")对当前状态编码,在预编码的洞察库中 top-k 检索。
AI.result:
在三个动态智能体环境(ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld)及一个静态技能检索基准 SRA-Bench 上的评估:
• ALFWorld:Bundle 洞察下成功率从 Base 的 54.29% 提升到 60.71%(约 +6.4pp);Atomic 洞察下 55.00% → 59.29%。
• WebShop:平均任务得分 Bundle 18.42 → 31.74(+72% 相对提升),Atomic 28.25 → 32.05。基线在 Bundle 下甚至低于无检索基线(31.03),而 InsightEmb 学会规避"过早"洞察从而实现"在噪声洞察池下安全检索"。
• ScienceWorld:Atomic 7.40 → 10.20;Bundle 7.40 → 8.00(无检索基线仅 2.40,因此所有设置均使其提升两倍以上)。
• SRA-Bench:Macro 平均 R@1/R@10 从 30.33/54.13 提升到 31.37/63.03(+8.90 R@10),定理证明、工具使用、竞赛数学和代码生成等结构匹配型任务提升尤为显著(MedCalcBench 因高度词汇专门化为唯一例外,可用 BM25 混合召回补救)。
• 跨域迁移对比:基于 ALFWorld 的领域内微调在 57.86,而纯数学训练的 InsightEmb 达到 60.71;结构多样性分析(配对嵌入的均值对余弦距离与协方差有效秩)表明数学对子在嵌入空间中的覆盖范围比 ALFWorld 更广。
• 推理导向嵌入对比:在 k∈{1,3,5} 范围内 InsightEmb 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上都超过了 ReasonIR-8B 和 Llama-NV-Embed-Reasoning-3B,优势在弱半轨迹消融时仍部分残留(ALFWorld 上承担约 83%、WebShop 上约 49% 的增益)。
• 机理分析:InsightEmb 显示出"状态感知"的检索阶段性变化,例如 ALFWorld 上 Search 类规则在前 4 步占 78.1% 而在 20–25 步下降到 61.7%,Verification 与 State Transform 类分别上升 14.6pp 和 3.9pp,体现了从检索到转换的进展条件切换。
• 鲁棒性:在 GPT-5.2 生成的洞察与 GPT-5.2 作为动作模型的更严苛设置下优势均保持一致。
AI.conclusion: InsightEmb 验证了一项简单而有力的设计主张:数学启发式检索与智能体洞察检索共享同一种"进展导向的情境→瓶颈解决规则"匹配结构。其两阶段对比课程能够仅用数学数据学习到可在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld、SRA-Bench 上迁移的几何,绕过昂贵且狭窄的领域内检索监督。此外,论文指出方法在词汇专门化、强模板化的检索场景(如 MedCalcBench)存在适用边界,可通过 BM25 混合召回加以补救。局限在于:动态智能体检索缺乏每步最优洞察的金标,只能通过下游任务成功率间接评估;阶段一的 partial-trajectory 查询当前复用同一套 I⁺/I⁻,未来可生成状态特定的正负样本以进一步提升状态感知能力。

title: Guideline-as-Oracle: Zero-Annotation Training of an Ophthalmic Telephone Triage Agent
summary: Scaling supervision for multi-turn medical agents is difficult because expert dialogue annotation is costly and clinical conversations are privacy-restricted. We introduce Guideline-as-Oracle (GAO), which compiles American Academy of Ophthalmology guidance into a 70-row operational rule table and uses it as the sole source of instance-level supervision for 3,000 training dialogues, reserving human labeling for evaluation. Because converting rules into dialogues is itself a design problem, we catalog eight construction strategies, including cited-row tier assignment, one-fact boundary pairs, metadata-only repair, and label repair, and characterize the evidential status of each: labeling mechanism, null, confounded, or evaluated only as a package. Fine-tuning a 9B backbone on this corpus yields GAO-Triage, improving agreement with a 201-case operational reference from 61.7% to 74.1% (exact McNemar p=0.0046) and emergent-case recall from 9.5% to 69.0%; the gains persist across a second seed and patient simulator. None of the seven general-purpose systems we test dominates GAO-Triage on both metrics, and GAO-Triage requires no frontier model at inference time. Permuting label-dialogue assignments collapses the model to a constant-routine predictor, indicating that the signal lies in guideline-derived assignment rather than dialogue surface form. Label repair coincides with the disappearance of a late-training safety degradation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Guideline-as-Oracle (GAO) 框架，将美国眼科学会（AAO）临床指南编译为 70 行规则表，作为唯一监督来源自动生成 3,000 轮眼科电话分诊对话，从而在零人工标注条件下微调 9B 模型。所得 GAO-Triage 在 201 例评测中将一致性从 61.7% 提升至 74.1%，紧急病例召回率从 9.5% 跃升至 69.0%，且无需推理阶段调用前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 多轮医疗对话智能体的监督面临两大瓶颈：专家对话标注成本高昂，且真实临床对话受隐私限制难以公开。现有公开医疗资源多为病历、波形或摘要形式，而非可供训练的对话数据。专业学会虽发布结构化指南（如 AAO），但如何将其转化为多轮对话智能体的实例级监督，以及该监督中真正承载能力的关键成分，尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 1. **规则编译**：将 AAO 指南编译为 70 行规则表 T = {(q_j, s_j, y_j)}，每行包含触发条件、症状家族与对应分级（紧急/急/常规）。2. **标注机制**：每个生成病例记录其引用的规则行集 J，取其中最高等级 Φ(J) 作为标签——即"引用即标注"。3. **八种对话构造策略**：引用行标注、单事实边界对、元数据修复、措辞多样性、替换、证据门控、训练-部署对齐、标签修复。策略效果在原文中多被标记为 null、混淆或仅包级评估。4. **训练设置**：以 Φ(J) 为唯一标签生成 3,000 轮对话（中位 11 轮护士发言），对 9B 基模进行全参数 SFT，类别权重 2.0/1.5/1.0 重采样，护士 token 交叉熵损失，3 轮训练。5. **评测设计**：201 例运营参考（42 紧急/47 急/112 常规），主指标为一致性（McNemar）与紧急召回率；通过禁用完整画像启发式等"干净协议"防止评测管线缺陷。6. **对照实验**：标签-对话置换实验验证信号来源。
AI.result: 1. **主对比**：GAO-Triage 较基座 9B 一致性 61.7%→74.1%（McNemar p=0.0046），紧急召回率 9.5%→69.0%（p=4.2×10⁻⁷），第二随机种子与第二患者模拟器均复现。2. **外部对比**：7 个通用模型无一在一致性与紧急召回率双指标上同时优于 GAO-Triage；GPT-5.5 一致性 75.1% 差异不显著（p=0.899），为零差异而非等效。3. **信号定位**：仅置换标签-对话配对（保持文本不变）使模型退化为恒定"常规"预测（112/201=55.7%，紧急召回 0/42），证明能力源于指南驱动的标签分配而非对话表层形式。4. **GRPO 失败**：直接对最终分级做结果奖励的 GRPO 后训练崩溃至 45.3%，主要原因是 39.8% 对话过早终止未给出分级。5. **策略评估**：八种构造策略中，两种即标注机制本身，两种产生 null，三种与共变修改混淆，仅一种（标签修复）经包级评估。6. **外部压力测试**：Oxford-40 评测中训练前体与 GPT-5.5 一致性分别为 62.5% 与 82.5%（差异不稳健），评测方向反转。
AI.conclusion: 编译型专业指南可在缺乏标注对话的场景下替代逐实例标注，为多轮分诊智能体提供可扩展的监督来源。但本文结果仅证明策略一致性（policy conformance），而非临床准确性；将结论转化为临床主张仍需独立多临床医师标注与交互式外部基准。此外，标签修复与晚期检查点安全性退化同步消失，提示数据构造策略对安全指标存在独立影响。论文同时警示：评测管线自身需审计（完整画像启发式会覆写模型判定），且基于公开 Reddit 帖的合成训练数据存在再识别风险与伦理问题，该系统不得用于真实医疗指导。

title: IMFACT: Counterfactual Explanations for Time Series via Intrinsic Mode Function Substitution
comment: 16 pages, 2 figure, 2 tables, accepted at XKDD Workshop at ECML-PKDD
summary: Oscillatory signals, such as vibration, carry class-discriminative information in specific frequency bands; perturbing them in raw feature space for counterfactual analysis easily destroys their temporal structure and produces physically implausible results. In this work, we introduce IMFACT (IMF-based counterfACTuals), a model-agnostic framework for generating plausible counterfactual explanations for time series classifiers that operates in the decomposition space of Empirical Mode Decomposition. An input signal is split into Intrinsic Mode Functions (IMFs), and selected IMFs are progressively substituted with those of a Nearest Unlike Neighbour (NUN) until the classifier flips to the target class. We evaluate six IMF-selection strategies and a multi-NUN cycling extension on two UCR benchmarks (FaultDetectionA, FruitFlies). The variance-based strategy with three NUNs outperforms two prominent baseline techniques on reliability and plausibility metrics, while cycling across three NUNs yields the best proximity across both datasets.

AI.tldr: IMFACT是一种模型无关的反事实解释框架，通过在经验模态分解(EMD)空间中替换本征模态函数(IMFs)，为时间序列分类器生成物理上合理、保真度高的反事实解释，避免了原始特征空间扰动破坏信号时序结构的问题。
AI.motivation: 振荡信号(如机械振动)的类别判别信息编码在特定频段中，直接在原始特征空间进行扰动会破坏时序相干性并产生物理上不合理的反事实结果。现有方法(Wachter、Native Guide、Glacier)均未利用信号分解作为扰动空间，限制了反事实的物理可解释性与时序保真度。
AI.method: IMFACT框架包含四个阶段：(1)检索目标类的最近异类邻居(NUN)；(2)对查询样本和NUN分别进行EMD分解得到IMFs；(3)按所选策略(distance/variance/extremes/coarse_to_fine)依次将查询的IMF替换为NUN对应IMF，每次替换后查询分类器直至预测翻转为目标类；(4)返回最终反事实。支持多NUN循环(cycle)与最近选择(closest)策略扩展。
AI.result: 在FaultDetectionA和FruitFlies两个UCR基准上：(1)消融实验显示所有19种配置均达到100%有效性，distance策略速度最快，extremes策略proximity最佳；(2)与基线对比，IMFACT是唯一在两个数据集上都达到100%有效性且运行时稳定的方法，而Glacier在FruitFlies上有效性降至36%、Wachter分别为58%/30%；(3)IMFACT在FruitFlies上比Native Guide快约468倍，proximity和plausibility指标具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 信号分解原生扰动空间(EMD/IMF)为时间序列反事实解释提供了新范式，特别适用于频率内容与时序相干性关键的场景；IMFACT在有效性、proximity、plausibility和运行时稳定性之间取得了跨数据集一致的最优权衡。局限性包括：仅评估了两个数据集与SimpleCNN、未经验证更深架构、限于单变量序列、EMD的模态混合问题、贪心搜索不保证全局最优以及variance策略运行缓慢。

title: RepoProbe: Benchmarking Architecture-Aware Repository Comprehension with Checklists
summary: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into software engineering has shifted the focus from function-level generation to repository-scale assistance. However, existing benchmarks largely rely on bug reports from GitHub Issues, which often allow models to bypass genuine understanding via pattern matching on error logs. This misalignment under-measures Edit Bias, which refers to premature generation, where models prematurely propose code modifications instead of understanding the existing repository architecture. Furthermore, current LLM-as-a-Judge scalar scoring suffers from high variance and low interpretability. This work introduces RepoProbe, a novel benchmark for evaluating repository-level code understanding through open-ended Q&A using GitHub Discussions, which focuses on open-ended architectural inquiries rather than defect reporting. To ensure rigorous evaluation, we propose a Checklist-Based Verification Protocol that decomposes answers into atomic, verifiable facts, thereby replacing subjective ratings with objective verification. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art (SOTA) LLMs reveals a persistent gap between high clarity and evidencegrounded technical correctness. It also quantitatively confirms the prevalence of edit bias, in which models prioritize code generation instead of architectural analysis. Finally, we demonstrate that our verification protocol significantly improves evaluation reliability compared to traditional evaluations with scalar scoring.

AI.tldr: RepoProbe是一个基于GitHub Discussions构建的仓库级代码理解基准（500个Q&A对，来自50个活跃仓库，覆盖15种编程语言），并提出基于检查表（Checklist）的验证协议以替代传统LLM-as-a-Judge标量评分。通过评估20个SOTA LLM，发现模型在"清晰表达"与"证据支撑的技术正确性"之间存在持续差距，并量化确认了"编辑偏见"（Edit Bias）这一失败模式——模型倾向于过早生成代码修改而非进行架构理解。
AI.motivation: 现有仓库级基准（如SWE-bench）主要依赖GitHub Issues中的缺陷报告，提供栈跟踪等强定位线索，使模型可通过模式匹配绕过真正的仓库理解（即"编辑偏见"）。同时，传统LLM-as-a-Judge标量评分存在高方差、低可解释性以及偏好冗长流畅回答的偏差，难以可靠评估开放式的仓库理解任务。
AI.method: 1）数据构建：采用多阶段流水线从2024年后创建的热门GitHub项目（≥1000 stars）的"已回答"Discussions中筛选，经相关性过滤、外部链接整合、检查表生成和质量保证，最终由专家审核保留500个自包含的Q&A对；2）检查表验证协议：将每个问题的参考答案分解为1-4个加权知识项（总分9分）+1分清晰度项，采用有理有据（rationale-first）的评分约束和严格离散评分标准，以Claude Sonnet 4.5为固定评判模型；3）实验设置：使用Claude Code作为统一的智能体脚手架，在20个跨10家供应商的前沿LLM上进行智能体式评估。
AI.result: 1）GPT-5.2以Overall Performance 62.7%、Perfect Solve Rate 26.0%领先，但最佳模型也仅在60%出头；2）所有模型的清晰度分数（Clarity）持续高于知识分数（Knowledge），揭示"流畅性掩盖正确性"的系统性差距；3）检查表验证标准差约为标量评分的一半（如Claude Opus 4.5：1.5% vs 3.5%），并通过案例分析证明其能消除"解读漂移"和"方向不一致"两类失效；4）编辑偏见在SOTA模型失败案例中占比显著（GPT-5.2 10.4%，Gemini 3 Pro 24.0%），证实模型在开放式查询中倾向直接生成代码而非分析架构；5）跨语言性能差异显著（QML 38.4% vs TypeScript 57.6%），Business Logic类别的完美解决率最低（15.8%）。
AI.conclusion: RepoProbe通过Discussion式任务有效弥补了缺陷中心基准的盲区，揭示前沿LLM在仓库级代码理解上仍存在本质性不足——进步并不单调、流畅表达与证据支撑存在系统性脱节。检查表验证协议在稳定性和可解释性上显著优于标量评分。讨论式基准可作为暴露"编辑偏见"的有效手段，为评估自主软件代理的工程判断力提供更贴近真实开发者工作流的代理指标。

title: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Observation-Calibrated Self-Distillation
summary: Large language model agents are commonly trained through reinforcement learning with sparse trajectory-level rewards, which offer limited guidance on how strongly individual tokens should be updated. On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) addresses this by re-scoring generated tokens under a privileged replay view to obtain dense, token-level supervision. However, we identify a confounding issue: the resulting support may reflect both the privileged information contained in the replay view and score shifts induced by the replay scaffold, making it difficult to attribute the support specifically to that information. This issue is especially pronounced when future environment observations serve as privileged information, since replaying them requires reconstructing an extended scaffold that itself perturbs token scores. To resolve this confounding, we propose Observation-Calibrated Self-Distillation (OCSD), which contrasts two structurally matched replay views, Full and Observation-Ablated, differing only in whether the actual future observation is present, to derive an observation residual that discounts score changes shared by the replay scaffold. OCSD then applies this residual to modulate token-level GRPO updates at high-uncertainty steps, while preserving the trajectory-level update direction. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA across three Qwen3 model scales show that OCSD consistently outperforms strong baselines. Diagnostic analyses further confirm that the calibrated residual aligns better with local environment feedback. Our code is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文针对智能体强化学习中On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) 存在的混淆问题——Full视图支持同时混合了真实未来观测信息与回放支架本身带来的分数偏移——提出观察校准自蒸馏 (OCSD) 方法，通过结构匹配的Full与Observation-Ablated双视图对比得到观测残差，仅在高不确定性步骤上对GRPO的token级更新强度进行调制，同时保留轨迹级更新方向。
AI.motivation: 1) GRPO等智能体RL方法仅使用稀疏的轨迹级奖励,无法区分各token对最终奖励的贡献粒度;2) 现有OPSD方法将未来观测作为特权信息,重新打分生成token以获得密集监督,但这一过程中回放支架(额外的格式、future-action骨架)本身也会扰动token分数,与真实观测效应发生混淆,导致Full-view支持难以归因于目标观测信息;3) 在多步交互的长视野智能体任务中,该问题尤为突出。
AI.method: OCSD构建两个结构匹配的replay view:Full view E^F(包含真实未来观测o_{k+1}、o_{k+2}及自然化的future action schema g(a_{k+1}))和Observation-Ablated view E^A(将观测字段替换为固定短语"Observation: not provided",其余支架完全相同)。观测残差定义为e_{i,k,t}=δ^F - δ^A(两者共享student对数概率项,自动抵消),映射为有界信号q=tanh(e/2)∈[-1,1]。采用NLL引导的步骤选择策略:在每条轨迹内按平均token NLL降序选取前ρ比例的高不确定性步骤。在这些被选步骤上,OCSD将token级GRPO优势调制为Â^OCSD=Â_i[1+β·sgn(Â_i)·q_{i,k,t}],保留轨迹级更新方向的同时调整更新强度,被GRPO剪裁与KL正则保持不变。关键超参:ρ=0.2,β=0.5。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和Search-QA三个基准、Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B三种规模上,OCSD全面优于GRPO、OPSD、GRPO+OPSD、RLSD和SDAR等基线:ALFWorld总体成功率55.5/82.8/87.2,较GRPO提升8.9/12.2/14.0分;WebShop成功率54.4/73.7/78.1;Search-QA平均EM 43.1/47.5/49.1,且OOD表现最佳。诊断分析显示:残差信号对valid/invalid动作的AUROC为0.707,优于Full view的0.654和Ablated view的0.464;观察互换分析证实残差依赖观测-动作的正确对应;计算开销仅比GRPO增加1.40%。消融实验表明去Ablated teacher、随机选择、去除步骤选择或去除符号对齐都会导致性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 本文识别并解决了智能体特权replay评分中的归因混淆问题,证明通过结构匹配的Full与Observation-Ablated双视图对比可有效分离未来观测信息与共享replay支架效应。OCSD在不增加额外模仿目标或修改更新方向的前提下,以极低的计算成本将未来观测转化为校准的、步骤局部的监督信号,在多个基准和模型规模上带来一致的稳定增益,并具备良好的分布外泛化能力。

title: Scrouting: Cost-Aware Routing of Coding Agents by Scouting the Repository First
summary: Frontier language models can resolve repository-level software issues, but each attempt is expensive, and existing routers select a model from the issue text alone. We present SuperScout, which routes after scouting the repository: a 7B searcher, SuperScout-7B, first explores the repository and produces a structured handoff whose reproduction claims are sandbox-verified, with false claims stripped before delivery. The searcher's hidden states, together with the task text, then feed a resume-based router that dispatches the task to one of four frontier fixers. Adding a new fixer requires no retraining. On the full Python slice of SWE-bench Pro (266 tasks) under the benchmark's official capped budget tier, SuperScout matches the best single model's solve rate (159 of 266 for SuperScout, 158 for the best model) at about a fifth of the total cost per solve, and the reported configuration sits above the random traffic-splitting baseline. A no-router ablation, always the cheapest fixer with the handoff, ties the routed system on this benchmark, so the handoff rather than the routing decision carries the result. A paired calibration study points to the mechanism: the handoff appears to redistribute rather than add solving ability, lifting the three cheaper fixers while slightly hurting the strongest, though at $N=99$ the per-fixer effects are directional only; the searcher's hidden states improve cost routing on the calibration labels while the handoff's own text does not. The searcher's compute adds less than half a cent of GPU time per task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SuperScout（"Scrouting"范式），通过让小型搜索模型先勘察代码库再路由到合适的修复模型，在 SWE-bench Pro Python 全量 266 题上以约 1/5 的单题成本追平最强单模型解决率（159 vs 158），其中经验证的交接文档（handoff）而非路由决策本身是效果的主要来源。
AI.motivation: 前沿语言模型能解决仓库级软件问题但单次成本高昂，现有路由器仅依据任务文本选择模型，无法接触到实际仓库。作者发现：(1) 各模型解决集合高度嵌套（containment 0.77–0.94），精度路由几乎没有提升空间；(2) 公开排行榜数据存在严重迁移问题（每个 fixers 真实表现与公开数据差距 −5.7 至 −24.0 pp）。因此应转向"成本路由"——仅预测何时便宜模型已足够，而此决策需在接触仓库之后做出。
AI.method: 系统包含四个组件：(1) **搜索器** SuperScout-7B（基于 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B + LoRA r=64，在 19,905 个搜索轨迹上 SFT，温度 0.9 单次采样）探索仓库并生成结构化交接文档（含可疑文件、诊断笔记、复现测试）；(2) **Verify-then-strip 沙箱门**在沙盒中回放复现声明，剥离虚假声明（仅 20% 真实，70% 虚假）；(3) **简历路由器**融合任务文本嵌入（Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B）与搜索器第-4 层预解码隐藏状态（3584 维），每个 fixer 用 25–50 个公开结果形成的"solved/failed 嵌入质心+基准率"简历，逻辑回归打分，从便宜到昂贵按阈值 θ=0.30 分配；(4) **修复器池**含 GPT-5.2、Claude Opus 4.6、Gemini 3 Flash、Kimi K2.5，添加新 fixer 无需重训。重要发现：贪心解码本地化率仅 0.110，温度 0.9 采样提升至 0.306（2.65×）。
AI.result: 在 SWE-bench Pro Python-266 上（官方封顶预算档：50 次 LLM 调用、$2/任务）：SuperScout 解决 159/266（59.77%），单题总成本 $0.230；最佳单模型 Claude Opus 4.6 solo 解决 158/266（59.40%），单题成本 $1.274——成本降至约 1/5。无路由器消融（始终用 Kimi K2.5 + handoff）同样达 159/266，$0.227/题，说明 handoff 而非路由决策承载了主要效果。校准研究（99 任务配对）显示 handoff 呈"再分配"模式：三个较弱 fixer 提升（+2.0 至 +5.1 pp），最强 GPT-5.2 反而下降（−4.0 pp），但所有对比 p>0.05 仅为方向性。路由器特征空间实验中，隐藏状态使成本节省从 30.5% 提升至 34.3%，而 handoff 文本特征反而将其压至 8–9%。本地化召回 0.566、精确率 0.821；搜索器 GPU 成本仅 $1.13（约 0.4¢/任务）。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明"先勘察再路由"有效但机制与预期不同：经沙箱验证的交接文档（而非路由决策）才是效果主要载体；搜索器隐藏状态比 handoff 文本本身更能指导路由器。系统通过仅用简历即可零成本接入新 fixers，适配快速演进的模型市场。局限包括：单一基准 Python 切片（266 题跨 3 个仓库）、配对校准 n=99 检验力不足、所有 handoff 效应仅为方向性、fixer 端污染不可控、未运行 pass-through 消融无法量化验证门的贡献、价格快照不稳定。

title: A-SR: Self-Evolving Agentic LLMs for Symbolic Regression via Hierarchical Coordination
summary: Symbolic regression aims to discover closed-form equations from data, but existing LLM-guided methods often rely on a unified proposal loop that compresses heterogeneous search failures into a scalar score and a single prompt. We propose A-SR, a self-evolving agentic framework that shifts the control unit from expression edits to role-conditioned evidence views. A-SR coordinates formula discovery through routing among coordination protocols, an online evaluator-reward role policy, and state-routed process memory.
